B2366: 3>if the MAC entity is configured with lch-basedPrioritization, and the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion does not overlap with the PUSCH duration of an uplink grant received in a Random Access Response or with the PUSCH duration of an uplink grant addressed to Temporary C-RNTI or with the PUSCH duration of a MSGA payload, and the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion for the pending SR triggered as specified in clause 5.4.5 overlaps with any other UL-SCH resource(s), and the physical layer can signal the SR on one valid PUCCH resource for SR, and the priority of the logical channel that triggered SR is higher than the priority of the uplink grant(s) for any UL-SCH resource(s) where the uplink grant was not already de-prioritized and its simultaneous transmission with the SR is not allowed by configuration of simultaneousPUCCH-PUSCH or simultaneousPUCCH-PUSCH-SecondaryPUCCHgroup or simultaneousSR-PUSCH-diffPUCCHgroups or simultaneousPUCCH-PUSCH-SamePriority or simultaneousPUCCH-PUSCH-SamePriority-SecondaryPUCCHgroup, and the priority of the uplink grant is determined as specified in clause 5.4.1; or
B2367: 3>if both sl-PrioritizationThres and ul-PrioritizationThres are configured and the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion for the pending SR triggered as specified in clause 5.22.1.5 overlaps with any UL-SCH resource(s) carrying a MAC PDU, and the value of the priority of the triggered SR determined as specified in clause 5.22.1.5 is lower than sl-PrioritizationThres and the value of the highest priority of the logical channel(s) in the MAC PDU is higher than or equal to ul-PrioritizationThres and any MAC CE prioritized as described in clause 5.4.3.1.3 is not included in the MAC PDU and the MAC PDU is not prioritized by upper layer according to TS 23.287 [19]; or
B2368: 3>if an SL-SCH resource overlaps with the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion for the pending SR triggered as specified in clause 5.4.5, and the MAC entity is not able to perform this SR transmission simultaneously with the transmission of the SL-SCH resource, and either transmission on the SL-SCH resource is not prioritized as described in clause 5.22.1.3.1a or the priority value of the logical channel that triggered SR is lower than ul-PrioritizationThres, if configured; or
B2369: 3>if an SL-SCH resource overlaps with the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion for the pending SR triggered as specified in clause 5.22.1.5, and the MAC entity is not able to perform this SR transmission simultaneously with the transmission of the SL-SCH resource, and the priority of the triggered SR determined as specified in clause 5.22.1.5 is higher than the priority of the MAC PDU determined as specified in clause 5.22.1.3.1a for the SL-SCH resource; or
B2370: 3>if an SL-PRS resource overlaps with the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion for the pending SR triggered as specified in clause 5.4.5, and the MAC entity is not able to perform this SR transmission simultaneously with the transmission of the SL-PRS resource, and either transmission on the SL-PRS resource is not prioritized as described in clause 5.22.1.3.1a or in the clause 5.22.1.3.5, or the priority value of the logical channel that triggered SR is lower than ul-PrioritizationThres, if configured; or
B2371: 3>if an SL-PRS resource overlaps with the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion for the pending SR triggered as specified in clause 5.22.1.5, and the MAC entity is not able to perform this SR transmission simultaneously with the transmission of the SL-PRS resource, and the priority of the triggered SR determined as specified in clause 5.22.1.5 is higher than the priority of the MAC PDU and SL-PRS, if available, determined as specified in clause 5.22.1.3.1a or the SL-PRS resource in clause 5.22.1.3.5:
B2372: 4>consider the SR transmission as a prioritized SR transmission.
B2373: 4>consider the other overlapping uplink grant(s), if any, as a de-prioritized uplink grant(s), except for the overlapping uplink grant(s) whose simultaneous transmission is allowed by configuration of simultaneousPUCCH-PUSCH or simultaneousPUCCH-PUSCH-SecondaryPUCCHgroup or simultaneousSR-PUSCH-diffPUCCH-Groups or simultaneousPUCCH-PUSCH-SamePriority or simultaneousPUCCH-PUSCH-SamePriority-SecondaryPUCCHgroup;
B2374: 4>if the de-prioritized uplink grant(s) is a configured uplink grant configured with autonomousTx whose PUSCH has already started:
B2375: 5>stop the configuredGrantTimer for the corresponding HARQ process of the de-prioritized uplink grant(s);
B2376: 5>stop the cg-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding HARQ process of the de-prioritized uplink grant(s).
B2377: 4>if SR_COUNTER < sr-TransMax:
B2378: 5>instruct the physical layer to signal the SR on one valid PUCCH resource for SR;
B2379: 5>if LBT failure indication is not received from lower layers:
B2380: 6>increment SR_COUNTER by 1;
B2381: 6>start the sr-ProhibitTimer.
B2382: 5>else if lbt-FailureRecoveryConfig is not configured:
B2383: 6>increment SR_COUNTER by 1.
B2384: 4>else:
B2385: 5>notify RRC to release PUCCH for all Serving Cells;
B2386: 5>notify RRC to release SRS for all Serving Cells;
B2387: 5>clear any configured downlink assignments and uplink grants;
B2388: 5>clear any PUSCH resources for semi-persistent CSI reporting;
B2389: 5>if rach-LessHO is not configured and if there is no ongoing RACH-less LTM cell switch:
B2390: 6>initiate a Random Access procedure (see clause 5.1) on the SpCell and cancel all pending SRs.
B2391: 3>else:
B2392: 4>consider the SR transmission as a de-prioritized SR transmission.
B2393: NOTE 1:Except for the cases specified in NOTE 3 below, the selection of which valid PUCCH resource for SR to signal SR on when the MAC entity has more than one overlapping valid PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion is left to UE implementation.
B2394: NOTE 2:If more than one individual SR triggers an instruction from the MAC entity to the PHY layer to signal the SR on the same valid PUCCH resource, the SR_COUNTER for the relevant SR configuration is incremented only once.
B2395: NOTE 3:When the MAC entity has pending SR for SCell beam failure recovery and the MAC entity has one or more PUCCH resources (other than PUCCH resources of pending SR for beam failure recovery of a BFD-RS set or for event triggered L1 measurement report) overlapping with PUCCH resource for SCell beam failure recovery for the SR transmission occasion, the MAC entity considers only the PUCCH resource for SCell beam failure recovery as valid. When the MAC entity has pending SR for beam failure recovery of a BFD-RS set of Serving Cell and the MAC entity has one or more PUCCH resources (other than PUCCH resources of pending SR for beam failure recovery or for event triggered L1 measurement report) overlapping with PUCCH resource for beam failure recovery of that BFD-RS set for the SR transmission occasion, the MAC entity considers only the PUCCH resource for beam failure recovery of that BFD-RS set as valid. When the MAC entity has pending SR for event triggered L1 measurement report and the MAC entity has one or more PUCCH resources (other than PUCCH resources of pending SR for beam failure recovery or for beam failure recovery of a BFD-RS set) overlapping with PUCCH resource for event triggered L1 measurement report for the SR transmission occasion, the MAC entity considers only the PUCCH resource for event triggered L1 measurement report as valid.
B2396: NOTE 4:For a UE operating in a semi-static channel access mode as described in TS 37.213 [18], PUCCH resources overlapping with the set of consecutive symbols where the UE does not transmit before the start of a next channel occupancy time are not considered valid.
B2397: NOTE 5:If the MAC entity is configured with lch-basedPrioritization, the MAC entity does not take UCI multiplexing according to the procedure specified in TS 38.213 [6] into account when determining whether the valid PUCCH resource for the SR transmission can be signalled by the physical layer and the SR transmission occasion overlaps with the PUSCH duration of an uplink grant of a MSGA payload.
B2398: NOTE 6:When the MAC entity overlapping has PUCCH resource between any of pending SR for SCell beam failure recovery, or PUCCH resource for pending SR for beam failure recovery of a BFD-RS set, or PUCCH resource for pending SR for event triggered L1 measurement report for the SR transmission occasion, the selection of which valid PUCCH resource for SR transmission is up to UE implementation.
B2399: NOTE 7:If an SL-SCH resource overlaps with the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion for the pending SR triggered by Uu MAC CEs except BSR/SL-BSR MAC CE, and the MAC entity is not able to perform this SR transmission simultaneously with the transmission of the SL-SCH resource, it is left to UE implementation to determine whether this SR transmission is prioritized over the SL transmission.
B2400: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for BSR, which was initiated by the MAC entity prior to the MAC PDU assembly and which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2401: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU includes a BSR MAC CE which contains buffer status up to (and including) the last event that triggered a BSR (see clause 5.4.5) prior to the MAC PDU assembly; or
B2402: -the UL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data available for transmission.
B2403: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for SL-BSR, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2404: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and the ongoing Random Access procedure was initiated by the MAC entity prior to the MAC PDU assembly, and this PDU includes an SL-BSR MAC CE which contains buffer status up to (and including) the last event that triggered an SL-BSR (see clause 5.22.1.6) prior to the MAC PDU assembly; or
B2405: -the SL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data available for transmission, and the ongoing Random Access procedure was initiated by the MAC entity prior to the sidelink MAC PDU assembly.
B2406: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for SL-CSI reporting, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2407: -the SL grant can accommodate SL-CSI reporting MAC CE for transmission.
B2408: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for SL-DRX command indication, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2409: -the SL grant can accommodate SL-DRX command indication for transmission.
B2410: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for BFR of an SCell, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2411: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU contains a MAC CE for BFR which includes beam failure recovery information of that SCell; or
B2412: -the SCell is deactivated (as specified in clause 5.9) and all triggered BFRs for SCells are cancelled.
B2413: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for BFR of a BFD-RS set of a Serving Cell, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2414: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU contains an Enhanced BFR MAC CE or a Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE which includes beam failure recovery information of that BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell.
B2415: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for consistent LBT failure recovery, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2416: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU includes an LBT failure MAC CE that indicates consistent LBT failure for all the SCells that triggered consistent LBT failure; or
B2417: -all the SCells that triggered consistent LBT failure recovery are deactivated (see clause 5.9).
B2418: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for Sidelink consistent LBT failure recovery, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if one of the following conditions is met:
B2419: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU includes an SL LBT failure MAC CE that indicates Sidelink consistent LBT failure; or
B2420: -all the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure recovery are cancelled (see clause 5.31.2).
B2421: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for positioning measurement gap activation/deactivation request, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2422: -the Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE that triggers the SR corresponding to the Random Access procedure has already been cancelled.
B2423: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for Timing Advance report, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2424: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU includes a Timing Advance Report MAC CE (see clause 5.4.8).
B2425: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for DSR, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2426: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU includes either a DSR MAC CE or all the PDCP SDUs associated with the DSR (see clause 5.4.9); or
B2427: -all the PDCP SDUs associated with the DSR have been discarded (see clause 5.4.9).
B2428: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for SL-PRS Resource Request, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2429: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU includes a SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE (see clause 5.22.1.12).
B2430: The MAC entity may stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for Event Triggered L1 Measurement Report, which has no valid PUCCH resources configured, if:
B2431: -a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU includes a (Truncated) Event Triggered L1 Measurement Report MAC CE (see clause 5.35).
B2432: 5.4.5Buffer Status Reporting
B2433: The Buffer Status reporting (BSR) procedure is used to provide the serving gNB with information about UL data volume in the MAC entity.
B2434: RRC configures the following parameters to control the BSR:
B2435: -periodicBSR-Timer;
B2436: -retxBSR-Timer;
B2437: -logicalChannelSR-DelayTimerApplied;
B2438: -logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer;
B2439: -logicalChannelSR-Mask;
B2440: -logicalChannelGroup, logicalChannelGroupIAB-Ext;
B2441: -sdt-LogicalChannelSR-DelayTimer;
B2442: -additionalBS-TableAllowed.
B2443: Each logical channel may be allocated to an LCG using the logicalChannelGroup. The maximum number of LCGs is eight except for IAB-MTs configured with logicalChannelGroupIAB-Ext, for which the maximum number of LCGs is 256.
B2444: The MAC entity determines the amount of UL data available for a logical channel according to the data volume calculation procedure in TSs 38.322 [3] and 38.323 [4].
B2445: A BSR shall be triggered if any of the following events occur for activated cell group:
B2446: -UL data, for a logical channel which belongs to an LCG, becomes available to the MAC entity; and either
B2447: -this UL data belongs to a logical channel with higher priority than the priority of any logical channel containing available UL data which belong to any LCG; or
B2448: -none of the logical channels which belong to an LCG contains any available UL data.
B2449: in which case the BSR is referred below to as 'Regular BSR';
B2450: -UL resources are allocated and number of padding bits is equal to or larger than the size of the Buffer Status Report MAC CE plus its subheader, in which case the BSR is referred below to as 'Padding BSR';
B2451: -retxBSR-Timer expires, and at least one of the logical channels which belong to an LCG contains UL data, in which case the BSR is referred below to as 'Regular BSR';
B2452: -periodicBSR-Timer expires, in which case the BSR is referred below to as 'Periodic BSR'.
B2453: NOTE 1:When Regular BSR triggering events occur for multiple logical channels simultaneously, each logical channel triggers one separate Regular BSR.
B2454: For Regular BSR, the MAC entity shall:
B2455: 1>if the BSR is triggered for a logical channel for which logicalChannelSR-DelayTimerApplied with value true is configured by upper layers and SDT procedure is not ongoing according to clause 5.27:
B2456: 2>start or restart the logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer.
B2457: 1>else if BSR is triggered for a logical channel for which logicalChannelSR-DelayTimerApplied with value true is configured by upper layers and SDT procedure is ongoing according to clause 5.27:
B2458: 2>start or restart logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer with the value as configured by the sdt-LogicalChannelSR-DelayTimer, if configured.
B2459: 1>else:
B2460: 2>if running, stop the logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer.
B2461: For Regular and Periodic BSR, the MAC entity for which logicalChannelGroupIAB-Ext is not configured by upper layers shall:
B2462: 1>if for at least one LCG configured with additionalBS-TableAllowed, the amount of UL data available for transmission when the MAC PDU containing the BSR is to be built is within the buffer sizes specified in Table 6.1.3.1-3:
B2463: 2>report Refined Long BSR for all LCGs which have data available for transmission;
B2464: 1>else:
B2465: 2>if more than one LCG has data available for transmission when the MAC PDU containing the BSR is to be built:
B2466: 3>report Long BSR for all LCGs which have data available for transmission.
B2467: 2>else if one LCG has data available and is configured with additionalBS-TableAllowed and the amount of UL data available for transmission when the MAC PDU containing the BSR is to be built is greater than the largest buffer size specified in Table 6.1.3.1-3:
B2468: 3>report Long BSR.
B2469: 2>else:
B2470: 3>report Short BSR.
B2471: For Regular and Periodic BSR, the MAC entity for which logicalChannelGroupIAB-Ext is configured by upper layers shall:
B2472: 1>if more than one LCG has data available for transmission when the MAC PDU containing the BSR is to be built:
B2473: 2>if the maximum LCG ID among the configured LCGs is 7 or lower:
B2474: 3>report Long BSR for all LCGs which have data available for transmission.
B2475: 2>else:
B2476: 3>report Extended Long BSR for all LCGs which have data available for transmission.
B2477: 1>else:
B2478: 2>report Extended Short BSR.
B2479: For Padding BSR, the MAC entity for which logicalChannelGroupIAB-Ext is not configured by upper layers shall:
B2480: 1>if the number of padding bits is equal to or larger than the size of the Short BSR plus its subheader but smaller than the size of the Long BSR plus its subheader:
B2481: 2>if more than one LCG has data available for transmission when the BSR is to be built:
B2482: 3>if the number of padding bits is equal to the size of the Short BSR plus its subheader:
B2483: 4>report Short Truncated BSR of the LCG with the highest priority logical channel with data available for transmission.
B2484: 3>else:
B2485: 4>report Long Truncated BSR of the LCG(s) with the logical channels having data available for transmission following a decreasing order of the highest priority logical channel (with or without data available for transmission) in each of these LCG(s), and in case of equal priority, in increasing order of LCGID.
B2486: 2>else:
B2487: 3>report Short BSR.
B2488: 1>else if for at least one LCG configured with additionalBS-TableAllowed, the amount of UL data available for transmission when the MAC PDU containing the BSR is to be built is within the buffer sizes specified in Table 6.1.3.1-3 and the number of padding bits is equal to or larger than the size of the Refined Long BSR plus its subheader:
B2489: 2>report Refined Long BSR for all LCGs which have data available for transmission.
B2490: 1>else if the number of padding bits is equal to or larger than the size of the Long BSR plus its subheader:
B2491: 2>report Long BSR for all LCGs which have data available for transmission.
B2492: For Padding BSR, the MAC entity for which logicalChannelGroupIAB-Ext is configured by upper layers shall:
B2493: 1>if the number of padding bits is equal to or larger than the size of the Extended Short BSR plus its subheader but smaller than the size of the Extended Long BSR plus its subheader:
B2494: 2>if more than one LCG has data available for transmission when the BSR is to be built:
B2495: 3>if the number of padding bits is smaller than the size of the Extended Long Truncated BSR with zero Buffer Size field plus its subheader:
B2496: 4>report Extended Short Truncated BSR of the LCG with the highest priority logical channel with data available for transmission.
B2497: 3>else:
B2498: 4>report Extended Long Truncated BSR of the LCG(s) with the logical channels having data available for transmission following a decreasing order of the highest priority logical channel (with or without data available for transmission) in each of these LCG(s), and in case of equal priority, in increasing order of LCGID.
B2499: 2>else:
B2500: 3>report Extended Short BSR.
B2501: 1>else if the number of padding bits is equal to or larger than the size of the Extended Long BSR plus its subheader:
B2502: 2>report Extended Long BSR for all LCGs which have data available for transmission.
B2503: For BSR triggered by retxBSR-Timer expiry, the MAC entity considers that the logical channel that triggered the BSR is the highest priority logical channel that has data available for transmission at the time the BSR is triggered.
B2504: The MAC entity shall:
B2505: 1>if the Buffer Status reporting procedure determines that at least one BSR has been triggered and not cancelled:
B2506: 2>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the BSR MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B2507: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the BSR MAC CE(s) as defined in clause 6.1.3.1;
B2508: 3>start or restart periodicBSR-Timer except when all the generated BSRs are long or short Truncated or Extended long or short Truncated BSRs;
B2509: 3>start or restart retxBSR-Timer.
B2510: 2>if a Regular BSR has been triggered and logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer is not running:
B2511: 3>if there is no UL-SCH resource available for a new transmission; or
B2512: 3>if the MAC entity is configured with configured uplink grant(s) and the Regular BSR was triggered for a logical channel for which logicalChannelSR-Mask is set to false; or
B2513: 3>if the UL-SCH resources available for a new transmission do not meet the LCP mapping restrictions (see clause 5.4.3.1) configured for the logical channel that triggered the BSR:
B2514: 4>trigger a Scheduling Request.
B2515: NOTE 2:UL-SCH resources are considered available if the MAC entity has an active configured grant, or receives, or determines an uplink grant. If the MAC entity has determined at a given point in time that UL-SCH resources are available, this need not imply that UL-SCH resources are available for use at that point in time.
B2516: A MAC PDU shall contain at most one BSR MAC CE, even when multiple events have triggered a BSR. The Regular BSR and the Periodic BSR shall have precedence over the padding BSR.
B2517: The MAC entity shall restart retxBSR-Timer upon reception of a grant for transmission of new data on any UL-SCH.
B2518: All triggered BSRs may be cancelled when the UL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data available for transmission but is not sufficient to additionally accommodate the BSR MAC CE plus its subheader. All BSRs triggered prior to MAC PDU assembly shall be cancelled when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes a Long, Refined Long, Extended Long, Short, or Extended Short BSR MAC CE which contains buffer status up to (and including) the last event that triggered a BSR prior to the MAC PDU assembly.
B2519: NOTE 3:MAC PDU assembly can happen at any point in time between uplink grant reception and actual transmission of the corresponding MAC PDU. BSR and SR can be triggered after the assembly of a MAC PDU which contains a BSR MAC CE, but before the transmission of this MAC PDU. In addition, BSR and SR can be triggered during MAC PDU assembly.
B2520: NOTE 4:Void
B2521: NOTE 5:If a HARQ process is configured with cg-RetransmissionTimer and if the BSR is already included in a MAC PDU for transmission on configured grant by this HARQ process, but not yet transmitted by lower layers, it is up to UE implementation how to handle the BSR content.
B2522: 5.4.6Power Headroom Reporting
B2523: The Power Headroom reporting procedure is used to provide the serving gNB with the following information:
B2524: -Type 1 power headroom: the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmit power and the estimated power for UL-SCH transmission per activated Serving Cell;
B2525: -Type 2 power headroom: the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmit power and the estimated power for UL-SCH and PUCCH transmission on SpCell of the other MAC entity (i.e. E-UTRA MAC entity in EN-DC, NE-DC, and NGEN-DC cases);
B2526: -Type 3 power headroom: the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmit power and the estimated power for SRS transmission per activated Serving Cell;
B2527: -MPE P-MPR: the power backoff to meet the MPE FR2 requirements for a Serving Cell operating on FR2;
B2528: -DPC: the adjustment to maximum output power for a given power class for a Serving Cell operating on FR1;
B2529: -DPCBC: the adjustment to maximum output power for a given power class for a Band Combination operating on FR1.
B2530: RRC controls Power Headroom reporting by configuring the following parameters:
B2531: -dpc-Reporting-FR1;
B2532: -phr-AssumedPUSCH-Reporting;
B2533: -phr-PeriodicTimer;
B2534: -phr-ProhibitTimer;
B2535: -phr-Tx-PowerFactorChange;
B2536: -phr-Type2OtherCell;
B2537: -phr-ModeOtherCG;
B2538: -multiplePHR;
B2539: -mpe-Reporting-FR2;
B2540: -mpe-ProhibitTimer;
B2541: -mpe-Threshold;
B2542: -numberOfN;
B2543: -mpe-ResourcePoolToAddModList;
B2544: -twoPHRMode.
B2545: A Power Headroom Report (PHR) shall be triggered if any of the following events occur:
B2546: -phr-ProhibitTimer expires or has expired and the path loss has changed more than phr-Tx-PowerFactorChange dB for at least one RS used as pathloss reference for one activated Serving Cell of any MAC entity of which the active DL BWP is not dormant BWP since the last transmission of a PHR in this MAC entity when the MAC entity has UL resources for new transmission;
B2547: NOTE 1:The path loss variation for one cell assessed above is between the pathloss measured at present time on the current pathloss reference and the pathloss measured at the transmission time of the last transmission of PHR on the pathloss reference in use at that time, irrespective of whether the pathloss reference has changed in between. The current pathloss reference for this purpose does not include any pathloss reference configured using pathlossReferenceRS-Pos in TS 38.331 [5].
B2548: NOTE 1a:If pathlossOffset is not configured for TCI state(s), the measured pathloss, as specified in clause 7 of TS 38.213 [6], is used to determine the path loss variation in NOTE 1; otherwise, the pathloss is set to the measured pathloss minus the latest pathloss offset of the TCI state associated with the pathloss reference.
B2549: -phr-PeriodicTimer expires;
B2550: -upon configuration or reconfiguration of the power headroom reporting functionality by upper layers, which is not used to disable the function;
B2551: -activation of an SCell of any MAC entity with configured uplink of which firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id is not set to dormant BWP;
B2552: -activation of an SCG;
B2553: -addition of the PSCell except if the SCG is deactivated (i.e. PSCell is newly added or changed);
B2554: -phr-ProhibitTimer expires or has expired, when the MAC entity has UL resources for new transmission, and the following is true for any of the activated Serving Cells of any MAC entity with configured uplink:
B2555: -there are UL resources allocated for transmission or there is a PUCCH transmission on this cell, and the required power backoff due to power management (as allowed by P-MPRc as specified in TS 38.101-1 [14], TS 38.101-2 [15], and TS 38.101-3 [16]) for this cell has changed more than phr-Tx-PowerFactorChange dB since the last transmission of a PHR when the MAC entity had UL resources allocated for transmission or PUCCH transmission on this cell.
B2556: -Upon switching of activated BWP from dormant BWP to non-dormant DL BWP of an SCell of any MAC entity with configured uplink;
B2557: -if dpc-Reporting-FR1 is configured, ΔPPowerClass /ΔPPowerClass, CA/ΔPPowerClass, EN-DC/ΔPPowerClass, NR-DC reporting is triggered upon uplink duty cycle exceedance or upon return to the power class after the duty cycle exceedance, as specified in TS 38.101-1 [14] and TS 38.101-3 [16]).
B2558: -if mpe-Reporting-FR2 is configured, and mpe-ProhibitTimer is not running:
B2559: -the measured P-MPR applied to meet FR2 MPE requirements as specified in TS 38.101-2 [15] is equal to or larger than mpe-Threshold for at least one activated FR2 Serving Cell since the last transmission of a PHR in this MAC entity; or
B2560: -the measured P-MPR applied to meet FR2 MPE requirements as specified in TS 38.101-2 [15] has changed more than phr-Tx-PowerFactorChange dB for at least one activated FR2 Serving Cell since the last transmission of a PHR due to the measured P-MPR applied to meet MPE requirements being equal to or larger than mpe-Threshold in this MAC entity.
B2561: in which case the PHR is referred below to as 'MPE P-MPR report'.
B2562: NOTE 2:The MAC entity should avoid triggering a PHR when the required power backoff due to power management decreases only temporarily (e.g. for up to a few tens of milliseconds) and it should avoid reflecting such temporary decrease in the values of PCMAX,f,c/PH when a PHR is triggered by other triggering conditions.
B2563: NOTE 3:If a HARQ process is configured with cg-RetransmissionTimer and if the PHR is already included in a MAC PDU for transmission on configured grant by this HARQ process, but not yet transmitted by lower layers, it is up to UE implementation how to handle the PHR content.
B2564: If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for a new transmission the MAC entity shall:
B2565: 1>if it is the first UL resource allocated for a new transmission since the last MAC reset:
B2566: 2>start phr-PeriodicTimer.
B2567: 1>if the Power Headroom reporting procedure determines that at least one PHR has been triggered and not cancelled; and
B2568: 1>if the allocated UL resources can accommodate the MAC CE for PHR which the MAC entity is configured to transmit, plus its subheader, as a result of LCP as defined in clause 5.4.3.1:
B2569: 2>if multiplePHR with value true is configured:
B2570: 3>for each activated Serving Cell with configured uplink associated with any MAC entity of which the active DL BWP is not dormant BWP; and
B2571: 3>for each activated Serving Cell with configured uplink associated with E-UTRA MAC entity:
B2572: 4>if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode:
B2573: 5>if this Serving Cell is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN and the MAC entity this Serving Cell belongs to is configured with twoPHRMode:
B2575: 6>obtain two values of the Type 1 power headroom for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213 [6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2576: 5>else if this Serving Cell is configured with multiple TRP PUSCH repetition (i.e., not configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN) and the MAC entity this Serving Cell belongs to is configured with twoPHRMode:
B2578: 6>if the UE supports mTRP-PUSCH-PHR-Type1-Reporting-r17:
B2579: 7>obtain two values of the Type 1 power headroom for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213 [6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2580: 6>else:
B2581: 7>obtain two values of the Type 1 or the value of Type 3 power headroom for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213 [6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2582: 5>else:
B2583: 6>obtain the value of the Type 1 or Type 3 power headroom for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213 [6] for NR Serving Cell and clause 5.1.1.2 of TS 36.213 [17] for E-UTRA Serving Cell.
B2584: 4>else (i.e. this MAC entity is not configured with twoPHRMode):
B2585: 5>if this Serving Cell is configured with multiple TRP PUSCH repetition or multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN and if the MAC entity this Serving Cell belongs to is configured with twoPHRMode:
B2587: 6>if there is at least one real PUSCH transmission at the slot where the PHR MAC CE is transmitted:
B2588: 7>if this Serving Cell is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN:
B2589: 8>if the first TCI-State or TCI-UL-State is applied for a real PUSCH transmission:
B2590: 9>obtain the value of the Type 1 power headroom of the real PUSCH transmission associated with the first TCI-State or TCI-UL-State for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213[6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2591: 8>else:
B2592: 9>obtain the value of the Type 1 power headroom of the real PUSCH transmission associated with the second TCI-State or TCI-UL-State for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213[6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2593: 7>else if this Serving Cell is configured with multiple TRP PUSCH repetition:
B2594: 8>obtain the value of the Type 1 power headroom of the first real transmission of the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213[6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2595: 6>else if there is no real PUSCH transmission at the slot where the PHR MAC CE is transmitted:
B2596: 7>if this Serving Cell is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN:
B2597: 8>obtain the value of the Type 1 power headroom of the reference PUSCH transmission associated with the first TCI-State or TCI-UL-State for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213[6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2598: 7>else if this Serving Cell is configured with multiple TRP PUSCH repetition:
B2599: 8>if the UE supports mTRP-PUSCH-PHR-Type1-Reporting-r17:
B2600: 9>obtain the value of the Type 1 power headroom of the reference PUSCH transmission associated with the SRS-ResourceSet with a lower SRS-resourceSetID for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213[6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2601: 8>else:
B2602: 9>obtain the value of the Type 1 power headroom of the reference PUSCH transmission associated with the SRS-ResourceSet with a lower SRS-resourceSetID or the value of the Type 3 power headroom for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213[6] for NR Serving Cell.
B2603: 5>else:
B2604: 6>obtain the value of the Type 1 or Type 3 power headroom for the corresponding uplink carrier as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213 [6] for NR Serving Cell and clause 5.1.1.2 of TS 36.213 [17] for E-UTRA Serving Cell.
B2605: 4>if this MAC entity is configured with phr-AssumedPUSCH-Reporting:
B2606: 5>if this MAC entity has UL resources allocated for transmission on this Serving Cell; or
B2607: 5>if the other MAC entity, if configured, has UL resources allocated for transmission on this Serving Cell and phr-ModeOtherCG is set to real by upper layers:
B2608: 6>if dynamicTransformPrecoderFieldPresenceDCI-0-1-r18 or dynamicTransformPrecoderFieldPresenceDCI-0-2-r18 is set to enabled in the active BWP of this Serving Cell:
B2609: 7>obtain the value for the corresponding PCMAX,f,c field for assumed PUSCH from the physical layer if available, as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213 [6].
B2610: 6>obtain the value for the corresponding PCMAX,f,c field from the physical layer.
B2611: 6>if mpe-Reporting-FR2 is configured and this Serving Cell operates on FR2 and this Serving Cell is associated to this MAC entity:
B2612: 7>obtain the value for the corresponding MPE field from the physical layer.
B2613: 4>else (i.e. if this MAC entity is not configured with phr-AssumedPUSCH-Reporting):
B2614: 5>if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode and any Serving Cell belonging to this MAC entity is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN; and
B2616: 5>if this Serving Cell is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN and the MAC entity this Serving Cell belongs to is configured with twoPHRMode:
B2617: 6>obtain two values for the corresponding PCMAX,f,c,k fields from the physical layer.
B2618: 6>if mpe-Reporting-FR2 is configured for the MAC entity this Serving Cell belongs to and this Serving Cell operates on FR2:
B2619: 7>obtain two values for the corresponding MPEk fields from the physical layer.
B2620: 5>else if this MAC entity is not configured with twoPHRmode, or if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode and any Serving Cell belonging to this MAC entity is configured with multiple TRP PUSCH repetition; and
B2621: 5>if this Serving Cell is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN and the MAC entity this Serving Cell belongs to is configured with twoPHRMode:
B2622: 6>if the first TCI-State or TCI-UL-State is applied for a real PUSCH transmission at the slot where the PHR MAC CE is transmitted:
B2623: 7>obtain the value for the PCMAX,f,c field for the PUSCH transmission associated to the first TCI-State or TCI-UL-State from the physical layer.
B2624: 7>if mpe-Reporting-FR2 is configured for the MAC entity this Serving Cell belongs to and this Serving Cell operates on FR2:
B2625: 8>obtain the value for the corresponding MPE field for the PUSCH transmission associated to the first TCI-State or TCI-UL-State from the physical layer.
B2626: 6>else if the second TCI-State or TCI-UL-State is applied for a real PUSCH transmission at the slot where the PHR MAC CE is transmitted:
B2627: 7>obtain the value for the PCMAX,f,c field for the PUSCH transmission associated to the second TCI-State or TCI-UL-State from the physical layer.
B2628: 7>if mpe-Reporting-FR2 is configured for the MAC entity this Serving Cell belongs to and this Serving Cell operates on FR2:
B2629: 8>obtain the value for the corresponding MPE field for the PUSCH transmission associated to the second TCI-State or TCI-UL-State from the physical layer.
B2630: 5>else:
B2631: 6>if this MAC entity has UL resources allocated for transmission on this Serving Cell; or
B2632: 6>if the other MAC entity, if configured, has UL resources allocated for transmission on this Serving Cell and phr-ModeOtherCG is set to real by upper layers:
B2633: 7>obtain the value for the corresponding PCMAX,f,c field from the physical layer.
B2634: 7>if mpe-Reporting-FR2 is configured and this Serving Cell operates on FR2 and this Serving Cell is associated to this MAC entity:
B2635: 8>obtain the value for the corresponding MPE field from the physical layer.
B2636: 7>if mpe-Reporting-FR2-r17 is configured and this Serving Cell operates on FR2 and this Serving Cell is associated to this MAC entity:
B2637: 8>obtain the value for the corresponding MPEi field from the physical layer;
B2638: 8>obtain the value for the corresponding Resourcei field from the physical layer.
B2639: 7>if dpc-Reporting-FR1 is configured and ΔPPowerClass /ΔPPowerClass, CA/ΔPPowerClass, EN-DC/ΔPPowerClass, NR-DC reporting is triggered and this Serving Cell operates on FR1 and this Serving Cell is associated to this MAC entity:
B2640: 8>obtain the value for the corresponding DPC field(s) from the physical layer.
B2641: 3>if phr-Type2OtherCell with value true is configured:
B2642: 4>if the other MAC entity is E-UTRA MAC entity:
B2643: 5>obtain the value of the Type 2 power headroom for the SpCell of the other MAC entity (i.e. E-UTRA MAC entity);
B2644: 5>if phr-ModeOtherCG is set to real by upper layers:
B2645: 6>obtain the value for the corresponding PCMAX,f,c field for the SpCell of the other MAC entity (i.e. E-UTRA MAC entity) from the physical layer.
B2646: 3>if this MAC entity is configured with mpe-Reporting-FR2-r17:
B2647: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Enhanced Multiple entry PHR as defined in clause 6.1.3.49 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2648: 3>else if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode and any Serving Cell belonging to this MAC entity is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN:
B2650: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Enhanced Multiple Entry PHR for multiple TRP STx2P MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.82 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2651: 3>else if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode and any Serving Cell belonging to this MAC entity is configured with multiple TRP PUSCH repetition:
B2652: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Enhanced Multiple Entry PHR for multiple TRP MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.51 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2653: 3>else if this MAC entity is configured with phr-AssumedPUSCH-Reporting:
B2654: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Multiple Entry PHR with assumed PUSCH MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.79 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2655: 3>else:
B2656: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Multiple Entry PHR MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.9 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2657: 2>else (i.e. Single Entry PHR format is used):
B2658: 3>if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode for multiple TRP PUSCH repetition or multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN:
B2660: 4>obtain two values of the Type 1 power headroom from the physical layer for the corresponding uplink carrier of the PCell.
B2661: 3>else:
B2662: 4>obtain the value of the Type 1 power headroom from the physical layer for the corresponding uplink carrier of the PCell.
B2663: 3>if this MAC entity is configured with phr-AssumedPUSCH-Reporting:
B2664: 4>if dynamicTransformPrecoderFieldPresenceDCI-0-1-r18 or dynamicTransformPrecoderFieldPresenceDCI-0-2-r18 is set to enabled in the active BWP of this Serving Cell:
B2665: 5>obtain the value for the corresponding PCMAX,f,c field for assumed PUSCH from the physical layer, if available, as specified in clause 7.7 of TS 38.213 [6].
B2666: 3>if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode and if this Serving Cell is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN:
B2668: 4>obtain two values for the corresponding PCMAX,f,c,k fields from the physical layer.
B2669: 4>if mpe-Reporting-FR2 is configured and this Serving Cell operates on FR2 and this Serving Cell is associated to this MAC entity:
B2670: 5>obtain two values for the corresponding MPEk fields from the physical layer.
B2671: 3>else:
B2672: 4>obtain the value for the corresponding PCMAX,f,c field from the physical layer;
B2673: 4>if mpe-Reporting-FR2 is configured and this Serving Cell operates on FR2:
B2674: 5>obtain the value for the corresponding MPE field from the physical layer.
B2675: 4>if mpe-Reporting-FR2-r17 is configured and this Serving Cell operates on FR2 and this Serving Cell is associated to this MAC entity:
B2676: 5>obtain the value for the corresponding MPEi field from the physical layer;
B2677: 5>obtain the value for the corresponding Resourcei field from the physical layer.
B2678: 4>if dpc-Reporting-FR1 is configured and this Serving Cell operates on FR1:
B2679: 5>obtain the value for the corresponding DPC field from the physical layer.
B2680: 3>if this MAC entity is configured with mpe-Reporting-FR2-r17:
B2681: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Enhanced Single entry PHR as defined in clause 6.1.3.48 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2682: 3>else if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode and this Serving Cell is configured with multipanelSchemeSDM or multipanelSchemeSFN:
B2684: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Enhanced Single Entry PHR for multiple TRP STx2P MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.81 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2685: 3>else if this MAC entity is configured with twoPHRMode and this Serving Cell is configured with multiple TRP PUSCH repetition:
B2686: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Enhanced Single Entry PHR for multiple TRP MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.50 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2687: 3>else if this MAC entity is configured with phr-AssumedPUSCH-Reporting:
B2688: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Single Entry PHR with assumed PUSCH MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.78 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2689: 3>else:
B2690: 4>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate and transmit the Single Entry PHR MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.8 based on the values reported by the physical layer.
B2691: 2>if this PHR report is an MPE P-MPR report:
B2692: 3>start or restart the mpe-ProhibitTimer;
B2693: 3>cancel triggered MPE P-MPR reporting for Serving Cells included in the PHR MAC CE.
B2694: 2>start or restart phr-PeriodicTimer;
B2695: 2>start or restart phr-ProhibitTimer;
B2696: 2>cancel all triggered PHR(s).
B2697: All triggered PHRs shall be cancelled when there is an ongoing SDT procedure as in clause 5.27 and the UL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data available for transmission but is not sufficient to additionally accommodate the PHR MAC CE plus its subheader.
B2698: 5.4.7Pre-emptive Buffer Status Reporting
B2699: The Pre-emptive Buffer Status reporting (Pre-emptive BSR) procedure is used by an IAB-MT to provide its parent IAB-DU(s) or IAB-donor-DU(s) with the information about the amount of the data expected to arrive at the IAB-MT from its child node(s) and/or UE(s) connected to it.
B2700: If configured, Pre-emptive BSR may be triggered for the specific case of an IAB-MT if any of the following events occur:
B2701: -UL grant is provided to child IAB node or UE;
B2702: -BSR is received from child IAB node or UE.
B2703: IAB-MT may report Extended Pre-emptive BSR (as defined in clause 6.1.3.1) if the MAC entity of the IAB-MT is configured with logicalChannelGroupIAB-Ext by upper layers. Otherwise IAB-MT may report Pre-emptive BSR (as defined in clause 6.1.3.1).
B2704: The MAC entity shall:
B2705: 1>if the Pre-emptive Buffer Status reporting procedure determines that at least one Pre-emptive BSR has been triggered and not cancelled:
B2706: 2>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the Extended Pre-emptive BSR or Pre-emptive BSR MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B2707: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Extended Pre-emptive BSR or Pre-emptive BSR MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.1.
B2708: 2>else:
B2709: 3>trigger a Scheduling Request.
B2710: A MAC PDU shall contain at most one Pre-emptive BSR MAC CE or Extended Pre-emptive BSR MAC CE, even when multiple events have triggered a Pre-emptive BSR.
B2711: All triggered Pre-emptive BSR(s) shall be cancelled when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes the corresponding Pre-emptive BSR MAC CE or Extended Pre-emptive BSR MAC CE.
B2712: NOTE:Pre-emptive BSR may be used for the case of dual-connected IAB node. It is up to network implementation to work out the associated MAC entity or entities which report the Pre-emptive BSR, and the associated expected amount of data reported by any such entity or entities. For the case of dual-connected IAB node, if two ingress BH RLC channels belonging to the same ingress LCG are mapped to two different egress Cell Groups (corresponding to different parent nodes), there may be ambiguity in Pre-emptive BSR calculations and interpretation by the receiving parent node(s) and the IAB node reporting pre-emptive BSR.
B2713: 5.4.8Timing Advance Reporting
B2714: The Timing Advance reporting procedure is used in a non-terrestrial network or an air to ground network to provide the gNB with an estimate of the UE's Timing Advance value (i.e., TTA as defined in the UE's TA formula, see TS 38.211 [8] clause 4.3.1).
B2715: RRC controls Timing Advance reporting by configuring the following parameters:
B2716: -offsetThresholdTA;
B2717: -timingAdvanceSR.
B2718: A Timing Advance report (TAR) shall be triggered if any of the following events occur:
B2719: -upon indication from upper layers to trigger a Timing Advance report;
B2720: -upon configuration of offsetThresholdTA by upper layers, if the UE has not previously reported Timing Advance value to current Serving Cell;
B2721: -if the variation between the current estimate of the Timing Advance value and the last reported Timing Advance value is equal to or larger than offsetThresholdTA, if configured.
B2722: The MAC entity shall:
B2723: 1>if the Timing Advance reporting procedure determines that at least one TAR has been triggered and not cancelled:
B2724: 2>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the Timing Advance Report MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B2725: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Timing Advance Report MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.56.
B2726: 2>else
B2727: 3>if timingAdvanceSR is configured with value enabled:
B2728: 4>trigger a Scheduling Request.
B2729: NOTE:UL-SCH resources are considered available if the MAC entity has been configured with, receives, or determines an uplink grant. If the MAC entity has determined at a given point in time that UL-SCH resources are available, this need not imply that UL-SCH resources are available for use at that point in time.
B2730: A MAC PDU shall contain at most one Timing Advance Report MAC CE, even when multiple events have triggered a Timing Advance report. The Timing Advance Report MAC CE shall be generated based on the latest available estimate of the UE's Timing Advance value prior to the MAC PDU assembly.
B2731: All triggered Timing Advance reports shall be cancelled when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes a Timing Advance Report MAC CE.
B2732: 5.4.9Delay status reporting
B2733: The Delay Status Report (DSR) is used to provide the serving gNB with delay status of LCGs. RRC controls the DSR procedure by configuring the following parameters per LCG:
B2734: -remainingTimeThreshold: the threshold on remaining time for triggering a DSR for a logical channel within an LCG. It is also used for reporting the amount of UL data buffered in an LCG in the Single Entry DSR MAC CE;
B2735: -dsr-ReportingThresList: the list of thresholds on remaining time for reporting the amount of UL data buffered in an LCG that is associated with these thresholds in the Multiple Entry DSR MAC CE.
B2736: The delay status for an LCG is evaluated and reported based on remaining time, which is the remaining value of the running PDCP discardTimer of an PDCP SDU as specified in clause 7.3 in TS 38.323 [4]. The delay status for an LCG also includes the amount of delay-critical UL data or delay-reporting UL data for the LCG, depending on whether the LCG is configured with dsr-ReportingThresList (see clause 6.1.3.72). The reported amount of UL data is calculated according to the data volume calculation procedure specified in clause 5.5 in TS 38.322 [3] and clause 5.15 in TS 38.323 [4] for the associated RLC and PDCP entities, respectively.
B2737: If an LCG is configured for delay status reporting, the MAC entity shall for each logical channel within the LCG:
B2738: 1>if the smallest remaining value of the running PDCP discardTimers among all the PDCP SDUs buffered for the logical channel that have not been transmitted in MAC PDU(s) and have not been reported as data volume in a DSR MAC CE becomes below remainingTimeThreshold of the LCG; and
B2739: 1>if there is no DSR pending for the logical channel:
B2740: 2>trigger a DSR for the logical channel.
B2741: If there is at least one DSR pending, the MAC entity shall:
B2742: 1>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission:
B2743: 2>if at least one LCG is configured with dsr-ReportingThresList and the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the Multiple Entry DSR MAC CE as specified in clause 6.1.3.72 plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B2744: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Multiple Entry DSR MAC CE as specified in clause 6.1.3.72.
B2745: 2>else if none of the LCG(s) is configured with dsr-ReportingThresList and the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the Single Entry DSR MAC CE as specified in clause 6.1.3.72 plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B2746: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Single Entry DSR MAC CE as specified in clause 6.1.3.72.
B2747: 2>else if there is no pending SR already triggered by the DSR procedure for the same logical channel as of this DSR:
B2748: 3>trigger a Scheduling Request.
B2749: 1>else if there is no pending SR already triggered by the DSR procedure for the same logical channel as of this DSR:
B2750: 2>trigger a Scheduling Request.
B2751: NOTE 1:The availability of UL-SCH resources for the transmission of a DSR MAC CE follows the same criteria specified in clause 5.4.5.
B2752: A PDCP SDU is considered to be associated with a DSR if it has not been transmitted in MAC PDU(s) and is a delay-critical PDCP SDU (as defined in TS 38.323 [4]) associated with the logical channel which triggered the DSR.
B2753: A MAC PDU shall contain at most one DSR MAC CE. A MAC PDU shall not contain any DSR MAC CE if it includes all PDCP SDUs associated with all the pending DSRs.
B2754: After a DSR is triggered, it is considered as pending until it is cancelled. The MAC entity shall cancel a pending DSR, when all the PDCP SDUs associated with the DSR have been discarded, or when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this MAC PDU includes a DSR MAC CE that contains the delay information of all the PDCP SDUs associated with the DSR (as described in the clause 6.1.3.72), or when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this MAC PDU includes all the PDCP SDUs associated with the DSR.
B2755: NOTE 2:It is up to UE implementation whether the MAC entity includes a DSR MAC CE in a MAC PDU if the MAC PDU can accommodate all PDCP SDUs associated with all the pending DSRs but is not sufficient to additionally accommodate this DSR MAC CE plus its subheader.
B2756: NOTE 3:For DSR, a PDCP SDU is not considered to have been transmitted in MAC PDU(s) if at least one of its segments has not been transmitted in any MAC PDU.
B2757: 5.5PCH reception
B2758: When the MAC entity needs to receive PCH, the MAC entity shall:
B2759: 1>if a PCH assignment has been received on the PDCCH for the P-RNTI:
B2760: 2>attempt to decode the TB on the PCH as indicated by the PDCCH information;
B2761: 2>if the TB on the PCH has been successfully decoded:
B2762: 3>deliver the decoded MAC PDU to upper layers.
B2763: 5.6BCH reception
B2764: When the MAC entity needs to receive BCH, the MAC entity shall:
B2765: 1>receive and attempt to decode the BCH;
B2766: 1>if a TB on the BCH has been successfully decoded:
B2767: 2>deliver the decoded MAC PDU to upper layers.
B2768: 5.7Discontinuous Reception (DRX)
B2769: The MAC entity may be configured by RRC with a DRX functionality that controls the UE's PDCCH monitoring activity for the MAC entity's C-RNTI, CI-RNTI, CS-RNTI, INT-RNTI, SFI-RNTI, SP-CSI-RNTI, TPC-PUCCH-RNTI, TPC-PUSCH-RNTI, TPC-SRS-RNTI, AI-RNTI, SL-RNTI, SL-CS-RNTI, SL-PRS-RNTI, SL-PRS-CS-RNTI, SL Semi-Persistent Scheduling V-RNTI, cellDTRX-RNTI, and adapt-SSB-PeriodicityIndication-RNTI. When using DRX operation, the MAC entity shall also monitor PDCCH according to requirements found in other clauses of this specification. When in RRC_CONNECTED, if DRX is configured, for all the activated Serving Cells, the MAC entity may monitor the PDCCH discontinuously using the DRX operation specified in this clause; otherwise the MAC entity shall monitor the PDCCH as specified in TS 38.213 [6].
B2770: NOTE 1:Void
B2771: RRC controls DRX operation by configuring the following parameters:
B2772: -drx-onDurationTimer: the duration at the beginning of a DRX cycle;
B2773: -drx-SlotOffset: the delay before starting the drx-onDurationTimer;
B2774: -drx-InactivityTimer: the duration after the PDCCH occasion in which a PDCCH indicates a new UL, DL or SL transmission for the MAC entity;
B2775: -drx-RetransmissionTimerDL (per DL HARQ process except for the broadcast process): the maximum duration until a DL retransmission is received;
B2776: -drx-RetransmissionTimerUL (per UL HARQ process): the maximum duration until a grant for UL retransmission is received;
B2777: -drx-LongCycleStartOffset: the Long DRX cycle and drx-StartOffset which defines the subframe where the Long and Short DRX cycle starts;
B2778: -drx-NonIntegerLongCycleStartOffset (optional): the Long DRX cycle and drx-StartOffset which defines the subframe where the Long and Short DRX cycle start, when the length of the Long DRX cycle and/or the short DRX cycle is not an integer;
B2779: -drx-ShortCycle (optional): the Short DRX cycle;
B2780: -drx-NonIntegerShortCycle (optional): the Short DRX cycle whose length is not an integer;
B2781: -drx-ShortCycleTimer (optional): the duration the UE shall follow the Short DRX cycle;
B2782: -drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL (per DL HARQ process except for the broadcast process): the minimum duration before a DL assignment for HARQ retransmission is expected by the MAC entity;
B2783: -drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL (per UL HARQ process): the minimum duration before a UL HARQ retransmission grant is expected by the MAC entity;
B2784: -drx-RetransmissionTimerSL (per sidelink process): the maximum duration until a grant for SL retransmission is received;
B2785: -drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerSL (per sidelink process): the minimum duration before an SL retransmission grant is expected by the MAC entity;
B2786: -drx-LastTransmissionUL (optional): the configuration to start drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL after the last transmission within a bundle;
B2787: -ps-Wakeup (optional): the configuration to start associated drx-onDurationTimer in case DCP is monitored but not detected;
B2788: -ps-TransmitOtherPeriodicCSI (optional): the configuration to report periodic CSI that is not L1-RSRP on PUCCH during the time duration indicated by drx-onDurationTimer in case DCP is configured but associated drx-onDurationTimer is not started;
B2789: -ps-TransmitPeriodicL1-RSRP (optional): the configuration to transmit periodic CSI that is L1-RSRP on PUCCH during the time duration indicated by drx-onDurationTimer in case DCP is configured but associated drx-onDurationTimer is not started;
B2790: -downlinkHARQ-FeedbackDisabled (optional): the configuration to disable HARQ feedback per DL HARQ process;
B2791: -uplinkHARQ-Mode (optional): the configuration to set HARQmodeA or HARQmodeB per UL HARQ process;
B2792: -disableCG-RetransmissionMonitoring (optional): the configuration to disable starting drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL for UL transmission over a configured uplink grant;
B2793: -drx-TimeReferenceSFN (optional): the configuration to indicate how UE initializes of DRX_SFN_COUNTER;
B2794: -lpwus-TransmitOtherPeriodicCSI (optional): the configuration to report periodic CSI that is not L1-RSRP on PUCCH during the time duration indicated by drx-onDurationTimer in case LP-WUS is configured but associated drx-onDurationTimer is not started;
B2795: -lpwus-TransmitPeriodicL1-RSRP (optional): the configuration to transmit periodic CSI that is L1-RSRP on PUCCH during the time duration indicated by drx-onDurationTimer in case LP-WUS is configured but associated drx-onDurationTimer is not started;
B2796: -lpwus-PDCCH-MonitoringTimer (optional): the duration after receiving the LP-WUS indication.
B2797: The following UE variable is used for the DRX operation if drx-NonIntegerLongCycleStartOffset is configured:
B2798: -DRX_SFN_COUNTER: the counter that increments when SFN changes to 0. The maximum value of this counter is at least 65535.
B2799: Serving Cells of a MAC entity may be configured by RRC in two DRX groups with separate DRX parameters. When RRC does not configure a secondary DRX group, there is only one DRX group and all Serving Cells belong to that one DRX group. When two DRX groups are configured, each Serving Cell is uniquely assigned to either of the two groups. The DRX parameters that are separately configured for each DRX group are: drx-onDurationTimer, drx-InactivityTimer. The DRX parameters that are common to the DRX groups are: drx-SlotOffset, drx-RetransmissionTimerDL, drx-RetransmissionTimerUL, drx-LongCycleStartOffset, drx-NonIntegerLongCycleStartOffset, drx-ShortCycle (optional), drx-NonIntegerShortCycle (optional), drx-ShortCycleTimer (optional), drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL, and drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL.
B2800: When DRX is configured, the Active Time for Serving Cells in a DRX group includes the time while:
B2801: -drx-onDurationTimer, drx-InactivityTimer or lpwus-PDCCH-MonitoringTimer configured for the DRX group is running; or
B2802: -drx-RetransmissionTimerDL, drx-RetransmissionTimerUL or drx-RetransmissionTimerSL is running on any Serving Cell in the DRX group; or
B2803: -ra-ContentionResolutionTimer (as described in clause 5.1.5) or msgB-ResponseWindow (as described in clause 5.1.4a) is running; or
B2804: -a Scheduling Request is sent on PUCCH and is pending (as described in clause 5.4.4 or 5.22.1.5). If this Serving Cell is part of a non-terrestrial network, the Active Time is started after the Scheduling Request transmission that is performed when the SR_COUNTER is 0 for all the SR configurations with pending SR(s) plus the UE-gNB RTT; or
B2805: -a PDCCH indicating a new transmission addressed to the C-RNTI of the MAC entity has not been received after successful reception of a Random Access Response for the Random Access Preamble not selected by the MAC entity among the contention-based Random Access Preamble (as described in clauses 5.1.4 and 5.1.4a); or
B2806: -there is an ongoing RACH-less LTM cell switch; or
B2807: -there is an ongoing RACH-less handover in a terrestrial network; or
B2808: -a PDCCH scheduling a mode-A UE-initiated CSI report on PUSCH has not been received after transmitting the corresponding UE Initiated Report Indication on PUCCH (as specified in TS 38.214 [7]) and before the next PUCCH occasion for the same CSI report.
B2809: The following MAC timers are used for DRX operation in a non-terrestrial network:
B2810: -HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-NTN (per DL HARQ process configured with HARQ feedback enabled): the minimum duration before a DL assignment for HARQ retransmission is expected by the MAC entity;
B2811: -HARQ-RTT-TimerUL-NTN (per UL HARQ process configured with HARQModeA): the minimum duration before a UL HARQ retransmission grant is expected by the MAC entity.
B2812: When DRX is not configured and multicast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI, the MAC entity shall:
B2813: 1>monitor the PDCCH as specified in TS 38.213 [6];
B2814: 1>if a MAC PDU is received in a configured downlink assignment for unicast; or
B2815: 1>if the PDCCH indicates a DL unicast transmission:
B2816: 2>stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM for the corresponding HARQ process.
B2817: When DRX is configured, the MAC entity shall:
B2818: 1>if a MAC PDU is received in a configured downlink assignment for unicast:
B2819: 2>if this Serving Cell is configured with downlinkHARQ-FeedbackDisabled:
B2820: 3>if the corresponding HARQ process is configured with HARQ feedback enabled:
B2821: 4>set HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-NTN for the corresponding HARQ process equal to drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL plus the latest available UE-gNB RTT value;
B2822: 4>start the HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-NTN for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the corresponding transmission carrying the DL HARQ feedback.
B2823: 2>else:
B2824: 3>start the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the corresponding transmission carrying the DL HARQ feedback.
B2825: NOTE 1a:Void.
B2826: NOTE 1b:Void.
B2827: 2>stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL for the corresponding HARQ process;
B2828: 2>stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM for the corresponding HARQ process.
B2829: 1>if a MAC PDU is transmitted in a configured uplink grant and LBT failure indication is not received from lower layers:
B2830: 2>if this Serving Cell is configured with uplinkHARQ-Mode:
B2831: 3>if the corresponding HARQ process is configured as HARQModeA:
B2832: 4>set HARQ-RTT-TimerUL-NTN for the corresponding HARQ process equal to drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL plus the latest available UE-gNB RTT value;
B2833: 4>if drx-LastTransmissionUL is configured:
B2834: 5>start the HARQ-RTT-TimerUL-NTN for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the last transmission (within a bundle) of the corresponding PUSCH transmission.
B2835: 4>else:
B2836: 5>start the HARQ-RTT-TimerUL-NTN for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the first transmission (within a bundle) of the corresponding PUSCH transmission.
B2837: 2>else:
B2838: 3>if disableCG-RetransmissionMonitoring is not configured for the configured uplink grant:
B2839: 4>if drx-LastTransmissionUL is configured:
B2840: 5>start the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the last transmission (within a bundle) of the corresponding PUSCH transmission.
B2841: 4>else:
B2842: 5>start the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the first transmission (within a bundle) of the corresponding PUSCH transmission.
B2843: 2>stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerUL for the corresponding HARQ process at the first transmission (within a bundle) of the corresponding PUSCH transmission.
B2844: 1>if a MAC PDU is transmitted in a configured sidelink grant:
B2845: 2>if the PUCCH resource is configured:
B2846: 3>start the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerSL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the corresponding PUCCH transmission carrying the SL HARQ feedback; or
B2847: 3>start the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerSL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the corresponding PUCCH resource for the SL HARQ feedback when the PUCCH is not transmitted;
B2848: 3>stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerSL for the corresponding HARQ process.
B2849: 2>else:

B2851: 3>stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerSL for the corresponding HARQ process.
B2852: 1>if a drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL expires:
B2853: 2>if the data of the corresponding HARQ process was not successfully decoded:
B2854: 3>start the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the expiry of drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL.

B2998: 5.7aDiscontinuous Reception (DRX) for MBS Broadcast
B2999: For MBS broadcast, the MAC entity may be configured by RRC with a DRX functionality per G-RNTI that controls the UE's PDCCH monitoring activity for the MAC entity's G-RNTI(s) as specified in TS 38.331 [5]. When in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_CONNECTED, if broadcast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI, the MAC entity is allowed to monitor the PDCCH for this G-RNTI discontinuously using the broadcast DRX operation specified in this clause; otherwise the MAC entity monitors each PDCCH for this G-RNTI as specified in TS 38.213 [6]. The broadcast DRX operation specified in this clause is performed independently for each G-RNTI and independently from the DRX operation specified in clauses 5.7 and 5.7b.
B3000: RRC controls broadcast DRX operation by configuring the following parameters:
B3001: -drx-onDurationTimerPTM: the duration at the beginning of a DRX cycle;
B3002: -drx-SlotOffsetPTM: the delay before starting the drx-onDurationTimerPTM;
B3003: -drx-InactivityTimerPTM: the duration after the PDCCH occasion in which a PDCCH indicates a new DL broadcast transmission for the MAC entity;
B3004: -drx-LongCycleStartOffsetPTM: the long DRX cycle drx-LongCycle-PTM and drx-StartOffset-PTM which defines the subframe where the DRX cycle starts.
B3005: When broadcast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI, the Active Time includes the time while:
B3006: -drx-onDurationTimerPTM or drx-InactivityTimerPTM for this G-RNTI is running.
B3007: When broadcast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI, the MAC entity shall for this G-RNTI:
B3008: 1>if [(SFN × 10) + subframe number] modulo (drx-LongCycle-PTM) = drx-StartOffset-PTM:
B3009: 2>start drx-onDurationTimerPTM after drx-SlotOffsetPTM from the beginning of the subframe.
B3010: 1>if the MAC entity is in Active Time for this G-RNTI:
B3011: 2>monitor the PDCCH for this G-RNTI as specified in TS 38.213 [6];
B3012: 2>if the PDCCH indicates a DL transmission for MBS broadcast:
B3013: 3>start or restart drx-InactivityTimerPTM in the first symbol after the end of the PDCCH reception.
B3014: NOTE:If a cell is configured for MBS broadcast reception, the SFN of this cell is used to calculate the DRX duration of MBS broadcast on this cell.
B3015: 5.7bDiscontinuous Reception (DRX) for MBS Multicast
B3016: For MBS multicast, the MAC entity may be configured by RRC with a DRX functionality per G-RNTI or per G-CS-RNTI that controls the UE's PDCCH monitoring activity for the MAC entity's G-RNTI(s) and G-CS-RNTI(s) as specified in TS 38.331 [5]. When in RRC_CONNECTED, if multicast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI, the MAC entity is allowed to monitor the PDCCH for this G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI discontinuously using the multicast DRX operation specified in this clause; otherwise the MAC entity monitors the PDCCH for this G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI as specified in TS 38.213 [6]. When in RRC_INACTIVE, if the UE is configured to receive multicast in RRC_INACTIVE and multicast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI, the MAC entity is allowed to monitor the PDCCH for this G-RNTI discontinuously using the multicast DRX operation specified in this clause; otherwise the MAC entity monitors the PDCCH for this G-RNTI as specified in TS 38.213 [6]. The multicast DRX operation specified in this clause is performed independently for each G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI and independently from the DRX operation specified in clauses 5.7 and 5.7a.
B3017: RRC controls multicast DRX operation per G-RNTI or per G-CS-RNTI by configuring the following parameters:
B3018: -drx-onDurationTimerPTM: the duration at the beginning of a DRX cycle;
B3019: -drx-SlotOffsetPTM: the delay before starting the drx-onDurationTimerPTM;
B3020: -drx-InactivityTimerPTM: the duration after the PDCCH occasion in which a PDCCH indicates a new DL multicast transmission for the MAC entity;
B3021: -drx-LongCycleStartOffsetPTM: the long DRX cycle drx-LongCycle-PTM and drx-StartOffset-PTM which defines the subframe where the long DRX cycle starts;
B3022: -drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM (per DL HARQ process for MBS multicast): the maximum duration until a DL multicast retransmission is received;
B3023: -drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-PTM (per DL HARQ process for MBS multicast): the minimum duration before a DL multicast assignment for HARQ retransmission is expected by the MAC entity.
B3024: The following MAC timer is used for DRX operation in a non-terrestrial network:
B3025: -HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-PTM-NTN (per DL HARQ process for MBS multicast): the minimum duration before a DL multicast assignment for HARQ retransmission is expected by the MAC entity.
B3026: When multicast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI, the Active Time includes the time while:
B3027: -drx-onDurationTimerPTM or drx-InactivityTimerPTM or drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM for this G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI is running.

B3031: 1>if a MAC PDU is received in a configured downlink multicast assignment:
B3032: 2>stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL for the corresponding HARQ process.

B3034: 1>if the PDCCH addressed to G-CS-RNTI indicates a DL multicast transmission and CS-RNTI is configured; or
B3035: 1>if a MAC PDU is received in a configured downlink multicast assignment and CS-RNTI is configured:
B3036: 2>if the first HARQ-ACK reporting mode (i.e. ack-nack) is used as specified in TS 38.213 [6]; and
B3037: 2>if HARQ feedback for MBS multicast is enabled:

B3043: When multicast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI, and the cfr-ConfigMulticast is configured for at least one of the active BWP(s) of the Serving Cell(s), or when multicast DRX is configured for a G-RNTI for multicast in RRC_INACTIVE, the MAC entity shall for this G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI:

B3045: 2>if HARQ feedback for MBS multicast is enabled:

B3055: 5>start the HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-NTN for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the corresponding transmission carrying the DL HARQ feedback.
B3056: 4>else:
B3057: 5>start the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the end of the corresponding transmission carrying the DL HARQ feedback.
B3058: 2>else if drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-PTM is configured:

B3071: 3>start the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the expiry of HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-PTM-NTN.
B3072: 1>if a DRX Command MAC CE indicated by PDCCH addressed to a G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI, or by a configured downlink multicast assignment is received:
B3073: 2>stop drx-onDurationTimerPTM of the DRX for this G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI, or the corresponding G-CS-RNTI;
B3074: 2>stop drx-InactivityTimerPTM of the DRX for this G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI, or the corresponding G-CS-RNTI.
B3075: 1>if [(SFN × 10) + subframe number] modulo (drx-LongCycle-PTM) = drx-StartOffset-PTM:

B3077: 1>if the MAC entity is in Active Time for this G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI:

B3087: 5>if the PDCCH addressed to G-RNTI indicates a DL multicast transmission; or

B3090: 7>set HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-NTN for the corresponding HARQ process equal to drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL plus the latest available UE-gNB RTT value;
