B3111: NOTE 2:The UE may start the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL or HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-NTN after receiving a PTM transmission only if ptp-Retx-Multicast or ptp-Retx-SPS-Multicast was included in the UECapabilityInformation message to network.
B3112: The MAC entity needs not to monitor the PDCCH for a G-RNTI or a G-CS-RNTI if it is not a complete PDCCH occasion (e.g. the Active Time for a G-RNTI or a G-CS-RNTI starts or ends in the middle of a PDCCH occasion).
B3113: 5.8Transmission and reception without dynamic scheduling
B3114: 5.8.1Downlink
B3115: Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) is configured by RRC for a Serving Cell per BWP. Multiple assignments can be active simultaneously in the same BWP. Activation and deactivation of the DL SPS are independent among the Serving Cells.
B3116: For the DL SPS, a DL assignment is provided by PDCCH, and stored or cleared based on L1 signalling indicating SPS activation or deactivation.
B3117: RRC configures the following parameters when the SPS is configured:
B3118: -cs-RNTI: CS-RNTI for activation, deactivation, and retransmission;
B3119: -nrofHARQ-Processes: the number of configured HARQ processes for SPS;
B3120: -harq-ProcID-Offset: Offset of HARQ process for SPS;
B3121: -periodicity: periodicity of configured downlink assignment for SPS.
B3122: When the SPS is released by upper layers, all the corresponding configurations shall be released.
B3123: After a downlink assignment is configured for SPS, the MAC entity shall consider sequentially that the Nth downlink assignment occurs in the slot for which:
B3124: (numberOfSlotsPerFrame × SFN + slot number in the frame) =[(numberOfSlotsPerFrame × SFNstart time + slotstart time) + N × periodicity × numberOfSlotsPerFrame / 10]modulo (1024 × numberOfSlotsPerFrame)
B3125: where SFNstart time and slotstart time are the SFN and slot, respectively, of the first transmission of PDSCH where the configured downlink assignment was (re-)initialised.
B3126: NOTE:In case of unaligned SFN across carriers in a cell group, the SFN of the concerned Serving Cell is used to calculate the occurrences of configured downlink assignments.
B3127: 5.8.1aDownlink for Multicast
B3128: MBS Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) is only applicable for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED and is configured by RRC on one Serving Cell per BWP. Multiple assignments can be active simultaneously in the same BWP.
B3129: For the DL MBS SPS, a DL assignment is provided by PDCCH, and stored or cleared based on L1 signalling indicating SPS activation or deactivation.
B3130: RRC configures the following parameters when the MBS SPS is configured:
B3131: -cs-RNTI: CS-RNTI for MBS SPS deactivation, PTP for PTM retransmission if configured;
B3132: -g-cs-RNTI: G-CS-RNTI for activation, deactivation, and retransmission;
B3133: -nrofHARQ-Processes: the number of configured HARQ processes for MBS SPS;
B3134: -harq-ProcID-Offset: Offset of HARQ process for MBS SPS;
B3135: -periodicity: periodicity of configured downlink assignment for MBS SPS.
B3136: When the MBS SPS is released by upper layers, all the corresponding configurations shall be released.
B3137: After a downlink assignment is configured for MBS SPS, the MAC entity shall consider sequentially that the Nth downlink assignment occurs in the slot for which:
B3138: (numberOfSlotsPerFrame × SFN + slot number in the frame) =[(numberOfSlotsPerFrame × SFNstart time + slotstart time) + N × periodicity × numberOfSlotsPerFrame / 10]modulo (1024 × numberOfSlotsPerFrame)
B3139: where SFNstart time and slotstart time are the SFN and slot, respectively, of the first transmission of PDSCH where the configured downlink assignment was (re-)initialised.
B3140: 5.8.2Uplink
B3141: There are two types of transmission without dynamic grant:
B3142: -configured grant Type 1 where an uplink grant is provided by RRC, and stored as configured uplink grant;
B3143: -configured grant Type 2 where an uplink grant is provided by PDCCH, and stored or cleared as configured uplink grant based on L1 signalling indicating configured uplink grant activation or deactivation.
B3144: Type 1 and Type 2 are configured by RRC for a Serving Cell per BWP. Multiple configurations can be active simultaneously in the same BWP. For Type 2, activation and deactivation are independent among the Serving Cells. For the same BWP, the MAC entity can be configured with both Type 1 and Type 2.
B3145: A multi-PUSCH configured grant has multiple consecutive configured uplink grants within a periodicity. Both Type 1 and Type 2 can be configured for a multi-PUSCH configured grant by RRC.
B3146: Only configured grant Type 1 can be configured for CG-SDT or for RACH-less LTM cell switch or for RACH-less handover. CG-SDT can only be configured on initial BWP.
B3147: The MAC entity shall not use the configured grant Type 1 for mode-B UE-initiated CSI reporting (configured in pusch-ResourceOfModeB-r19) to generate MAC PDU for UL-SCH data transmission in the procedures specified in this clause and in clause 5.4.
B3148: RRC configures the following parameters when the configured grant Type 1 is configured:
B3149: -cs-RNTI: CS-RNTI for retransmission;
B3150: -cg-SDT-CS-RNTI: CS-RNTI for CG-SDT retransmission;
B3151: -cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB: an RSRP threshold configured for SSB selection for CG-SDT;
B3152: -cg-RRC-RSRP-ThresholdSSB: an RSRP threshold configured for SSB selection for RACH-less handover;
B3153: -periodicity: periodicity of the configured grant Type 1;
B3154: -timeDomainOffset: Offset of a resource with respect to SFN = timeReferenceSFN in time domain;
B3155: -timeDomainAllocation: Allocation of configured uplink grant in time domain which contains startSymbolAndLength (i.e. SLIV in TS 38.214 [7]) or startSymbol (i.e. S in TS 38.214 [7]);
B3156: -nrofHARQ-Processes: the number of HARQ processes for configured grant;
B3157: -harq-ProcID-Offset: offset of HARQ process for configured grant configured with cg-RetransmissionTimer for operation with shared spectrum channel access;
B3158: -harq-ProcID-Offset2: offset of HARQ process for configured grant not configured with cg-RetransmissionTimer;
B3159: -timeReferenceSFN: SFN used for determination of the offset of a resource in time domain. The UE uses the closest SFN with the indicated number preceding the reception of the configured grant configuration;
B3160: -timeReferenceHyperSFN: H-SFN used for determination of the offset of a resource in time domain. The UE uses the closest H-SFN with the indicated number preceding the reception of the configured grant configuration.
B3161: RRC configures the following parameters when the configured grant Type 2 is configured:
B3162: -cs-RNTI: CS-RNTI for activation, deactivation, and retransmission;
B3163: -periodicity: periodicity of the configured grant Type 2;
B3164: -nrofHARQ-Processes: the number of HARQ processes for configured grant;
B3165: -harq-ProcID-Offset: offset of HARQ process for configured grant configured with cg-RetransmissionTimer for operation with shared spectrum channel access;
B3166: -harq-ProcID-Offset2: offset of HARQ process for configured grant not configured with cg-RetransmissionTimer.
B3167: RRC configures the following parameter when retransmissions on configured uplink grant is configured:
B3168: -cg-RetransmissionTimer: the duration after a configured grant (re)transmission of a HARQ process when the UE shall not autonomously retransmit that HARQ process;
B3169: -cg-SDT-RetransmissionTimer: the duration after a configured grant (re)transmission of a HARQ process of the initial CG-SDT transmission with CCCH message when the UE shall not autonomously retransmit the HARQ process;
B3170: -cg-RRC-RetransmissionTimer: the duration after a configured grant (re)transmission of a HARQ process of the first PUSCH transmission of RACH-less handover and RACH-less LTM cell switch when the UE shall not autonomously retransmit the HARQ process.
B3171: RRC configures the following parameter when a multi-PUSCH configured grant is configured:
B3172: -nrofSlotsInCG-Period: the number of configured uplink grants in a periodicity of a multi-PUSCH configured grant.
B3173: RRC configures the following parameter when UTO-UCI (as specified in clause 9.3 in TS 38.213 [6]) is configured for a configured grant:
B3174: -nrofBitsInUTO-UCI: number of bits in a UTO-UCI bitmap.
B3175: For a configured uplink grant, the MAC entity shall:
B3176: 1>if its associated configured grant is configured with UTO-UCI and it has not been indicated to the lower layers as unused for PUSCH transmission; or
B3177: 1>if its associated configured grant is not configured with UTO-UCI:
B3178: 2>if it is associated with a multi-PUSCH configured grant and meets the validity conditions specified in the clause 6.1 in TS 38.214 [7]; or
B3179: 2>if it is not associated with a multi-PUSCH configured grant:
B3180: 3>consider it available for use.
B3181: The MAC entity shall not include the UL-SCH resource of a configured uplink grant not available for use in its procedures (e.g. in clauses 5.4.1 and 5.4.4).
B3182: For a configured grant configured with UTO-UCI, the MAC entity determines if a configured uplink grant which is within the subsequent nrofBitsInUTO-UCI valid occasions of its associated configured grant configuration is going to be used for PUSCH transmission by considering at least the amount of buffered data that can be transmitted on the available occasions of the associated configured grant and other available UL-SCH resources. Upon this determination, the MAC entity sends an indication to lower layers, for use in the procedure for reporting UTO-UCI.
B3183: Upon configuration of a configured grant Type 1 for a BWP of a Serving Cell by upper layers, the MAC entity shall:
B3184: 1>store the uplink grant provided by upper layers as a configured uplink grant for the indicated BWP of the Serving Cell;
B3185: 1>if cg-SDT-PeriodicityExt is configured:
B3186: 2>initialise or re-initialise the configured uplink grant to start in the symbol according to timeDomainOffset, timeReferenceHyperSFN, timeReferenceSFN, and S (derived from SLIV or provided by startSymbol as specified in TS 38.214 [7]), and to reoccur with cg-SDT-PeriodicityExt.
B3187: 1>else:
B3188: 2>initialise or re-initialise the configured uplink grant to start in the symbol according to timeDomainOffset, timeReferenceSFN, and S (derived from SLIV or provided by startSymbol as specified in TS 38.214 [7]), and to reoccur with periodicity.
B3189: If cg-SDT-PeriodicityExt (as defined in TS 38.331 [5]) is not configured, after an uplink grant is configured for a configured grant Type 1, the MAC entity shall consider sequentially that the configured uplink grant, or the first configured uplink grant in a multi-PUSCH configured grant, in the Nth (N ≥ 0) periodicity occurs in the symbol for which:
B3190: [(SFN × numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot)+ (slot number in the frame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot) + symbol number in the slot] =(timeReferenceSFN × numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot+ timeDomainOffset × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot + S + N × periodicity)modulo (1024 × numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot)
B3191: If cg-SDT-PeriodicityExt (as defined in TS 38.331 [5]) is configured, after an uplink grant is configured for a configured grant Type 1, the MAC entity shall consider sequentially that the configured uplink grant in the Nth (N ≥ 0) periodicity occurs in the symbol for which:
B3192: [(H-SFN × numberOfSFNperH-SFN + SFN) × numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot+ (slot number in the frame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot) + symbol number in the slot] =((timeReferenceHyperSFN × numberOfSFNperH-SFN + timeReferenceSFN)× numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot+ timeDomainOffset × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot + S + N × cg-SDT-PeriodicityExt)modulo (1024 × 1024 × numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot)
B3193: For a multi-PUSCH configured grant Type 1, the Mth (1 < M ≤ nrofSlotsInCG-Period) configured uplink grant within a periodicity occurs (M-1) × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot symbols after the symbol in which the first configured uplink grant in that periodicity occurs.
B3194: For an uplink grant configured for configured grant Type 1 for CG-SDT on the selected uplink carrier as in clause 5.27, when CG-SDT is triggered and not terminated, for each configured uplink grant valid according to TS 38.214 [7] for which the above formula is satisfied, the MAC entity shall:
B3195: 1>if, after initial transmission for CG-SDT with CCCH message has been performed according to clause 5.4.1, PDCCH addressed to the MAC entity's C-RNTI has not been received:
B3196: 2>if the SSB corresponding to the configured UL grant has the same SSB index as the SSB selected for initial transmission for CG-SDT with CCCH message (i.e., retransmission of initial transmission of CG-SDT):
B3197: 3>select this SSB;
B3198: 3>indicate the SSB index corresponding to the configured uplink grant to the lower layer;
B3199: 3>consider this configured uplink grant as valid.
B3200: 1>else if at least one SSB corresponding to the configured uplink grant with SS-RSRP above the cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB is available:
B3201: 2>if this is the initial transmission of CG-SDT with CCCH message after the CG-SDT procedure is initiated as in clause 5.27 (i.e., initial transmission for CG-SDT):
B3202: 3>select an SSB with SS-RSRP above cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB amongst the SSB(s) associated with the configured uplink grant.
B3203: 2>else if PDCCH addressed to C-RNTI has been received after the initial transmission of CG-SDT with CCCH message (i.e., subsequent new transmission for CG-SDT):
B3204: 3>if SS-RSRP of the SSB selected for the previous transmission for CG-SDT is above cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB and this SSB is associated with this configured uplink grant:
B3205: 4>select this SSB.
B3206: 3>else if SS-RSRP of the SSB selected for the previous transmission for CG-SDT is not above cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB:
B3207: 4>select an SSB with SS-RSRP above cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB amongst the SSB(s) associated with the configured uplink grant.
B3208: 2>if SSB is selected above:
B3209: 3>indicate the SSB index to the lower layer;
B3210: 3>consider this configured uplink grant as valid.
B3211: The MAC entity shall:
B3212: 1>if no SSB configured for CG-SDT with SS-RSRP above cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB is available:
B3213: 2>if PDCCH addressed to C-RNTI after the initial transmission of the CG-SDT with CCCH message has been received:
B3214: 3>if there is data available for transmission for at least one RB configured for SDT:
B3215: 4>initiate Random Access procedure in clause 5.1.
B3216: NOTE 1:Void.
B3217: For an uplink grant configured for configured grant Type 1 for RACH-less LTM cell switch, when there is an ongoing RACH-less LTM cell switch procedure, for each configured uplink grant valid according to TS 38.214 [7] for which the above formula is satisfied, the MAC entity shall:
B3218: 1>if an SSB corresponding to the configured UL grant has the same SSB index as the SSB associated with the TCI state indicated by the UL TCI state ID field, if present, or by the TCI state ID field otherwise, in the (Enhanced) LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE, as specified in clause 21.1 in TS 38.213 [6]:
B3219: 2>select the SSB associated with the TCI state indicated by (Enhanced) LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE.
B3220: 2>indicate the SSB index to the lower layer;
B3221: 2>consider this configured uplink grant as valid.
B3222: 1>if an SSB corresponding to the configured UL grant has the same SSB index as the selected SSB or the SSB associated with the selected CSI-RS according to 5.36.3, as specified in clause 21.1 in TS 38.213 [6]:
B3223: 2>indicate the SSB index to the lower layer;
B3224: 2>consider this configured uplink grant as valid.
B3225: 1>else:
B3226: 2>consider this configured uplink grant as not valid.
B3227: NOTE 1a:When there is an ongoing RACH-less LTM cell switch, the configured grant Type 1 which is not specifically configured for LTM (see cg-LTM-Configuration in TS 38.331 [5]) is not used.
B3228: NOTE 1b:After completion of LTM cell switch, the UE stops using the grant configured for RACH-less LTM cell switch (see cg-LTM-Configuration in TS 38.331 [5]).
B3229: For the uplink grant configured for configured grant Type 1 for RACH-less handover, if the configured uplink grant is valid according to TS 38.214 [7] for which the above formula is satisfied and RACH-less handover is not successfully completed, the MAC entity shall:
B3230: 1>if the first PUSCH transmission of RACH-less handover has been performed according to clause 5.4.1 and 5.33:
B3231: 2>if the SSB corresponding to the configured UL grant has the same SSB index as the SSB selected for the first PUSCH transmission of RACH-less handover (i.e., retransmission of the first PUSCH transmission of RACH-less handover):
B3232: 3>select this SSB;
B3233: 3>indicate the SSB index corresponding to the configured uplink grant to the lower layer;
B3234: 3>consider this configured uplink grant as valid.
B3235: 1>else if at least one SSB corresponding to the configured uplink grant with SS-RSRP above cg-RRC-RSRP-ThresholdSSB is available:
B3236: 2>select an SSB with SS-RSRP above cg-RRC-RSRP-ThresholdSSB amongst the SSB(s) associated with the configured uplink grant;
B3237: 2>indicate the selected SSB index to the lower layer;
B3238: 2>consider this configured uplink grant as valid.
B3239: The MAC entity shall:
B3240: 1>if no SSB configured for RACH-less handover with SS-RSRP above cg-RRC-RSRP-ThresholdSSB is available:
B3241: 2>initiate Random Access procedure in clause 5.1.
B3242: NOTE 1A:When the UE determines if there is an SSB with SS-RSRP above cg-RRC-RSRP-ThresholdSSB or cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB, the UE uses the latest unfiltered L1-RSRP measurement.
B3243: After an uplink grant is configured for a configured grant Type 2, the MAC entity shall consider sequentially that the configured uplink grant, or the first configured uplink grant in a multi-PUSCH configured grant, in the Nth (N ≥ 0) periodicity occurs in the symbol for which:
B3244: [(SFN × numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot)+ (slot number in the frame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot) + symbol number in the slot] =[(SFNstart time × numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot+ slotstart time × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot + symbolstart time) + N × periodicity]modulo (1024 × numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot)
B3245: where SFNstart time, slotstart time, and symbolstart time are the SFN, slot, and symbol, respectively, of the first transmission opportunity of PUSCH where the configured uplink grant was (re-)initialised.
B3246: For a multi-PUSCH configured grant Type 2, the Mth (1 < M ≤ nrofSlotsInCG-Period) configured uplink grant within the same periodicity occurs (M-1) × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot symbols after the symbol in which the first configured uplink grant in that periodicity occurs.
B3247: If cg-nrofPUSCH-InSlot or cg-nrofSlots is configured for a configured grant Type 1 or Type 2, the MAC entity shall consider the uplink grants occur in those additional PUSCH allocations as specified in clause 6.1.2.3 of TS 38.214 [7].
B3248: NOTE 2:In case of unaligned SFN across carriers in a cell group, the SFN of the concerned Serving Cell is used to calculate the occurrences of configured uplink grants.
B3249: When the configured uplink grant is released by upper layers, all the corresponding configurations shall be released and all corresponding uplink grants shall be cleared.
B3250: The MAC entity shall:
B3251: 1>if at least one configured uplink grant confirmation has been triggered and not cancelled; and
B3252: 1>if the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission:
B3253: 2>if, in this MAC entity, at least one configured uplink grant is configured by configuredGrantConfigToAddModList:
B3254: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate a Multiple Entry Configured Grant Confirmation MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.31.
B3255: 2>else:
B3256: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate a Configured Grant Confirmation MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.7.
B3257: 2>cancel all triggered configured uplink grant confirmation(s).
B3258: For a configured grant Type 2, the MAC entity shall clear the configured uplink grant(s) immediately after first transmission of Configured Grant Confirmation MAC CE or Multiple Entry Configured Grant Confirmation MAC CE which confirms the configured uplink grant deactivation.
B3259: Retransmissions use:
B3260: -repetition of configured uplink grants; or
B3261: -received uplink grants addressed to CS-RNTI; or
B3262: -configured uplink grants with cg-RetransmissionTimer, cg-RRC-RetransmissionTimer or cg-SDT-RetransmissionTimer configured.
B3263: 5.8.3Sidelink
B3264: There are two types of transmission without dynamic sidelink grant:
B3265: -configured grant Type 1 where an sidelink grant is provided by RRC, and stored as configured sidelink grant;
B3266: -configured grant Type 2 where an sidelink grant is provided by PDCCH, and stored or cleared as configured sidelink grant based on L1 signalling indicating configured sidelink grant activation or deactivation.
B3267: Type 1 and/or Type 2 are configured with a single BWP. Multiple configurations of up to 8 configured grants (including both Type 1 and Type 2, if configured) can be active simultaneously on the BWP.
B3268: RRC configures the following parameters when the configured grant Type 1 is configured, as specified in TS 38.331 [5] or TS 36.331 [21]:
B3269: -sl-ConfigIndexCG/sl-PRS-ConfigIndexCG: the identifier of a configured grant for sidelink;
B3270: -sl-CS-RNTI: SL-CS-RNTI for retransmission;
B3271: -sl-NrOfHARQ-Processes: the number of HARQ processes for configured grant;
B3272: -sl-PeriodCG/sl-PRS-PeriodCG: periodicity of the configured grant Type 1;
B3273: -sl-TimeOffsetCG-Type1: Offset of a resource with respect to reference logical slot defined by sl-TimeReferenceSFN-Type1 in time domain, referring to the number of logical slots in a resource pool;
B3274: -sl-TimeResourceCG-Type1: time resource location of the configured grant Type 1;
B3275: -sl-CG-MaxTransNumList: the maximum number of times that a TB can be transmitted using the configured grant;
B3276: -sl-HARQ-ProcID-offset: offset of HARQ process for configured grant Type 1;
B3277: -sl-TimeReferenceSFN-Type1: SFN used for determination of the offset of a resource in time domain. If it is present, the UE uses the first logical slot of associated resource pool after the starting time of the closest SFN with the indicated number preceding the reception of the sidelink configured grant configuration Type 1 as reference logical slot. If it is absent, the indicated reference SFN is zero.
B3278: RRC configures the following parameters when the configured grant Type 2 is configured, as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B3279: -sl-ConfigIndexCG/sl-PRS-ConfigIndexCG: the identifier of a configured grant for sidelink;
B3280: -sl-CS-RNTI: SL-CS-RNTI for activation, deactivation, and retransmission;
B3281: -sl-PRS-CS-RNTI: SL-PRS-CS-RNTI for activation, and deactivation;
B3282: -sl-NrOfHARQ-Processes: the number of HARQ processes for configured grant;
B3283: -sl-PeriodCG/sl-PRS-PeriodCG: periodicity of the configured grant Type 2;
B3284: -sl-CG-MaxTransNumList: the maximum number of times that a TB can be transmitted using the configured grant;
B3285: -sl-HARQ-ProcID-offset: offset of HARQ process for configured grant Type 2.
B3286: Upon configuration of a configured grant Type 1, the MAC entity shall for each configured sidelink grant:
B3287: 1>store the sidelink grant provided by RRC as a configured sidelink grant;
B3288: 1>if the configured sidelink grant is not on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool:
B3289: 2>initialise or re-initialise the configured sidelink grant to determine PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) and SL-PRS transmission occasion(s), if available, according to sl-TimeOffsetCG-Type1 and sl-TimeResourceCG-Type1, and to reoccur with sl-periodCG for transmissions of multiple MAC PDUs and SL-PRS(s) according to clause 8.1.2 of TS 38.214 [7].
B3290: 1>if the configured sidelink grant is on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool:
B3291: 2>initialise or re-initialise the configured sidelink grant to determine PSCCH duration(s) and SL-PRS transmission occasion(s) according to sl-TimeOffsetCG-Type1 and sl-TimeResourceCG-Type1, and to reoccur with sl-PRS-periodCG for transmissions of multiple SL-PRS(s) according to clause 8.2.4 of TS 38.214 [7].
B3292: NOTE 1:If the MAC entity is configured with multiple configured sidelink grants, collision among the configured sidelink grants may occur. How to handle the collision is left to UE implementation.
B3293: After a sidelink grant is configured for a configured grant Type 1, the MAC entity shall consider sequentially that the first slot of the Sth sidelink grant occurs in the logical slot for which:
B3294: CURRENT_slot = (sl-ReferenceSlotCG-Type1 + sl-TimeOffsetCG-Type1 + S × PeriodicitySL) modulo T'max
B3295: where CURRENT_slot refers to current logical slot in the associated resource pool, or  and T'max is the number of slots that belongs to the associated resource pool as defined in clause 8 of TS 38.214[7]. sl-ReferenceSlotCG-Type1 refers to reference logical slot defined by sl-TimeReferenceSFN-Type1.
B3297: After a sidelink grant is configured for a configured grant Type 2, the MAC entity shall consider sequentially that the first slot of Sth sidelink grant occurs in the logical slot for which:
B3298: CURRENT_slot = (sl-StartSlotCG-Type2 + S × PeriodicitySL) modulo T'max
B3299: where sl-StartSlotCG-Type2 refers to the logical slot of the first transmission opportunity of PSSCH or SL-PRS where the configured sidelink grant was (re)initialised.
B3300: When a configured sidelink grant is released by RRC, all the corresponding configurations shall be released and all corresponding sidelink grants shall be cleared.
B3301: The MAC entity shall:
B3302: 1>if the configured sidelink grant confirmation has been triggered and not cancelled; and
B3303: 1>if the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission:
B3304: 2>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate a Sidelink Configured Grant Confirmation MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.34;
B3305: 2>cancel the triggered configured sidelink grant confirmation.
B3306: For a configured grant Type 2, the MAC entity shall clear the corresponding configured sidelink grant immediately after first transmission of Sidelink Configured Grant Confirmation MAC CE triggered by the configured sidelink grant deactivation.
B3307: 5.9Activation/Deactivation of SCells
B3308: If the MAC entity is configured with one or more SCells, the network may activate and deactivate the configured SCells. Upon configuration of an SCell, the SCell is deactivated unless the parameter sCellState is set to activated for the SCell by upper layers.
B3309: The configured SCell(s) is activated and deactivated by:
B3310: -receiving the SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.10;
B3311: -receiving the Enhanced SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.55;
B3312: -configuring sCellDeactivationTimer timer per configured SCell (except the SCell configured with PUCCH, if any): the associated SCell is deactivated upon its expiry;
B3313: -configuring sCellState per configured SCell: if configured, the associated SCell is activated upon SCell configuration;
B3314: -receiving scg-State: the SCells of SCG are deactivated.
B3315: The MAC entity shall for each configured SCell:
B3316: 1>if an SCell is configured with sCellState set to activated upon SCell configuration, or an SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE or an Enhanced SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is received activating the SCell:
B3317: 2>if the SCell was deactivated prior to receiving this Enhanced SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE and a TRS is indicated for this SCell:
B3318: 3>indicate to lower layers the information regarding the TRS.
B3319: 2>if the SCell was deactivated prior to receiving this SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE or this Enhanced SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE; or
B3320: 2>if the SCell is configured with sCellState set to activated upon SCell configuration:
B3321: 3>if firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id is not set to dormant BWP:
B3322: 4>activate the SCell according to the timing defined in TS 38.213 [6] for MAC CE activation and according to the timing defined in TS 38.133 [11] for direct SCell activation; i.e. apply normal SCell operation including:
B3323: 5>SRS transmissions on the SCell;
B3324: 5>CSI reporting for the SCell;
B3325: 5>CSI logging for the SCell, if configured;
B3326: 5>PDCCH monitoring on the SCell;
B3327: 5>PDCCH monitoring for the SCell;
B3328: 5>PUCCH transmissions on the SCell, if configured.
B3329: 3>else (i.e. firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id is set to dormant BWP):
B3330: 4>stop the bwp-InactivityTimer of this Serving Cell, if running.
B3331: 3>activate the DL BWP and UL BWP indicated by firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id and firstActiveUplinkBWP-Id respectively.
B3332: 2>start or restart the sCellDeactivationTimer associated with the SCell according to the timing defined in TS 38.213 [6] for MAC CE activation and according to the timing defined in TS 38.133 [11] for direct SCell activation;
B3333: 2>if the active DL BWP is not the dormant BWP:
B3334: 3>(re-)initialize any suspended configured uplink grants of configured grant Type 1 associated with this SCell according to the stored configuration, if any, and to start in the symbol according to rules in clause 5.8.2;
B3335: 3>trigger PHR according to clause 5.4.6.
B3336: 1>else if an SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE or an Enhanced SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is received deactivating the SCell; or
B3337: 1>if the sCellDeactivationTimer associated with the activated SCell expires; or
B3338: 1>if the SCG associated with the activated SCell is deactivated:
B3339: 2>deactivate the SCell according to the timing defined in TS 38.213 [6];
B3340: 2>stop the sCellDeactivationTimer associated with the SCell;
B3341: 2>stop the bwp-InactivityTimer associated with the SCell;
B3342: 2>deactivate any active BWP associated with the SCell;
B3343: 2>clear any configured downlink assignment and any configured uplink grant Type 2 associated with the SCell respectively;
B3344: 2>clear any PUSCH resource for semi-persistent CSI reporting associated with the SCell;
B3345: 2>suspend any configured uplink grant Type 1 associated with the SCell;
B3346: 2>flush all HARQ buffers associated with the SCell;
B3347: 2>cancel, if any, triggered consistent LBT failure for the SCell.
B3348: 1>if PDCCH on the activated SCell indicates an uplink grant or downlink assignment; or
B3349: 1>if PDCCH on the Serving Cell scheduling the activated SCell indicates an uplink grant or a downlink assignment for the activated SCell; or
B3350: 1>if a MAC PDU is transmitted in a configured uplink grant and LBT failure indication is not received from lower layers; or
B3351: 1>if a MAC PDU is received in a configured downlink assignment:
B3352: 2>restart the sCellDeactivationTimer associated with the SCell.
B3353: 1>if the SCell is deactivated:
B3354: 2>not transmit SRS on the SCell;
B3355: 2>not report CSI for the SCell;
B3356: 2>not log CSI for the SCell;
B3357: 2>not transmit on UL-SCH on the SCell;
B3358: 2>not transmit on RACH on the SCell;
B3359: 2>not monitor the PDCCH on the SCell;
B3360: 2>not monitor the PDCCH for the SCell;
B3361: 2>not transmit PUCCH on the SCell;
B3362: 2>if the SCell is configured as a scheduled cell in MC-DCI-SetOfCells and with the search space for DCI to schedule multiple cells (as specified in TS 38.213 [6]) of the same searchSpaceId as the serving cell in which MC-DCI-SetOfCells containing the SCell is configured:
B3363: 3>not monitor the PDCCH for scheduling multiple cells (as specified in TS 38.213 [6]) for the set of cells in MC-DCI-SetOfCells including the SCell.
B3364: When the measurement reporting for fast unknown SCell activation is configured by RRC, the MAC entity shall:
B3365: 1>if SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE or an Enhanced SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is received activating the SCell(s):
B3366: 2>if SCell(s) was deactivated prior to receiving this SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE or this Enhanced SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE:
B3367: 3>indicate to upper layers SCell(s) activation indication.
B3368: HARQ feedback for the MAC PDU containing SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE or Enhanced SCell Activation/Deactivation MAC CE shall not be impacted by PCell, PSCell and PUCCH SCell interruptions due to SCell activation/deactivation in TS 38.133 [11].
B3369: When SCell is deactivated, the ongoing Random Access procedure on the SCell, if any, is aborted.
B3370: 5.10Activation/Deactivation of PDCP duplication
B3371: If one or more DRBs are configured with PDCP duplication, the network may activate and deactivate the PDCP duplication for all or a subset of associated RLC entities for the configured DRB(s).
B3372: The PDCP duplication for the configured DRB(s) is activated and deactivated by:
B3373: -receiving the Duplication Activation/Deactivation MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.11;
B3374: -receiving the Duplication RLC Activation/Deactivation MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.32;
B3375: -indication by RRC.
B3376: The PDCP duplication for all or a subset of associated RLC entities for the configured DRB(s) is activated and deactivated by:
B3377: -receiving the Duplication RLC Activation/Deactivation MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.32;
B3378: -indication by RRC.
B3379: The PDCP duplication for all associated RLC entities for the configured DRB(s) is activated by:
B3380: -receiving an uplink grant addressed to CS-RNTI with NDI=1 for a logical channel associated with the DRB configured with survivalTimeStateSupport, described in clause 5.4.1.
B3381: The MAC entity shall for each DRB configured with PDCP duplication:
B3382: 1>if a Duplication Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is received activating the PDCP duplication of the DRB:
B3383: 2>indicate the activation of PDCP duplication of the DRB to upper layers.
B3384: 1>if a Duplication Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is received deactivating the PDCP duplication of the DRB:
B3385: 2>indicate the deactivation of PDCP duplication of the DRB to upper layers.
B3386: 1>if a Duplication RLC Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is received activating PDCP duplication for associated RLC entities of a DRB configured with PDCP duplication:
B3387: 2>indicate the activation of PDCP duplication for the indicated secondary RLC entity(ies) of the DRB to upper layers.
B3388: 1>if a Duplication RLC Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is received deactivating PDCP duplication for associated RLC entities of a DRB configured with PDCP duplication:
B3389: 2>indicate the deactivation of PDCP duplication for the indicated secondary RLC entity(ies) of the DRB to upper layers.
B3390: 1>if activation of a PDCP duplication for all configured RLC entities is triggered for the DRB as specified in clause 5.4.1:
B3391: 2>indicate the activation of PDCP duplication for all configured RLC entities of the DRB to upper layers.
B3392: NOTE:How to identify "associated RLC entity" or equivalent entity in N3C indirect path for a configured DRB is out of scope of 3GPP.
B3393: 5.11MAC reconfiguration
B3394: When a reconfiguration of the MAC entity is requested by upper layers, the MAC entity shall:
B3395: 1>initialize the corresponding HARQ entity upon addition of an SCell;
B3396: 1>remove the corresponding HARQ entity upon removal of an SCell;
B3397: 1>apply the new value for timers when the timer is (re)started;
B3398: 1>apply the new maximum parameter value when counters are initialized;
B3399: 1>apply immediately the configurations received from upper layers for other parameters.
B3400: 5.12MAC Reset
B3401: If a reset of the MAC entity is requested by upper layers upon receiving RRCResume or RRCSetup, the MAC entity shall:
B3402: 1>stop the MBS multicast DRX timers;
B3403: 1>flush the soft buffers for all DL HARQ processes used for MBS multicast;
B3404: 1>for each DL HARQ process used for MBS multicast, consider the next received transmission for a TB as the very first transmission.
B3405: Otherwise, if a reset of the MAC entity is requested by upper layers or the reset of the MAC entity is triggered due to SCG deactivation as defined in clause 5.29, the MAC entity shall:
B3406: 1>if the MAC reset is not due to SCG deactivation:
B3407: 2>initialize Bj for each logical channel to zero;
B3408: 1>initialize SBj for each logical channel to zero if Sidelink resource allocation mode 1 is configured by RRC;
B3409: 1>if upper layers indicate SCG deactivation and bfd-and-RLM with value true is configured for the deactivated SCG:
B3410: 2>stop (if running) all timers except beamFailureDetectionTimer associated with PSCell and timeAlignmentTimers.
B3411: 1>else if upper layers indicate the reset is triggered by reconfiguration with sync:
B3412: 2>stop (if running) all timers, except MBS broadcast DRX timers, ltm-TimeAlignmentTimer(s), and ltm-TimeAlignmentTimerTag2(s), if configured;
B3413: 2>consider all timeAlignmentTimers as expired and perform the corresponding actions in clause 5.2;
B3414: 1>else:
B3415: 2>stop (if running) all timers, except MBS broadcast DRX timers;
B3416: 2>consider all timeAlignmentTimers, inactivePosSRS-TimeAlignmentTimer, and cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer, if configured, as expired and perform the corresponding actions in clause 5.2;
B3417: 1>set the NDIs for all uplink HARQ processes to the value 0;
B3418: 1>sets the NDIs for all HARQ process IDs to the value 0 for monitoring PDCCH in Sidelink resource allocation mode 1;
B3419: 1>stop, if any, ongoing Random Access procedure;
B3420: 1>discard explicitly signalled contention-free Random Access Resources for 4-step RA type and 2-step RA type, if any, except the contention-free Random Access Resources signalled in the LTM Cell Switch Command;
B3421: 1>flush Msg3 buffer;
B3422: 1>flush MSGA buffer;
B3423: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Scheduling Request procedure;
B3424: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Buffer Status Reporting procedure;
B3425: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Delay Status Reporting procedure;
B3426: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Power Headroom Reporting procedure;
B3427: 1>cancel, if any, triggered consistent LBT failure;
B3428: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure;
B3429: 1>cancel, if any, triggered BFR;
B3430: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Sidelink Buffer Status Reporting procedure;
B3431: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Pre-emptive Buffer Status Reporting procedure;
B3432: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Timing Advance Reporting procedure;
B3433: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Recommended bit rate query procedure;
B3434: 1>cancel, if any, triggered UL Rate Control procedure;
B3435: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Configured uplink grant confirmation;
B3436: 1>cancel, if any, triggered configured sidelink grant confirmation;
B3437: 1>clear, if any, configured sidelink grants;
B3438: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Desired Guard Symbol query;
B3439: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request procedure;
B3440: 1>cancel, if any, triggered SDT procedure;
B3441: 1>cancel, if any, triggered IAB-MT Recommended Beam Indication query;
B3442: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Desired DL TX Power Adjustment query;
B3443: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Desired IAB-MT PSD range query;
B3444: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Case-6 Timing Request query;
B3445: 1>cancel, if any, triggered SL-PRS resource request;
B3446: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Event Triggered L1 Measurement Report;
B3447: 1>flush the soft buffers for all DL HARQ processes, except for the DL HARQ process being used for MBS broadcast;
B3448: 1>for each DL HARQ process, except for the DL HARQ process being used for MBS broadcast, consider the next received transmission for a TB as the very first transmission;
B3449: 1>release, if any, Temporary C-RNTI;
B3450: 1>clear, if any, Differential Koffset;
B3451: 1>if upper layers indicate SCG deactivation and bfd-and-RLM with value true is not configured; or
B3452: 1>if the MAC reset is not due to SCG deactivation:
B3453: 2>reset all BFI_COUNTERs;
B3454: 1>reset all LBT_COUNTERs;
B3455: 1>reset TTT for event triggered L1 measurement report triggering condition evaluation;
B3456: 1>reset all MR_SENT_COUNTER;
B3457: 1>clear all BEAM_ENTERING_LIST;
B3458: 1>clear all BEAM_LEAVING_LIST;
B3459: 1>clear all BEAM_REPORTED_LIST;
B3460: 1>clear all MR_LIST.
B3461: If a Sidelink specific reset of the MAC entity is requested for a PC5-RRC connection by upper layers, the MAC entity shall:
B3462: 1>flush the soft buffers for all Sidelink processes for all TB(s) associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3463: 1>consider all Sidelink processes for all TB(s) associated to the PC5-RRC connection as unoccupied;
B3464: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Scheduling Request procedure only associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3465: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Sidelink Buffer Status Reporting procedure only associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3466: 1>cancel, if any, triggered SL-PRS resource request only associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3467: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Sidelink CSI Reporting procedure associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3468: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Sidelink DRX Command Indication procedure associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3469: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Sidelink IUC-Request transmission procedure associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3470: 1>cancel, if any, triggered Sidelink IUC-Information Reporting procedure associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3471: 1>stop (if running) all timers associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3472: 1>reset the numConsecutiveDTX associated to the PC5-RRC connection;
B3473: 1>initialize SBj for each logical channel associated to the PC5-RRC connection to zero.
B3474: 5.12aVoid
B3475: 5.13Handling of unknown, unforeseen and erroneous protocol data
B3476: When a MAC entity receives a MAC PDU for the MAC entity's C-RNTI, CS-RNTI, G-RNTI, G-CS-RNTI or by the configured downlink assignment, containing a Reserved LCID or eLCID value, or an LCID or eLCID value the MAC Entity does not support, the MAC entity shall at least:
B3477: 1>discard the received subPDU and any remaining subPDUs in the MAC PDU.
B3478: When a MAC entity receives a MAC PDU for the MAC entity's C-RNTI, CS-RNTI or G-RNTI (for MBS multicast in RRC_INACTIVE), or by the configured downlink assignment, containing an LCID or eLCID value which is not configured, or an LCID or eLCID value associated with a suspended RB as specified in TS 38.331 [5], the MAC entity shall at least:
B3479: 1>discard the received subPDU.
B3480: When a MAC entity receives a MAC PDU on SL-SCH containing a Reserved LCID value for broadcast or groupcast, or an LCID value which is not configured, the MAC entity shall:
B3481: 1>discard the received subPDU.
B3482: When a MAC entity receives a MAC PDU on SL-SCH containing a Reserved LCID value for unicast, the MAC entity shall:
B3483: 1>discard the received subPDU and any remaining subPDUs in the MAC PDU.
B3484: 5.14Handling of measurement gaps
B3485: During an activated measurement gap that has not been cancelled by lower layer indication (as specified in clause 10.6 in TS 38.213 [6]), the MAC entity shall, on the Serving Cell(s) in the corresponding frequency range of the measurement gap configured by measGapConfig as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B3486: 1>not perform the transmission of HARQ feedback and SR;
B3487: 1>not perform the transmission of CSI, except for CSI reporting for LTM and reconfiguration with sync in the MSGA payload as specified in clause 5.2.4a in TS 38.214 [7];
B3488: 1>not report SRS;
B3489: 1>not transmit on UL-SCH except for Msg3 or the MSGA payload as specified in clause 5.4.2.2;
B3490: 1>if the ra-ResponseWindow or the ra-ContentionResolutionTimer or the msgB-ResponseWindow is running, or if there is an ongoing RACH-less LTM cell switch, or if there is an ongoing RACH-less handover:
B3491: 2>monitor the PDCCH as specified in clauses 5.1.4, 5.1.4a, 5.1.5, and 5.7.
B3492: 1>else:
B3493: 2>not monitor the PDCCH;
B3494: 2>not receive on DL-SCH.
B3495: NOTE:The MAC entity does not consider there is a measurement gap occasion if it is activated but cancelled.
B3496: 5.15Bandwidth Part (BWP) operation
B3497: 5.15.1Downlink and Uplink
B3498: In addition to clause 12 of TS 38.213 [6], this clause specifies requirements on BWP operation.
B3499: A Serving Cell may be configured with one or multiple BWPs, and the maximum number of BWP per Serving Cell is specified in TS 38.213 [6].
B3500: The BWP switching for a Serving Cell is used to activate an inactive BWP and deactivate an active BWP at a time. The BWP switching is controlled by the PDCCH indicating a downlink assignment or an uplink grant, by the bwp-InactivityTimer, by RRC signalling, or by the MAC entity itself upon initiation of Random Access procedure or upon detection of consistent LBT failure on SpCell. Upon RRC (re-)configuration of firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id and/or firstActiveUplinkBWP-Id for SpCell except for PSCell when SCG is deactivated (see clause 5.29) or activation of an SCell, the DL BWP and/or UL BWP indicated by firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id and/or firstActiveUplinkBWP-Id respectively (as specified in TS 38.331 [5]) is active without receiving PDCCH indicating a downlink assignment or an uplink grant. Upon RRC (re-)configuration of firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id for PSCell when SCG is deactivated, the DL BWP is switched to the firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id as specified in TS 38.331 [5]. The active BWP for a Serving Cell is indicated by either RRC or PDCCH (as specified in TS 38.213 [6]). For unpaired spectrum, a DL BWP is paired with a UL BWP, and BWP switching is common for both UL and DL.
B3501: For each SCell a dormant BWP may be configured with dormantBWP-Id by RRC signalling as described in TS 38.331 [5]. Entering or leaving dormant BWP for SCells is done by BWP switching per SCell or per dormancy SCell group based on instruction from PDCCH (as specified in TS 38.213 [6]). The dormancy SCell group configurations are configured by RRC signalling as described in TS 38.331 [5]. Upon reception of the PDCCH indicating leaving dormant BWP, the DL BWP indicated by firstOutsideActiveTimeBWP-Id or by firstWithinActiveTimeBWP-Id (as specified in TS 38.331 [5] and TS 38.213 [6]) is activated. Upon reception of the PDCCH indicating entering dormant BWP, the DL BWP indicated by dormantBWP-Id (as specified in TS 38.331 [5]) is activated. The dormant BWP configuration for SpCell or PUCCH SCell is not supported.

Upon reception of the PDCCH for BWP switching other than successful contention resolution, if the MAC entity decides to perform BWP switching, the MAC entity shall stop the ongoing Random Access procedure and initiate a Random Access procedure after performing the BWP switching; if the MAC decides to ignore the PDCCH for BWP switching, the MAC entity shall continue with the ongoing Random Access procedure on the Serving Cell.

B3618: 5.15.2Sidelink

B3661: 5.16SUL operation
B3662: The Supplementary UL (SUL) carrier can be configured as a complement to the normal UL (NUL) carrier. Switching between the NUL carrier and the SUL carrier means that the UL transmissions move from one carrier to the other carrier, which is done by:
B3663: -an indication in DCI;
B3664: -the Random Access procedure as specified in clause 5.1.1;
B3665: -the SDT procedure as specified in clause 5.27.
B3666: If the MAC entity receives a UL grant indicating an SUL switch while a Random Access procedure is ongoing, the MAC entity shall ignore the UL grant.
B3667: The Serving Cell configured with supplementaryUplink belongs to a single TAG.
B3668: 5.17Beam Failure Detection and Recovery procedure
B3669: The MAC entity may be configured by RRC per Serving Cell or per BFD-RS set with a beam failure recovery procedure which is used for indicating to the serving gNB of a new SSB or CSI-RS when beam failure is detected on the serving SSB(s)/CSI-RS(s). Beam failure is detected by counting beam failure instance indication from the lower layers to the MAC entity. If beamFailureRecoveryConfig is reconfigured by upper layers during an ongoing Random Access procedure for beam failure recovery for SpCell, the MAC entity shall stop the ongoing Random Access procedure and initiate a Random Access procedure using the new configuration. The Serving Cell is configured with two BFD-RS sets if and only if failureDetectionSet1 and failureDetectionSet2 are configured for the active DL BWP of the Serving Cell. When the SCG is deactivated, the UE performs beam failure detection on the PSCell if bfd-and-RLM is set to true.
B3670: RRC configures the following parameters in the beamFailureRecoveryConfig, beamFailureRecoverySpCellConfig, beamFailureRecoverySCellConfig and the radioLinkMonitoringConfig for the Beam Failure Detection and Recovery procedure:
B3671: -beamFailureInstanceMaxCount for the beam failure detection (per Serving Cell or per BFD-RS set of Serving Cell configured with two BFD-RS sets);
B3672: -beamFailureDetectionTimer for the beam failure detection (per Serving Cell or per BFD-RS set of Serving Cell configured with two BFD-RS sets);
B3673: -beamFailureRecoveryTimer for the beam failure recovery procedure for SpCell;
B3674: -rsrp-ThresholdSSB: an RSRP threshold for the SpCell beam failure recovery;
B3675: -rsrp-ThresholdBFR: an RSRP threshold for the SCell beam failure recovery or for the beam failure recovery of BFD-RS set of Serving Cell;
B3676: -powerRampingStep: powerRampingStep for the SpCell beam failure recovery;
B3677: -powerRampingStepHighPriority: powerRampingStepHighPriority for the SpCell beam failure recovery;
B3678: -preambleReceivedTargetPower: preambleReceivedTargetPower for the SpCell beam failure recovery;
B3679: -preambleTransMax: preambleTransMax for the SpCell beam failure recovery;
B3680: -scalingFactorBI: scalingFactorBI for the SpCell beam failure recovery;
B3681: -ssb-perRACH-Occasion: ssb-perRACH-Occasion for the SpCell beam failure recovery using contention-free Random Access Resources;
B3682: -ra-ResponseWindow: the time window to monitor response(s) for the SpCell beam failure recovery using contention-free Random Access Resources;
B3683: -prach-ConfigurationIndex: prach-ConfigurationIndex for the SpCell beam failure recovery using contention-free Random Access Resources;
B3684: -ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex: ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex for the SpCell beam failure recovery using contention-free Random Access Resources;
B3685: -ra-OccasionList: ra-OccasionList for the SpCell beam failure recovery using contention-free Random Access Resources;
B3686: -candidateBeamRSList: list of candidate beams for SpCell beam failure recovery;
B3687: -candidateBeamRS-List-r16: list of candidate beams for SCell beam failure recovery or list of candidate beams for beam failure recovery of a Serving Cell for BFD-RS set one;
B3688: -candidateBeamRS-List2-r17: list of candidate beams for beam failure recovery of a Serving Cell for BFD-RS set two.
B3689: The following UE variables are used for the beam failure detection procedure:
B3690: -BFI_COUNTER (per Serving Cell or per BFD-RS set of Serving Cell configured with two BFD-RS sets): counter for beam failure instance indication which is initially set to 0.
B3691: The MAC entity shall for each Serving Cell configured for beam failure detection:
B3692: 1>if the Serving Cell is configured with two BFD-RS sets:
B3693: 2>if beam failure instance indication for a BFD-RS set has been received from lower layers:
B3694: 3>start or restart the beamFailureDetectionTimer of the BFD-RS set;
B3695: 3>increment BFI_COUNTER of the BFD-RS set by 1;
B3696: 3>if BFI_COUNTER of the BFD-RS set >= beamFailureInstanceMaxCount:
B3697: 4>trigger a BFR for this BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell;
B3698: 2>if BFR is triggered for both BFD-RS sets of the SpCell and the Beam Failure Recovery procedure is not successfully completed for any of the BFD-RS sets:
B3699: 3>initiate a Random Access procedure (see clause 5.1) on the SpCell;
B3700: 2>if the Serving Cell is SpCell and the Random Access procedure initiated for beam failure recovery of both BFD-RS sets of SpCell is successfully completed (see clause 5.1):
B3701: 3>set BFI_COUNTER of each BFD-RS set of SpCell to 0.
B3702: 3>consider the Beam Failure Recovery procedure successfully completed.
B3703: 2>if the beamFailureDetectionTimer of a BFD-RS set expires; or
B3704: 2>if beamFailureDetectionTimer, beamFailureInstanceMaxCount, or any of the reference signals used for beam failure detection is reconfigured by upper layers or by the BFD-RS Indication MAC CE associated with a BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell; or
B3705: 2>if the reference signal(s) associated with a BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell used for beam failure detection is changed:
B3706: 3>set BFI_COUNTER of the BFD-RS set to 0.
B3707: 2>if a PDCCH addressed to C-RNTI indicating uplink grant for a new transmission is received for the HARQ process used for the transmission of the Enhanced BFR MAC CE or Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE which contains beam failure recovery information of a BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell:
B3708: 3>set BFI_COUNTER of the BFD-RS set to 0;
B3709: 3>consider the Beam Failure Recovery procedure successfully completed for this BFD-RS set and cancel all the triggered BFRs of this BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell.
B3710: 2>if the Serving Cell is SCell and the SCell is deactivated as specified in clause 5.9:
B3711: 3>set BFI_COUNTER of each BFD-RS set of SCell to 0;
B3712: 3>consider the Beam Failure Recovery procedure successfully completed and cancel all the triggered BFRs of all BFD-RS sets of the Serving Cell.
B3713: 1>else:
B3714: 2>if beam failure instance indication has been received from lower layers:
B3715: 3>start or restart the beamFailureDetectionTimer;
B3716: 3>increment BFI_COUNTER by 1;
B3717: 3>if BFI_COUNTER >= beamFailureInstanceMaxCount:
B3718: 4>if the Serving Cell is SCell:
B3719: 5>trigger a BFR for this Serving Cell;
B3720: 4>else if the Serving Cell is PSCell and, the SCG is deactivated:
B3721: 5>if beam failure of the PSCell has not been indicated to upper layers since the SCG was deactivated or since the deactivated SCG was last reconfigured with BFD-RS:
B3722: 6>indicate beam failure of the PSCell to upper layers.
B3723: NOTE:After beam failure is indicated to upper layers, the UE may stop the beamFailureDetectionTimer and lower layer beam failure indication while BFI_COUNTER >= beamFailureInstanceMaxCount for the deactivated SCG.
B3724: 4>else:
B3725: 5>initiate a Random Access procedure (see clause 5.1) on the SpCell;
B3726: 5>if beam failure is detected for an NCR-MT:
B3727: 6>indicate to NCR-Fwd to cease forwarding.
B3728: 2>if the beamFailureDetectionTimer expires; or
B3729: 2>if beamFailureDetectionTimer, beamFailureInstanceMaxCount, or any of the reference signals used for beam failure detection is reconfigured by upper layers associated with this Serving Cell; or
B3730: 2>if the reference signal(s) associated with this Serving Cell used for beam failure detection is changed:
B3731: 3>set BFI_COUNTER to 0.
B3732: 2>if the Serving Cell is SpCell and the Random Access procedure initiated for SpCell beam failure recovery is successfully completed (see clause 5.1):
B3733: 3>set BFI_COUNTER to 0;
B3734: 3>stop the beamFailureRecoveryTimer, if configured;
B3735: 3>if the Random Access procedure was triggered by beam failure recovery for NCR-MT:
B3736: 4>indicate to NCR-Fwd to resume forwarding using the last forwarding configuration received by NCR-MT as part of side control information before beam failure detection;
B3737: 3>consider the Beam Failure Recovery procedure successfully completed.
B3738: 2>else if the Serving Cell is SCell, and a PDCCH addressed to C-RNTI indicating uplink grant for a new transmission is received for the HARQ process used for the transmission of the MAC CE for BFR which contains beam failure recovery information of this Serving Cell; or
B3739: 2>if the SCell is deactivated as specified in clause 5.9:
B3740: 3>set BFI_COUNTER to 0;
B3741: 3>consider the Beam Failure Recovery procedure successfully completed and cancel all the triggered BFRs for this Serving Cell.
B3742: The MAC entity shall:
B3743: 1>if the Beam Failure Recovery procedure determines that at least one BFR has been triggered and not cancelled for an SCell for which evaluation of the candidate beams according to the requirements as specified in TS 38.133 [11] has been completed and if none of the Serving Cell(s) of this MAC entity are configured with two BFD-RS sets:

B3750: 1>if the Beam Failure Recovery procedure determines that at least one BFR for any BFD-RS set has been triggered and not cancelled for an SCell for which evaluation of the candidate beams according to the requirements as specified in TS 38.133 [11] has been completed; or

B3755: 2>else if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and if the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of LCP:

B3757: 2>else:

B3759: 3>trigger the SR for SCell beam failure recovery for each SCell for which BFR has been triggered, not cancelled, and for which evaluation of the candidate beams according to the requirements as specified in TS 38.133 [11] has been completed.
B3760: All BFRs triggered for an SCell shall be cancelled when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes a MAC CE for BFR which contains beam failure information of that SCell. All BFRs triggered for a BFD-RS set of a Serving Cell shall be cancelled when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes an Enhanced BFR MAC CE or Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE which contains beam failure recovery information of that BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell.

B3863: 5.18.10Recommended Bit Rate
B3864: The recommended bit rate procedure is used to provide the MAC entity with information about the bit rate which the gNB recommends. The bit rate is the recommended bit rate of the physical layer. Averaging window of default value 2000 ms will apply as specified in TS 26.114 [13].
B3865: The gNB may transmit the Recommended bit rate MAC CE to the MAC entity to indicate the recommended bit rate for the UE for a specific logical channel and a specific direction (either uplink or downlink). Upon reception of a Recommended bit rate MAC CE the MAC entity shall:
B3866: -indicate to upper layers the recommended bit rate for the indicated logical channel and direction.
B3867: The MAC entity may request the gNB to indicate the recommended bit rate for a specific logical channel and a specific direction. If the MAC entity is requested by upper layers to query the gNB for the recommended bit rate for a logical channel and for a direction (i.e. for uplink or downlink), the MAC entity shall:
B3868: 1>if a Recommended bit rate query for this logical channel and this direction has not been triggered:
B3869: 2>trigger a Recommended bit rate query for this logical channel, direction, and desired bit rate.
B3870: If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission the MAC entity shall:
B3871: 1>for each Recommended bit rate query that the Recommended Bit Rate procedure determines has been triggered and not cancelled:
B3872: 2>if bitRateQueryProhibitTimer for the logical channel and the direction of this Recommended bit rate query is configured, and it is not running; and
B3873: 2>if the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission and the allocated UL resources can accommodate a Recommended bit rate MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of LCP as defined in clause 5.4.3.1:
B3874: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Recommended bit rate MAC CE for the logical channel and the direction of this Recommended bit rate query;
B3875: 3>start the bitRateQueryProhibitTimer for the logical channel and the direction of this Recommended bit rate query;
B3876: 3>cancel this Recommended bit rate query.

B3902: 5.18.18Timing offset adjustments for IAB
B3903: For IAB operation, in order to achieve time-domain synchronization across multiple backhaul hops, a timing adjustment may be provided to an IAB node by its parent node. Two different values may be provided, related to Case-1/Case-6, and Case-7 timing modes respectively. The Timing Delta MAC CE carries Tdelta which is used to determine the IAB-DU DL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-1 timing mode, and to determine the IAB-DU DL Tx and IAB-MT UL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-6 timing mode. The Case-7 Timing advance offset MAC CE carries Toffset,2 which is used to determine the IAB-MT UL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-7 timing mode.
B3904: Upon reception of a Timing Delta MAC CE the IAB node shall:
B3905: -apply the value of Tdelta as specified in TS 38.213 [6].
B3906: Upon reception of a Case-7 Timing advance offset MAC CE the IAB node shall:
B3907: -apply the value of Toffset,2 as specified in TS 38.213 [6].
B3908: 5.18.19Guard symbols for IAB
B3909: For IAB operation, the MAC entity on the IAB-DU or IAB-donor-DU reserves a sufficient number of symbols at the beginning and/or the end of slots where the child IAB-node switches operation from its IAB-DU to its IAB-MT function and operation from its IAB-MT to its IAB-DU function. The MAC entity on the IAB-DU or IAB-donor-DU informs the child node about the number of guard symbols it provides via the Provided Guard Symbols MAC CE. The IAB-MT on the child node may inform the parent IAB-DU or IAB-donor-DU about the number of guard symbols desired via the Desired Guard Symbols MAC CE. IAB-MT transmission timing modes are specified in clause 14 of TS 38.213 [6].
B3910: Upon reception of a Provided Guard Symbols MAC CE the MAC entity shall:
B3911: -indicate to lower layers the number of provided guard symbols and the SCS configuration for the indicated Serving Cell.
B3912: The MAC entity may:
B3913: 1>if a Desired Guard Symbol query has not been triggered:
B3914: 2>trigger a Desired Guard Symbol query for this Serving Cell.
B3915: If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission the MAC entity shall:
B3916: 1>for each Desired Guard Symbol query that has been triggered and not cancelled:
B3917: 2>if the allocated UL resources can accommodate a Desired Guard Symbols MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of LCP as defined in clause 5.4.3.1:
B3918: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Desired Guard Symbols MAC CE;
B3919: 3>cancel this Desired Guard Symbol query.
B3920: For Case-1 timing mode, a separate value for the number of guard symbols is specified for each of the following eight switching scenarios (see Table 5.18.19-1).
B3921: Table 5.18.19-1: Switching scenarios and relevant guard symbols for Case-1 timing mode
B3922 R0: Switching scenario | Field for number of guard symbols in MAC CE
B3922 R1: IAB-MT operation to IAB-DU operation | MT Rx to DU Tx | NmbGS 1
B3922 R2:  | MT Rx to DU Rx | NmbGS 2
B3922 R3:  | MT Tx to   DU Tx | NmbGS 3
B3922 R4:  | MT Tx to   DU Rx | NmbGS 4
B3922 R5: IAB-DU operation to IAB-MT operation | DU Rx to MT Tx | NmbGS 5
B3922 R6:  | DU Rx to MT Rx | NmbGS 6
B3922 R7:  | DU Tx to MT Tx | NmbGS 7
B3922 R8:  | DU Tx to MT Rx | NmbGS 8
B3924: For Case-6 and Case-7 timing modes, a separate value for the number of guard symbols is specified for each of the following eight switching scenarios (see Table 5.18.19-2):
B3925: Table 5.18.19-2: Switching scenarios and relevant guard symbols for Case-6 and Case-7 timing modes
B3926 R0: Switching scenario | Field for number of guard symbols in MAC CE
B3926 R1: IAB-MT operation to IAB-DU operation | MT Tx (Case-6) to DU Tx (Case-1) | NmbGS 9
B3926 R2:  | MT Tx (Case-6) to DU Rx (Case-1) | NmbGS 10
B3926 R3:  | MT Tx (Case-7) to DU Tx (Case-1) | NmbGS 11
B3926 R4:  | MT Tx (Case-7) to DU Rx (Case-1) | NmbGS 12
B3926 R5: IAB-DU operation to IAB-MT operation | DU Tx (Case-1) to MT Tx (Case-6) | NmbGS 13
B3926 R6:  | DU Rx (Case-1) to MT Tx (Case-6) | NmbGS 14
B3926 R7:  | DU Tx (Case-1) to MT Tx (Case-7) | NmbGS 15
B3926 R8:  | DU Rx (Case-1) to MT Tx (Case-7) | NmbGS 16
B3928: 5.18.20Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Command
B3929: If the UE is configured with pre-configured measurement gaps, the network may send DL MAC CE for Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Command to the UE as in clause 6.1.3.41. For the activated measurement gap, the UE shall follow the specified UE behaviour in clause 5.14.
B3930: Upon the reception of the MAC CE for Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Command, the MAC entity shall:
B3931: 1>if the Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Command MAC CE indicates the deactivation of a pre-configured positioning measurement gap:
B3932: 2>deactivate the positioning measurement gap.
B3933: 1>else if the Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Command MAC CE indicates the activation of a pre-configured measurement gap:
B3934: 2>activate the positioning measurement gap and perform the procedure specified in clause 5.14.
B3935: 5.18.21PPW Activation/Deactivation Command
B3936: If the UE is configured with pre-configured PPW, the network may send DL MAC CE for PPW Activation/Deactivation Command to the UE as in clause 6.1.3.42. For the activated PPW, the UE shall follow the specified UE behaviour in clause 5.24.
B3937: Upon activation of DL BWP, the PPW(s) configured for that BWP are considered deactivated. Upon reconfiguration of PPW(s) of the active DL BWP, all the PPW(s) for that BWP are considered deactivated.
B3938: Upon the reception of the MAC CE for PPW Activation/Deactivation Command, the MAC entity shall:
B3939: 1>if the DL MAC CE for PPW Activation/Deactivation Command indicates the deactivation of a pre-configured PPW:
B3940: 2>deactivate the PPW.
B3941: 1>else if the DL MAC CE for PPW Activation/Deactivation Command indicates the activation of a pre-configured PPW:
B3942: 2>activate the PPW according to the procedure specified in clause 5.24.

B3963: 5.18.26Restricted and recommended beam indication for IAB
B3964: Child IAB-DU Restricted Beam Indication MAC CE is used by an IAB-DU or an IAB-donor-DU to indicate to its child node spatial resources and associated frequency information where simultaneous transmission/reception from the IAB-MT of the child node and transmission from the IAB-DU cells of the child node is restricted. IAB-MT Recommended Beam Indication MAC CE is used by an IAB-node to indicate to its parent node recommendations for spatial resources and associated frequency information for transmission/reception from and to the IAB-MT of the IAB-node. Time resources where these restrictions/recommendations can apply are indicated via RRC, while the MAC CE further selects from these time resources the specific time resource configuration (comprising a list of slot indices) to which information provided in the MAC CE applies.
B3965: Upon reception of a Child IAB-DU Restricted Beam Indication MAC CE the IAB-node shall:
B3966: -apply the configuration signalled in the MAC CE to the time slots indicated in IAB-ResourceConfig (as specified in TS 38.331 [5]) which contains iab-ResourceConfigID parameter which matches the Resource Configuration ID field of the MAC CE.
B3967: The MAC entity may:
B3968: 1>if an IAB-MT Recommended Beam Indication query has not been triggered:
B3969: 2>trigger an IAB-MT Recommended Beam Indication query for this Serving Cell.
B3970: If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission the MAC entity shall:
B3971: 1>for each IAB-MT Recommended Beam Indication query that has been triggered and not cancelled:
B3972: 2>if the allocated UL resources can accommodate a IAB-MT Recommended Beam Indication MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of LCP as defined in clause 5.4.3.1:
B3973: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the IAB-MT Recommended Beam Indication MAC CE;
B3974: 3>cancel this IAB-MT Recommended Beam Indication query.
B3975: 5.18.27DL TX power adjustment for IAB
B3976: DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE is used by an IAB-DU or an IAB-donor-DU to indicate to its child node spatial resources and associated frequency information where the DL TX power adjustment contained in the MAC CE applies. Desired DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE is used by an IAB-node to indicate to its parent node recommendations for such a restriction. Time resources where these restrictions/recommendations can apply are indicated via RRC, while the MAC CE further selects from these time resources the specific time resource configuration (comprising a list of slot indices) to which information provided in the MAC CE applies.
B3977: Upon reception of a DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE the IAB-node shall:
B3978: -apply the configuration signalled in the MAC CE to the time slots indicated in IAB-ResourceConfig (as specified in TS 38.331 [5]) which contains iab-ResourceConfigID parameter which matches the Resource Configuration ID field of the MAC CE.
B3979: The MAC entity may:
B3980: 1>if a Desired DL TX Power Adjustment query has not been triggered:
B3981: 2>trigger a Desired DL TX Power Adjustment query for this Serving Cell.
B3982: If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission the MAC entity shall:
B3983: 1>for each Desired DL TX Power Adjustment query that has been triggered and not cancelled:
B3984: 2>if the allocated UL resources can accommodate a Desired DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of LCP as defined in clause 5.4.3.1:
B3985: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Desired DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE;
B3986: 3>cancel this Desired DL TX Power Adjustment query.
B3987: 5.18.28UL PSD range adjustment for IAB
B3988: Desired IAB-MT PSD range MAC CE is used by an IAB-node to indicate to its parent node a recommendation of spatial resources and associated frequency information where the desired PSD range, contained in the MAC CE (and provided to help with the node's UL TX power control) could apply. Time resources where these recommendations can apply are indicated via RRC, while the MAC CE further selects from these time resources the specific time resource configuration (comprising a list of slot indices) to which information provided in the MAC CE applies.
B3989: The MAC entity may:
B3990: 1>if a Desired IAB-MT PSD range query has not been triggered:
B3991: 2>trigger a Desired IAB-MT PSD range query for this Serving Cell.
B3992: If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission the MAC entity shall:
B3993: 1>for each Desired IAB-MT PSD range query that has been triggered and not cancelled:
B3994: 2>if the allocated UL resources can accommodate a Desired IAB-MT PSD range MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of LCP as defined in clause 5.4.3.1:
B3995: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Desired IAB-MT PSD range MAC CE;
B3996: 3>cancel this Desired IAB-MT PSD range query.
B3997: 5.18.29Timing case indication for IAB
B3998: Timing Case Indication MAC CE is used by an IAB-DU or an IAB-donor-DU to indicate to its child node timing modes which should apply to time resources indicated via RRC.
B3999: Upon reception of a Timing Case Indication MAC CE the IAB-node shall:
B4000: -apply the configuration signalled in the MAC CE to the time slots indicated in IAB-ResourceConfig which contains iab-ResourceConfigID parameter (as specified in TS 38.331 [5]) which matches the Resource Configuration ID field of the MAC CE.
B4001: 5.18.30Case-6 Timing Request
B4002: The Case-6 Timing Request MAC CE is used by the IAB-MT to inform its parent node whether Case-6 timing is required for simultaneous operation.
B4003: The MAC entity may:

B4005: 2>trigger a Case-6 Timing Request query for this Serving Cell.

B4010: 3>cancel this Case-6 Timing Request range query.
B4011: 5.18.31Backhaul Link Beam Indication for NCR
B4012: NCR Downlink Backhaul Link Beam Indication MAC CE and NCR Uplink Backhaul Link Beam Indication MAC CE are used by a gNB to indicate to an NCR-node the beam to be used for the downlink and uplink backhaul transmission respectively between the gNB and the NCR-node.
B4013: Upon reception of an NCR Downlink Backhaul Link Beam Indication MAC CE, the NCR-node shall:
B4014: -indicate to NCR-Fwd to apply the configuration contained in NCR Downlink Backhaul Link Beam Indication MAC CE as received by the NCR-MT.
B4015: Upon reception of an NCR Uplink Backhaul Link Beam Indication MAC CE, the NCR-node shall:
B4016: -indicate to NCR-Fwd to apply the configuration contained in the NCR Uplink Backhaul Link Beam Indication MAC CE as received by the NCR-MT.
B4017: 5.18.32Access Link Beam Indication for NCR
B4018: NCR Access Link Beam Indication MAC CE is used by a gNB to indicate to an NCR-node the forwarding resources to be used for the semi-persistent access link transmission between the NCR-node and the UE(s) served by this device.
B4019: Upon reception of an NCR Access Link Beam Indication MAC CE, the NCR-node shall:
B4020: -apply the configuration signalled in the MAC CE as received by NCR-MT to the forwarding resource lists indicated via RRC, and use it to operate the NCR-Fwd.
B4021: 5.18.33Enhanced Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE

B4032: 2>indicate the deactivation of the PSI-based SDU discard for the DRB to upper-layers.
B4033: 5.18.35(Enhanced) LTM Cell Switch Command
B4034: The network may instruct the UE to perform LTM cell switch procedure by sending the LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.75 or the Enhanced LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.75a. The Enhanced LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE is used for MAC entity associated with MCG if the value of ltm-NoSecurityChangeID contained within the LTM-Candidate associated with target configuration ID in ltm-Config is not equal to the value of stored ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID as specified in TS 38.331 [5]. Otherwise, the LTM Cell Switch MAC CE is used.
B4035: The MAC entity shall:
B4036: 1>if the MAC entity receives an (Enhanced) LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE on a Serving Cell:
B4037: 2>indicate to upper layers that the LTM cell switch procedure is triggered and the Target Configuration ID included in the LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE; or indicate to upper layers that the LTM cell switch procedure is triggered, the Target Configuration ID and the NCC value included in the Enhanced LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE;
B4038: 2>if the MAC reset operation as specified in clause 5.12 is performed, as requested by upper layers:
B4039: 3>if Timing Advance Command value (hexa-decimal) is not set as FFF:
B4040: 4>process the received Timing Advance Command (see clause 5.2);
B4041: 4>consider the RACH-less LTM cell switch to be ongoing;
B4042: 4>if the MAC entity is associated with the SCG:
B4043: 5>indicate to upper layers to skip the Random Access procedure for this LTM cell switch.
B4044: 3>else if the UE is configured with UE-based Timing Advance measurement as specified in TS 38.331 [5] and the UE has successfully measured the Timing Advance for the SpCell of the indicated LTM target configuration:
B4045: 4>process the measured Timing Advance (see clause 5.2);
B4046: 4>consider the RACH-less LTM cell switch to be ongoing.
B4047: 4>if the MAC entity is associated with the SCG:
B4048: 5>indicate to upper layers to skip the Random Access procedure for this LTM cell switch.
B4049: 3>if the SR Configuration ID is included in the (Enhanced) LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE:
B4050: 4>consider the SR configuration indicated by the SR Configuration ID as the SR configuration that corresponds to the logical channel serving the radio bearer used (i.e., SRB1) during RACH-less LTM cell switch procedure.
B4051: 3>indicate to lower layers the information regarding the TCI state information included in the LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE or the Enhanced LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE.
B4052: NOTE:The UE should indicate to upper layers that the LTM cell switch procedure is triggered as soon as possible following the reception of the (Enhanced) LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE, which could be before confirming successful reception (HARQ) of this message.
B4053: 5.18.36Candidate Cell TCI States Activation/Deactivation
B4054: The network may activate and deactivate the TCI states of LTM candidate cell(s) configured in CandidateTCI-State and CandidateTCI-UL-State by sending the Candidate Cell TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.76. The network deactivates the TCI state(s) for one LTM candidate cell by not including the corresponding TCI state ID field(s) in the Candidate Cell TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE. The UE shall deactivate all TCI states of an LTM candidate cell upon (re-)configuration of any TCI state of the LTM candidate cell. The UE shall deactivate all TCI states of all configured LTM candidate cells for the corresponding cell group after reconfiguration with sync that is not triggered by LTM.
B4055: The MAC entity shall:
B4056: 1>if the MAC entity receives a Candidate Cell TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE on a Serving Cell:

B4063: 5.18.38Activation/Deactivation of Semi-Persistent CSI-RS/CSI-IM resource set for candidate cell
B4064: The network may activate or deactivate the configured Semi-Persistent CSI-RS/CSI-IM resource sets for a candidate cell by sending the SP CSI-RS/CSI-IM Resource Set Activation/Deactivation for Candidate Cell MAC CE described in clause 6.1.3.12a. The UE shall deactivate all Semi-Persistent CSI-RS/CSI-IM resource sets of an LTM candidate cell upon (re-)configuration of any Semi-Persistent CSI-RS/CSI-IM resource set of the LTM candidate cell. The UE shall deactivate all Semi-Persistent CSI-RS/CSI-IM resource sets of all configured LTM candidate cells for the corresponding cell group after reconfiguration with sync that is not triggered by LTM. After reconfiguration with sync that is triggered by LTM, the configured Semi-Persistent CSI-RS/CSI-IM resource sets for all candidate cell(s), except the ones for CSI reporting at target cell, are deactivated. After CSI reporting at the target cell after or during cell switch triggered by LTM as specified in clause 5.2.4a in TS 38.214 [7], the configured Semi-Persistent CSI-RS/CSI-IM resource sets for the target cell are deactivated.
B4065: The MAC entity shall:
B4066: 1>if the MAC entity receives an SP CSI-RS/CSI-IM Resource Set Activation/Deactivation for Candidate Cell MAC CE:
B4067: 2>indicate to lower layers the information regarding the SP CSI-RS/CSI-IM Resource Set Activation/Deactivation for Candidate Cell MAC CE.

The updated value(s) of pathloss offset(s) in the MAC CE does not impact the value(s) in RRC configuration.
