B4073: 5.18.40UL Rate Control
B4074: The UL Rate Control procedure provides information on UL physical-layer bit rate available to a QoS flow.
B4075: The MAC entity is configured by upper layers with a set of QoS flows for which UL bit rate indication and UL bit rate query are supported.
B4076: The gNB may transmit the UL Rate Control MAC CE (defined in clause 6.1.3.86) to the MAC entity to recommend UL bit rate(s) for one or multiple QoS flows. Upon reception of the UL Rate Control MAC CE, the MAC entity shall indicate the recommended bit rate(s) to upper layers.
B4077: The MAC entity may transmit the UL Rate Control MAC CE to the serving gNB to request preferred UL bit rate(s) for one or multiple QoS flows. Upon request by upper layers for a preferred UL bit rate for a QoS flow, the MAC entity shall trigger a bit rate query for the QoS flow, if no other bit rate query is already pending for the same QoS flow. A bit rate query remains pending after being triggered, until it is cancelled.
B4078: When UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission, the MAC entity shall:
B4079: 1>for each QoS flow with a pending bit rate query:
B4080: 2>if ul-RateQueryProhibitTimer for the QoS flow is not running:
B4081: 3>include the QoS flow and its preferred bit rate in the MAC entity's list of pending bit rate queries.
B4082: 1>if there is at least one entry in the MAC entity's list of pending bit rate queries; and
B4083: 1>if the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the UL Rate Control MAC CE, including its subheader and preferred bit rate of at least one of the pending queries, as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B4084: 2>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the UL Rate Control MAC CE.
B4085: 1>for each QoS flow whose bit rate query is included in the UL Rate Control MAC CE:
B4086: 2>start its ul-RateQueryProhibitTimer;
B4087: 2>cancel its bit rate query.
B4088: NOTE:If the UL-SCH resources cannot accommodate all the pending bit rate queries, it is up to UE implementation to determine whether and which queries are included in the UL Rate Control MAC CE.

The configured semi-persistent CLI measurement resource sets are initially deactivated upon (re-)configuration by upper layers and after reconfiguration with sync.

B4100: 5.19Data inactivity monitoring
B4101: The UE may be configured by RRC with a Data inactivity monitoring functionality, when in RRC_CONNECTED. RRC controls Data inactivity operation by configuring the timer dataInactivityTimer.
B4102: When dataInactivityTimer is configured, the UE shall:
B4103: 1>if any MAC entity receives a MAC SDU for DTCH logical channel, DCCH logical channel, or CCCH logical channel, or multicast MTCH logical channel; or
B4104: 1>if any MAC entity transmits a MAC SDU for DTCH logical channel, or DCCH logical channel:
B4105: 2>start or restart dataInactivityTimer.
B4106: 1>if the dataInactivityTimer expires:
B4107: 2>indicate the expiry of the dataInactivityTimer to upper layers.
B4108: 5.20Void
B4109: 5.21LBT operation
B4110: 5.21.1General
B4111: The lower layer may perform an LBT procedure, see TS 37.213 [18], according to which a transmission is not performed by lower layers if the channel is identified as being occupied. When lower layer performs an LBT procedure before a transmission and the transmission is not performed, an LBT failure indication is sent to the MAC entity from lower layers. Unless otherwise specified, when LBT procedure is performed for a transmission, actions as specified in this specification are performed regardless of if an LBT failure indication is received from lower layers. When LBT is not performed by the lower layers, LBT failure indication is not received from lower layers.
B4112: 5.21.2LBT failure detection and recovery procedure
B4113: The MAC entity may be configured by RRC with a consistent LBT failure recovery procedure. Consistent LBT failure is detected per UL BWP by counting LBT failure indications, for all UL transmissions, from the lower layers to the MAC entity.
B4114: RRC configures the following parameters in the lbt-FailureRecoveryConfig:
B4115: -lbt-FailureInstanceMaxCount for the consistent LBT failure detection;
B4116: -lbt-FailureDetectionTimer for the consistent LBT failure detection;
B4117: The following UE variable is used for the consistent LBT failure detection procedure:
B4118: -LBT_COUNTER (per Serving Cell): counter for LBT failure indication which is initially set to 0.
B4119: For each activated Serving Cell configured with lbt-FailureRecoveryConfig, the MAC entity shall:
B4120: 1>if LBT failure indication has been received from lower layers:
B4121: 2>start or restart the lbt-FailureDetectionTimer;
B4122: 2>increment LBT_COUNTER by 1;
B4123: 2>if LBT_COUNTER >= lbt-FailureInstanceMaxCount:
B4124: 3>trigger consistent LBT failure for the active UL BWP in this Serving Cell;
B4125: 3>if this Serving Cell is the SpCell:
B4126: 4>if consistent LBT failure has been triggered in all UL BWPs configured with PRACH occasions on same carrier in this Serving Cell:
B4127: 5>indicate consistent LBT failure to upper layers.
B4128: 4>else:
B4129: 5>stop any ongoing Random Access procedure in this Serving Cell;
B4130: 5>switch the active UL BWP to a UL BWP, on same carrier in this Serving Cell, configured with PRACH occasion and for which consistent LBT failure has not been triggered;
B4131: 5>initiate a Random Access Procedure (as specified in clause 5.1.1).
B4132: 1>if all triggered consistent LBT failures are cancelled in this Serving Cell; or
B4133: 1>if the lbt-FailureDetectionTimer expires; or
B4134: 1>if lbt-FailureDetectionTimer or lbt-FailureInstanceMaxCount is reconfigured by upper layers:
B4135: 2>set LBT_COUNTER to 0.
B4136: The MAC entity shall:
B4137: 1>if consistent LBT failure has been triggered, and not cancelled, in the SpCell; and
B4138: 1>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission in the SpCell and these UL-SCH resources can accommodate the LBT failure MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B4139: 2>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the LBT failure MAC CE.
B4140: 1>else if consistent LBT failure has been triggered, and not cancelled, in at least one SCell:
B4141: 2>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission in a Serving Cell for which consistent LBT failure has not been triggered and these UL-SCH resources can accommodate the LBT failure MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B4142: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the LBT failure MAC CE.
B4143: 2>else:
B4144: 3>trigger a Scheduling Request for LBT failure MAC CE.
B4145: 1>if a MAC PDU is transmitted and LBT failure indication is not received from lower layers and this PDU includes the LBT failure MAC CE:
B4146: 2>cancel all the triggered consistent LBT failure(s) in SCell(s) for which consistent LBT failure was indicated in the transmitted LBT failure MAC CE.
B4147: 1>if consistent LBT failure is triggered and not cancelled in the SpCell; and
B4148: 1>if the Random Access procedure is considered successfully completed (see clause 5.1) in the SpCell:
B4149: 2>cancel all the triggered consistent LBT failure(s) in the SpCell.
B4150: 1>if lbt-FailureRecoveryConfig is reconfigured by upper layers for a Serving Cell:
B4151: 2>cancel all the triggered consistent LBT failure(s) in this Serving Cell.
B4152: 5.22SL-SCH Data transfer and SL-PRS transmission
B4153: 5.22.1SL-SCH Data and SL-PRS transmission
B4154: 5.22.1.1SL Grant reception and SCI transmission
B4155: Sidelink grant is received dynamically on the PDCCH, configured semi-persistently by RRC or autonomously selected by the MAC entity. The MAC entity may have a sidelink grant on an active SL BWP to determine a set of PSCCH duration(s) in which transmission of SCI occurs and a set of PSSCH duration(s) in which transmission of SL-SCH associated with the SCI occurs. The MAC entity may have a sidelink grant on the Shared SL-PRS resource pool of an active BWP to determine a set of PSCCH durations(s) in which transmission of SCI occurs and a set of SL-PRS transmission occasion(s) and PSSCH duration(s) in which transmission of SL-PRS and SL-SCH associated with the SCI occur. The MAC entity may have a sidelink grant on the Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool of an active BWP to determine a set of PSCCH duration(s) in which transmission of SCI occurs and a set of SL-PRS transmission occasion(s) in which transmission of SL-PRS associated to the SCI occurs. A sidelink grant addressed to SL-CS-RNTI with NDI = 1 is considered as a dynamic sidelink grant. A sidelink grant addressed to SL-PRS-CS-RNTI with Activation/Release indication = 1 as in clause 7.3.1.4.3 in TS 38.212 [9] is considered as a dynamic sidelink grant.
B4156: If the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 1 as indicated in TS 38.331 [5] or if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation scheme 1 as indicated in TS 38.331 [5] and PDCCH is received for resource allocation on Shared SL-PRS resource pool, the MAC entity shall for each PDCCH occasion and for each grant received for this PDCCH occasion:
B4157: 1>if a sidelink grant has been received on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's SL-RNTI:
B4158: 2>if the NDI received on the PDCCH has not been toggled compared to the value in the previously received HARQ information for the HARQ Process ID:
B4159: 3>use the received sidelink grant to determine PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) and SL-PRS transmission occasion(s), if available, for one or more retransmissions of a single MAC PDU for the corresponding Sidelink process according to clause 8.1.2 of TS 38.214 [7] and SL-PRS according to clause 8.1.4 of TS 38.214 [7].
B4160: 2>else:
B4161: 3>use the received sidelink grant to determine PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) and SL-PRS transmission occasion(s), if available, for initial transmission and, if available, retransmission(s) of a single MAC PDU and SL-PRS according to clause 8.1.2 of TS 38.214 [7].
B4162: NOTE 0:When SL-PRS is transmitted on Shared SL-PRS resource pool, the PSSCH duration(s) and SL-PRS transmission occasion(s) are determined only after the LCP procedure in clause 5.22.1.4.1.
B4163: 1>else if a sidelink grant has been received on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's SL-CS-RNTI:
B4164: 2>if PDCCH contents indicate retransmission(s) for the identified HARQ process ID that has been set for an activated configured sidelink grant identified by sl-ConfigIndexCG:
B4165: 3>use the received sidelink grant to determine PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) and SL-PRS transmission occasion(s), if available, for one or more retransmissions of a single MAC PDU and SL-PRS according to clause 8.1.2 of TS 38.214 [7].
B4166: 2>else if PDCCH contents indicate configured grant Type 2 deactivation for a configured sidelink grant:
B4167: 3>trigger configured sidelink grant confirmation for the configured sidelink grant.
B4168: 2>else if PDCCH contents indicate configured grant Type 2 activation for a configured sidelink grant:
B4169: 3>trigger configured sidelink grant confirmation for the configured sidelink grant;
B4170: 3>store the configured sidelink grant;
B4171: 3>initialise or re-initialise the configured sidelink grant to determine the set of PSCCH durations and the set of PSSCH durations for transmissions of multiple MAC PDUs according to clause 8.1.2 of TS 38.214 [7] and the set of SL-PRS transmission occasions for transmission of multiple SL-PRS according to clause of 8.2.4 of TS 38.214 [7], if available.
B4172: 1>if a dynamic sidelink grant is available for retransmission(s) of a MAC PDU which has been positively acknowledged as specified in clause 5.22.1.3.1a:
B4173: 2>clear the PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) corresponding to retransmission(s) of the MAC PDU from the sidelink grant.
B4174: If the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation scheme 1 as in TS 38.331 [5] and PDCCH is received for resource allocation on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool, the MAC entity shall for each PDCCH occasion:
B4175: 1>if a sidelink grant has been received on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's SL-PRS-RNTI: (i.e., dynamic grant)
B4176: 2>use the received sidelink grant to determine the PSCCH duration(s) and the corresponding SL-PRS occasion(s) for initial transmission and, if available, retransmission(s) of the transmission of SL-PRS according to clause 8.2.4 of TS 38.214 [7].
B4177: 1>else if a sidelink grant has been received on the PDCCH for MAC entity's SL-PRS-CS-RNTI: (i.e., configured sidelink grant type 2)
B4178: 2>if the PDCCH content indicates the configured grant Type 2 activation for a configured sidelink grant:
B4179: 3>store the configured sidelink grant;
B4180: 3>trigger configured sidelink grant confirmation for the configured sidelink grant;
B4181: 3>initialise or re-initialise the configured sidelink grant to determine the set of PSCCH duration(s) and the corresponding SL-PRS occasion for the transmission of SL-PRS according to clause of 8.2.4 of TS 38.214 [7].

B4577: NOTE 3:It is left for UE implementation to reselect any pre-selected but not reserved resource(s) other than the resource(s) indicated for pre-emption or re-evaluation by the physical layer during reselection triggered by re-evaluation or pre-emption indicated by the physical layer.
B4578: NOTE 4:It is up to UE implementation whether to set the resource reservation interval in the re-selected resource to replace pre-empted resource.
B4579: NOTE 5:It is up to UE implementation whether to trigger resource reselection due to de-prioritization as specified in clause 16.2.4 of TS 38.213 [6], clause 5.14.1.2.2 of TS 36.321 [22] and clause 5.22.1.3.1a.
B4580: NOTE 6:For the selected sidelink grant corresponds to transmissions of multiple MAC PDU, it is up to UE implementation whether to apply re-evaluation check to the resources in non-initial reservation period that have been signalled neither in the immediate last nor in the current period.
B4581: NOTE 7:MAC entity, based on UE implementation, decides whether to indicate to lower layer the larger than 1 number of consecutive slots for Multi-consecutive slots transmission as specified in clause 8.1.4 of TS 38.214 [7].
B4582: 5.22.1.2bRe-selection for using a received resource conflict indication
B4583: If the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 2 or Sidelink resource allocation scheme 2 to transmit using pool(s) of resources in a carrier as indicated in TS 38.331 [5] based on full sensing, or partial sensing or any combination(s), the MAC entity shall for each Sidelink process:
B4584: 1>if sl-interUECoordinationScheme2 enabling reception/transmission of a resource conflict indication is configured by RRC; and
B4585: 1>if the next resource of the selected sidelink grant which has been indicated by a prior SCI is overlapped with conflict resource(s) indicated by the physical layer as specified in clause 16.3.1 of TS 38.213 [6]:
B4586: 2>remove the resource from the selected sidelink grant associated to the Sidelink process;
B4587: 2>if sl-NRPSSCH-EUTRA-ThresRSRP-List is configured by the RRC:
B4588: 3>when SCS of NR SL is (pre-)configured as μ = 0:
B4589: 4>randomly select the time and frequency resource from the resources indicated by the physical layer as specified in clause 8.1.4 of TS 38.214 [7] excluding the conflict resource(s) for the removed resource, according to the amount of selected frequency resources, the selected number of HARQ retransmissions and the remaining PDB of either SL data available in the logical channel(s), and the remaining SL-PRS delay budget for SL-PRS transmission, if available, by ensuring the minimum time gap between any two selected resources of the selected sidelink grant in case that PSFCH is configured for this pool of resources, and that a resource can be indicated by the time resource assignment of an SCI for a retransmission according to clause 8.3.1.1 of TS 38.212 [9];
B4590: 3>when SCS of NR SL is (pre-)configured as μ = 1:
B4591: 4>randomly select the time and frequency resources in the second of NR SL slots overlapping with an LTE SL subframe to which the selected transmission resources belongs, or select the time and frequency resources in the first of NR SL slots overlapping with an LTE SL subframe for one transmission opportunity from the available resources indicated by the physical layer as specified in clause 8.1.4 of TS 38.214 [7] excluding the conflict resource(s) for the removed resource, according to the amount of selected frequency resources, the selected number of HARQ retransmissions and the remaining PDB of either SL data available in the logical channel(s), and the remaining SL-PRS delay budget for SL-PRS transmission, if available, by ensuring the minimum time gap between any two selected resources of the selected sidelink grant in case that PSFCH is configured for this pool of resources, and that a resource can be indicated by the time resource assignment of an SCI for a retransmission according to clause 8.3.1.1 of TS 38.212 [9].
B4592: 2>else:
B4593: 3>randomly select the time and frequency resource from the resources indicated by the physical layer as specified in clause 8.1.4 of TS 38.214 [7] excluding the conflict resource(s) for the removed resource, according to the amount of selected frequency resources, the selected number of HARQ retransmissions and the remaining PDB of either SL data available in the logical channel(s), and the remaining SL-PRS delay budget for SL-PRS transmission, if available, by ensuring the minimum time gap between any two selected resources of the selected sidelink grant in case that PSFCH is configured for this pool of resources, and that a resource can be indicated by the time resource assignment of an SCI for a retransmission according to clause 8.3.1.1 of TS 38.212 [9].
B4594: NOTE 1:If retransmission resource cannot be selected by ensuring that the resource can be indicated by the time resource assignment of a prior SCI, how to select the time and frequency resource for more transmission opportunities from the available resources is left for UE implementation by ensuring the minimum time gap between any two selected ‎resources in case that PSFCH is configured for this pool of ‎resources.
B4595: 2>replace the removed resource by the selected resource for the selected sidelink grant.
B4596: NOTE 2:It is left for UE implementation to reselect any pre-selected but not reserved resource(s) other than the resource overlapping with the conflict resource(s) indicated by the physical layer during reselection triggered by the conflict resource(s) indicated by the physical layer.
B4597: NOTE 3:It is up to UE implementation whether and how to set the resource reservation interval in the re-selected resource to replace the resource overlapping with the conflict resource(s) indicated by the physical layer.
B4598: 5.22.1.2cResource re-selection from SL LBT Failure indication
B4599: If the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 2 to transmit using pool(s) of resources in a carrier as indicated in TS 38.331 [5] based on sensing or random selection the MAC entity shall for each Sidelink process:
B4600: 1>if SL LBT failure indication is received from lower layers:
B4601: 2>for the resource(s) where SL LBT failure is detected from the selected sidelink grant associated to the Sidelink process:
B4602: 3>if transmission based on random selection is configured by upper layers:
B4603: 4>randomly select the time and frequency resources for one transmission opportunity from the resource pool excluding all RB sets for which Sidelink consistent LBT failures were detected and not cancelled, if configured according to the amount of selected frequency resources and the remaining PDB of SL data available in the logical channel(s) by ensuring the minimum time gap between any two selected resources of the selected sidelink grant in case that PSFCH is configured for this pool of resources.
B4604: 3>else:
B4605: 4>randomly select the time and frequency resources for one transmission opportunity from the resources indicated by the physical layer as specified in clause 8.1.4 of TS 38.214 [7], according to the amount of selected frequency resources and the remaining PDB of SL data available in the logical channel(s) by ensuring the minimum time gap between any two selected resources of the selected sidelink grant in case that PSFCH is configured for this pool of resources.
B4606: The MAC entity shall only apply the above procedure for non Multi-consecutive slots transmission case and Multi-consecutive slots transmission case using single slot candidate resources.
B4607: 5.22.1.3Sidelink HARQ operation and SL-PRS transmission
B4608: 5.22.1.3.1Sidelink HARQ Entity
B4609: The MAC entity is configured by upper layers to transmit using pool(s) of resources on one or more carriers as indicated in clause 5.8.8 of TS 38.331 [5]. For each carrier, the MAC entity includes at most one Sidelink HARQ entity for transmission on SL-SCH, which maintains a number of parallel Sidelink processes.
B4610: The maximum number of transmitting Sidelink processes associated with the Sidelink HARQ Entity is 16. A sidelink process may be configured for transmissions of multiple MAC PDUs. For transmissions of multiple MAC PDUs with Sidelink resource allocation mode 2, the maximum number of transmitting Sidelink processes associated with the Sidelink HARQ Entity is 4.
B4611: A delivered sidelink grant and its associated Sidelink transmission information are associated with a Sidelink process. Each Sidelink process supports one TB.
B4612: NOTE:For SL-PRS transmission on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool, the maximum number of SL-PRS the UE should support is left to UE implementation.
B4613: For each sidelink grant, the Sidelink HARQ Entity shall:
B4614: 1>if the MAC entity determines that the sidelink grant is used for initial transmission as specified in clause 5.22.1.1; or
B4615: 1>if the sidelink grant is a configured sidelink grant and no MAC PDU has been obtained in an sl-PeriodCG of the configured sidelink grant; or
B4616: 1>if the sidelink grant is a dynamic sidelink grant or selected sidelink grant and no MAC PDU has been obtained in the previous sidelink grant when PSCCH duration(s) and 2nd stage SCI on PSSCH of the previous sidelink grant is not in SL DRX Active time as specified in clause 5.28.3 of any destination that has data to be sent:
B4617: NOTE 1:Void.
B4618: 2>(re-)associate a Sidelink process to this grant, and for the associated Sidelink process:
B4619: 2>if all PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) for initial transmission of a MAC PDU of the dynamic sidelink grant or the configured sidelink grant is not in SL DRX Active time as specified in clause 5.28.3 of the destination that has data to be sent:
B4620: 3>ignore the sidelink grant.
B4621: NOTE 1A:The Sidelink HARQ Entity will associate the selected sidelink grant to the Sidelink process determined by the MAC entity.
B4623: 2>else:
B4624: 3>obtain the MAC PDU and SL-PRS, if any, to transmit from the Multiplexing and assembly entity, if any;
B4625: 3>if a MAC PDU to transmit has been obtained:
B4626: 4>if a HARQ Process ID has been set for the sidelink grant:
B4627: 5>(re-)associate the HARQ Process ID corresponding to the sidelink grant to the Sidelink process.
B4628: NOTE 1a:There is one-to-one mapping between a HARQ Process ID and a Sidelink process in the MAC entity configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 1.
B4629: 4>determines Sidelink transmission information of the TB for the source and destination pair of the MAC PDU as follows:
B4630: 5>set the Source Layer-1 ID to the 8 LSB of the Source Layer-2 ID of the MAC PDU;
B4631: 5>set the Destination Layer-1 ID to the 16 LSB of the Destination Layer-2 ID of the MAC PDU;
B4632: 5>(re-)associate the Sidelink process to a Sidelink process ID;
B4633: NOTE 1b:How UE determine Sidelink process ID in SCI is left to UE implementation for NR sidelink.
B4634: 5>consider the NDI to have been toggled compared to the value of the previous transmission corresponding to the Sidelink identification information and the Sidelink process ID of the MAC PDU and set the NDI to the toggled value;
B4635: NOTE 2:The initial value of the NDI set to the very first transmission for the associated Sidelink process is left to UE implementation.
B4636: NOTE 3:Void.
B4637: 5>if the MAC PDU is for NR sidelink discovery:
B4638: 6>set the cast type indicator to broadcast.
B4639: 5>else:
B4640: 6>if the MAC PDU includes only Sidelink MAC CE(s):
B4641: 7>if the MAC PDU includes only Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE indicating non-preferred resource set and triggered by a condition other than the explicit request:
B4642: 8>set the cast type indicator to one of broadcast, groupcast and unicast.
B4643: 7>else:
B4644: 8>set the cast type indicator to unicast.
B4645: 6>else:
B4646: 7>set the cast type indicator to one of broadcast, groupcast and unicast as indicated by upper layers.
B4647: 5>if HARQ feedback has been enabled for the MAC PDU according to clause 5.22.1.4.2;
B4648: 6>set the HARQ feedback enabled/disabled indicator to enabled.
B4649: 5>else:
B4650: 6>set the HARQ feedback enabled/disabled indicator to disabled.
B4651: 5>set the priority to the value of the highest priority of the logical channel(s), if any, and MAC CE(s), if included, in the MAC PDU and SL-PRS, if any;
B4652: NOTE 3A:When determining Sidelink transmission information, the priority of the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE is the value configured in RRC parameters sl-PriorityCoordInfoCondition when triggered by a condition, or sl-PriorityCoordInfoExplicit when triggered by an explicit request. When determining Sidelink transmission information, the priority of the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE is the value configured in RRC parameter sl-PriorityRequest. When determining Sidelink transmission information, the priority of the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE is the value indicated in Priority field in the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE provided by the UE when triggered by an explicit request, if sl-PriorityCoordInfoExplicit-r17 is not configured. When determining Sidelink transmission information for performing sensing and candidate resource selections in PHY, the priority value of the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE triggered under a condition is up to UE implementation, if sl-PriorityCoordInfoCondition-r17 is not configured. When determining Sidelink transmission information for performing sensing and candidate resource selections in PHY, the priority value of Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE is the same as that of a TB to be transmitted by the UE, if sl-PriorityRequest-r17 is not configured.
B4653: 5>if HARQ feedback is enabled for groupcast:
B4654: 6>if both a group size and a member ID are provided by upper layers and the group size is not greater than the number of candidate PSFCH resources in a slot associated with this sidelink grant:
B4655: 7>select either positive-negative acknowledgement or negative-only acknowledgement.
B4656: NOTE 4:Selection of positive-negative acknowledgement or negative-only acknowledgement is up to UE implementation.
B4657: 6>else:
B4658: 7>select negative-only acknowledgement.
B4659: NOTE 5:UE operating in SL unlicensed does not use negative-only acknowledgement for groupcast HARQ feedback.
B4660: 6>if negative-only acknowledgement is selected, UE's location information is available, and sl-TransRange has been configured for a logical channel in the MAC PDU, and sl-ZoneConfig is configured as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B4661: 7>set the communication range requirement to the value of the longest communication range of the logical channel(s) in the MAC PDU;
B4662: 7>determine the value of sl-ZoneLength corresponding to the communication range requirement and set Zone_id to the value of Zone_id calculated using the determined value of sl-ZoneLength as specified in TS 38.331 [5].
B4663: 5>set the Redundancy version to the selected value.
B4664: 5>if the upper layers triggers the SL-PRS transmission of the peer UE identified by the Destination layer-2 ID:
B4665: 6>set the SL-PRS request to request.
B4666: 5>set the SL-PRS resource ID, if SL-PRS is available, within Sidelink transmission information.
B4667: NOTE 6:The SL-PRS resource ID(s) for initial transmission and retransmission(s) are determined by the UE's own upper layers by implementation.
B4668: 4>deliver the MAC PDU, the SL-PRS, if available, the sidelink grant and the Sidelink transmission information of the TB and/or the SL-PRS to the associated Sidelink process;
B4669: 4>instruct the associated Sidelink process to trigger a new transmission.
B4670: 3>else:
B4671: 4>flush the HARQ buffer of the associated Sidelink process.
B4672: 1>else (i.e. retransmission):
B4673: 2>if the HARQ Process ID corresponding to the sidelink grant received on PDCCH, the configured sidelink grant or the selected sidelink grant is associated to a Sidelink process of which HARQ buffer is empty; or
B4674: 2>if the HARQ Process ID corresponding to the sidelink grant received on PDCCH is not associated to any Sidelink process; or
B4675: 2>if PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) for one or more retransmissions of a MAC PDU of the dynamic sidelink grant or the configured sidelink grant is not in SL DRX Active time as specified in clause 5.28.3 of the destination that has data to be sent:
B4676: 3>ignore the sidelink grant.
B4677: 2>else:
B4678: 3>identify the Sidelink process associated with this grant, and for the associated Sidelink process:
B4679: 4>set the SL-PRS resource ID, if SL-PRS is available, within Sidelink transmission information;
B4680: 4>deliver the sidelink grant and the Sidelink transmission information of the MAC PDU and the SL-PRS, if available, to the associated Sidelink process;
B4681: 4>instruct the associated Sidelink process to trigger a retransmission.
B4682: 5.22.1.3.1aSidelink process not associated with Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool
B4683: The Sidelink process is associated with a HARQ buffer.
B4684: New transmissions and retransmissions are performed on the resource indicated in the sidelink grant as specified in clause 5.22.1.1 and with the MCS selected as specified in clause 8.1.3.1 of TS 38.214 [7] and clause 5.22.1.1.
B4685: If the Sidelink process is configured to perform transmissions of multiple MAC PDUs with Sidelink resource allocation mode 2, the process maintains a counter SL_RESOURCE_RESELECTION_COUNTER. For other configurations of the Sidelink process, this counter is not available.
B4686: Priority of a MAC PDU and SL-PRS, if available, is determined by the highest priority of the logical channel(s), MAC CE(s) in the MAC PDU or SL-PRS.
B4687: If the Sidelink HARQ Entity requests a new transmission, the Sidelink process shall:
B4688: 1>store the MAC PDU in the associated HARQ buffer;
B4689: 1>store the sidelink grant received from the Sidelink HARQ Entity;
B4690: 1>generate a transmission as described below.
B4691: If the Sidelink HARQ Entity requests a retransmission, the Sidelink process shall:
B4692: 1>store the sidelink grant received from the Sidelink HARQ Entity;
B4693: 1>generate a transmission as described below.
B4694: To generate a transmission, the Sidelink process shall:
B4695: 1>if there is no uplink transmission; or
B4696: 1>if the MAC entity is able to simultaneously perform uplink transmission(s) and sidelink transmission at the time of the transmission; or
B4697: 1>if the other MAC entity and the MAC entity are able to simultaneously perform uplink transmission(s) and sidelink transmission at the time of the transmission respectively; or
B4698: 1>if there is a MAC PDU to be transmitted for this duration in uplink, except a MAC PDU obtained from the Msg3 buffer, the MSGA buffer, or prioritized as specified in clause 5.4.2.2, and the sidelink transmission is prioritized over uplink transmission:
B4699: 2>instruct the physical layer to transmit SCI according to the stored sidelink grant with the associated Sidelink transmission information;
B4700: 2>instruct the physical layer to generate a transmission according to the stored sidelink grant;
B4701: 2>if HARQ feedback has been enabled for the MAC PDU according to clause 5.22.1.4.2:
B4702: 3>instruct the physical layer to monitor PSFCH for the transmission and perform PSFCH reception as specified in clause 5.22.1.3.2.
B4703: 2>if sl-PUCCH-Config is configured by RRC for the stored sidelink grant:
B4704: 3>determine transmission of an acknowledgement on the PUCCH as specified in clause 5.22.1.3.2.
B4705: 1>if this transmission corresponds to the last transmission of the MAC PDU; or
B4706: 1>if this transmission corresponds to the last transmission of the MAC PDU and SL-PRS:
B4707: 2>decrement SL_RESOURCE_RESELECTION_COUNTER by 1, if available.
B4708: NOTE 1:If the number of HARQ retransmissions selected by the MAC entity has been reached, or if a positive acknowledgement to a transmission of the MAC PDU has been received, or if a negative-only acknowledgement was enabled in the SCI and no negative acknowledgement was received for the transmission of the MAC PDU, the MAC entity determines this transmission corresponds to the last transmission of the MAC PDU or the last transmission of the MAC PDU and SL-PRS for Sidelink resource allocation mode 2. How to determine the last transmission in other cases is up to UE implementation.
B4709: 1>if sl-MaxTransNum corresponding to the highest priority of the logical channel(s) in the MAC PDU has been configured in sl-CG-MaxTransNumList for the sidelink grant by RRC and the number of transmissions of the MAC PDU has been reached to sl-MaxTransNum; or
B4710: 1>if a positive acknowledgement to this transmission of the MAC PDU was received according to clause 5.22.1.3.2, except a positive acknowledgement to Multi-consecutive slots transmission (i.e., multiple TBs case) of the MAC PDU and there is remaining slot(s) for this MAC PDU; or
B4711: 1>if negative-only acknowledgement was enabled in the SCI and no negative acknowledgement was received for this transmission of the MAC PDU according to clause 5.22.1.3.2:
B4712: 2>flush the HARQ buffer of the associated Sidelink process.
B4713: NOTE 1A: If a selected sidelink grant is available for retransmission(s) of a MAC PDU related to a Multi-consecutive slots transmissions (i.e., multiple TBs case) for which positive acknowledgements to all the MAC PDUs have been received, UE may flush the HARQ buffer of the associated Sidelink process.
B4714: The transmission of the MAC PDU or SL-PRS, if available, is prioritized over uplink transmission(s) of the MAC entity or the other MAC entity if the following conditions are met:
B4715: 1>if the MAC entity is not able to perform this sidelink transmission simultaneously with all uplink transmission(s) at the time of the transmission, and
B4716: 1>if none of the uplink transmission(s) is prioritized by upper layer according to TS 23.287 [19], and
B4717: 1>if none of the NR uplink MAC PDU(s) includes any MAC CE prioritized as described in clause 5.4.3.1.3, and
B4718: 1>if ul-PrioritizationThres is configured and if the value of the highest priority of logical channel(s) of all the NR uplink transmission(s) is not lower than ul-PrioritizationThres, and
B4719: 1>if sl-PrioritizationThres is configured and if the value of the highest priority of logical channel(s) or MAC CE(s) in the MAC PDU is lower than sl-PrioritizationThres.
B4720: NOTE 2:If the MAC entity is not able to perform this sidelink transmission simultaneously with all uplink transmissions as specified in clause 5.4.2.2 of TS 36.321 [22] at the time of the transmission, and prioritization-related information is not available prior to the time of this sidelink transmission due to processing time restriction, it is up to UE implementation whether this sidelink transmission is performed.
B4721: 5.22.1.3.2PSFCH reception
B4722: The MAC entity shall for each PSSCH transmission:
B4723: 1>if an acknowledgement corresponding to the PSSCH transmission in clause 5.22.1.3.1a is obtained from the physical layer:
B4724: 2>deliver the acknowledgement to the corresponding Sidelink HARQ entity for the Sidelink process;
B4725: 1>else:
B4726: 2>deliver a negative acknowledgement to the corresponding Sidelink HARQ entity for the Sidelink process;
B4727: 1>if the PSSCH transmission occurs for a pair of Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID corresponding to a PC5-RRC connection which has been established by upper layers:
B4728: 2>perform the HARQ-Based Sidelink RLF Detection procedure as specified in clause 5.22.1.3.3.
B4729: If sl-PUCCH-Config is configured by RRC, the MAC entity shall for a PUCCH transmission occasion:
B4730: 1>if the timeAlignmentTimer, associated with the TAG containing the Serving Cell on which the HARQ feedback is to be transmitted, is stopped or expired, and the Serving Cell is not configured with two TAGs; or
B4731: 1>if the Serving Cell on which the HARQ feedback is to be transmitted is configured with two TAGs and if the timeAlignmentTimer of the TAG, associated with the TCI state(s) used for transmitting the HARQ feedback, is stopped or expired:
B4732: 2>not instruct the physical layer to generate acknowledgement(s) of the data in this TB.
B4733: 1>else if all PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) for initial transmission of a MAC PDU of the dynamic sidelink grant or the configured sidelink grant is not in SL DRX Active time as specified in clause 5.28.3 of the destination that has data to be sent and the sidelink grant is ignored according to clause 5.22.1.3.1:
B4734: 2>instruct the physical layer to signal a positive acknowledgement corresponding to the transmission on the PUCCH according to clause 16.5 of TS 38.213 [6].
B4735: 1>else if a MAC PDU has been obtained for a sidelink grant associated to the PUCCH transmission occasion in clause 5.22.1.3.1, the MAC entity shall:
B4736: 2>if the most recent transmission of the MAC PDU was not prioritized as specified in clause 5.22.1.3.1a:
B4737: 3>instruct the physical layer to signal a negative acknowledgement on the PUCCH according to clause 16.5 of TS 38.213 [6].
B4738: 2>else if HARQ feedback has been disabled for the MAC PDU and next retransmission(s) of the MAC PDU is not required:
B4739: 3>instruct the physical layer to signal a positive acknowledgement corresponding to the transmission on the PUCCH according to clause 16.5 of TS 38.213 [6].
B4740: 2>else if HARQ feedback has been disabled for the MAC PDU, and no sidelink grant is available for next retransmission(s) of the MAC PDU (including immediately after all PSSCH duration(s) in an sl-PeriodCG for the sidelink grant, the number of transmissions of the MAC PDU has not reached sl-MaxTransNum corresponding to the highest priority of the logical channel(s) in the MAC PDU, if configured in sl-CG-MaxTransNumList for the sidelink grant by RRC), if any; or
B4741: 2>else if PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) for one or more retransmissions of a MAC PDU of the dynamic sidelink grant or the configured sidelink grant is not in SL DRX Active time as specified in clause 5.28.3 of the destination that has data to be sent:
B4742: 3>instruct the physical layer to signal a negative acknowledgement corresponding to the transmission on the PUCCH according to clause 16.5 of TS 38.213 [6].
B4743: 2>else:
B4744: 3>instruct the physical layer to signal an acknowledgement corresponding to the transmission on the PUCCH according to clause 16.5 of TS 38.213 [6]
B4745: 1>else:
B4746: 2>instruct the physical layer to signal a positive acknowledgement on the PUCCH according to clause 16.5 of TS 38.213 [6].
B4747: 5.22.1.3.3HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection
B4748: For each carrier associated with a PC5-RRC connection, the HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection procedure is used to detect Sidelink RLF based on a number of consecutive DTX on PSFCH reception occasions for a PC5-RRC connection.
B4749: RRC configures the following parameter to control HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection:
B4750: -sl-maxNumConsecutiveDTX.
B4751: The following UE variable is used for HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection.
B4752: -numConsecutiveDTX, which is maintained per carrier per PC5-RRC connection.
B4753: For each carrier associated with a PC5-RRC connection, the Sidelink HARQ Entity shall (re-)initialize numConsecutiveDTX to zero for each PC5-RRC connection which has been established by upper layers, if any, upon establishment of the PC5-RRC connection or (re)configuration of sl-maxNumConsecutiveDTX.
B4754: For each carrier associated with a PC5-RRC connection, the Sidelink HARQ Entity shall for each PSFCH reception occasion associated to the PSSCH transmission:
B4755: 1>if PSFCH reception is absent on the PSFCH reception occasion:
B4756: 2>increment numConsecutiveDTX by 1;
B4757: NOTE 1:For SL operation with shared spectrum channel access, UE increases the numConsecutiveDTX by 1 when the UE fails to detect the HARQ feedback on all the associated PSFCH resources according to clause 16.3.0 of TS 38.213 [6].
B4758: 2>if more than one carrier selected as defined in clause 5.22.1.11 is considered as the carriers for HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection:
B4759: 3>if numConsecutiveDTX reaches sl-maxNumConsecutiveDTX for all carriers applied for HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection:
B4760: 4>indicate HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection to upper layers (i.e., RRC layer and V2X layer).
B4761: 3>else if numConsecutiveDTX reaches sl-maxNumConsecutiveDTX for a carrier applied for HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection:
B4762: 4>trigger the TX carrier (re-)selection procedure as specified in clause 5.22.1.11;
B4763: 4>indicate HARQ-based Sidelink carrier failure to upper layers (i.e., RRC layer and V2X layer).
B4764: 2>else:
B4765: 3>if numConsecutiveDTX reaches sl-maxNumConsecutiveDTX:
B4766: 4>indicate HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection to upper layers.
B4767: 1>else:
B4768: 2>re-initialize numConsecutiveDTX to zero.
B4769: 5.22.1.3.4Processing of sidelink grant on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool
B4770: For each sidelink grant, the MAC entity shall:
B4771: 1>if the MAC entity determines that the sidelink grant is used for initial transmission as specified in clause 5.22.1.1:
B4772: 2>associate a Sidelink process to this sidelink grant;
B4773: 2>set the Destination ID to the Destination layer-2 ID corresponding to the SL-PRS transmission;
B4774: 2>if the length of the Source ID is configured to as 12 bit:
B4775: 3>set the Source ID to the 12 LSB of the Source layer-2 ID corresponding to the SL-PRS transmission;
B4776: 2>else if length of the Source ID is configured to as 24 bit:
B4777: 3>set the Source ID to the Source layer-2 ID corresponding to the SL-PRS transmission;
B4778: 2>set the cast type indicator to one of broadcast, groupcast and unicast as indicated by the upper layer;
B4779: 2>set the SL-PRS priority as the value indicated by upper layer;
B4780: 2>set the SL-PRS resource ID;
B4781: NOTE 1:The SL-PRS resource ID(s) for initial transmission and retransmission(s) are determined by the UE's own upper layers by implementation.
B4782: 2>if the upper layer triggers SL-PRS transmission of the peer UE identified by the Destination layer-2 ID:
B4783: 3>set the SL-PRS request to request;
B4784: 2>deliver the SL-PRS transmission information to the Sidelink process;
B4785: 2>instruct the associated Sidelink process to trigger a new transmission as defined in 5.22.1.3.5.
B4786: 1>else (i.e., retransmission):
B4787: 2>identify the Sidelink process associated with this grant;
B4788: 2>if sl-PRS-MaxNumTransmissions is configured and the number of transmissions of the SL-PRS has not reached the selected maximum number of SL-PRS transmissions; or
B4789: 2>if sl-PRS-MaxNumTransmissions is not configured:
B4790: 3>set the SL-PRS resource ID;
B4791: 3>deliver the SL-PRS transmission information to the Sidelink process;
B4792: 3>instruct the associated Sidelink process to trigger a retransmission as defined in 5.22.1.3.5.
B4793: NOTE 2:For configured sidelink grant, the Sidelink process for retransmission is identified by the SL-PRS Process ID as specified in clause 5.22.1.1.
B4794: 5.22.1.3.5Sidelink process associated with Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool
B4795: If the Sidelink process is configured to perform transmissions of multiple SL-PRS with Sidelink resource allocation scheme 2, the process maintains a counter SL_RESOURCE_RESELECTION_COUNTER. For other configurations of the Sidelink process, this counter is not available. For each SL-PRS new transmission or retransmission, the MAC entity shall:
B4796: 1>if there is no uplink transmission; or
B4797: 1>if there is uplink transmission and the sidelink transmission is prioritized over uplink transmission:
B4798: 2>instruct the physical layer to transmit SCI of the SL grant with the associated SL-PRS transmission information on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool;
B4799: 2>instruct the physical layer to generate the SL-PRS on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool.
B4800: 1>if this transmission corresponds to the last transmission of the SL-PRS transmission:
B4801: 2>decrement SL_RESOURCE_RESELECTION_COUNTER by 1, if available.
B4802: NOTE:If the number of SL-PRS transmissions selected by the MAC entity has been reached, the MAC entity determines this transmission corresponds to the last transmission of the SL-PRS transmission for Sidelink resource allocation scheme 2.
B4803: The transmission of the SL-PRS is prioritized over uplink transmission(s) of the MAC entity or the other MAC entity if the following conditions are met:
B4804: 1>if the MAC entity is not able to perform this sidelink transmission simultaneously with all uplink transmission(s) at the time of the transmission, and
B4805: 1>if ul-PrioritizationThres is configured and if the value of the highest priority of logical channel(s) of all the NR uplink transmission(s) is not lower than ul-PrioritizationThres, and
B4806: 1>if sl-PrioritizationThres is configured and if the value of SL-PRS priority is lower than sl-PrioritizationThres.
B4807: 5.22.1.4Multiplexing and assembly
B4808: 5.22.1.4.0General
B4809: For PDU(s) associated with one SCI, MAC shall consider only logical channels with the same Source Layer-2 ID-Destination Layer-2 ID pair for one of unicast, groupcast and broadcast which is associated with the pair. Multiple transmissions for different Sidelink processes are allowed to be independently performed in different PSSCH durations.
B4810: NOTE:Sidelink data for discovery and sidelink data for non-discovery transmitted by a UE cannot be multiplexed into the same TB because they are always associated with different destination L2 IDs (see TS 23.304 [26]).
B4811: 5.22.1.4.1Logical channel prioritization
B4812: 5.22.1.4.1.1General
B4813: The sidelink Logical Channel Prioritization procedure is applied whenever a new transmission is performed.
B4814: RRC controls the scheduling of sidelink data by signalling for each logical channel:
B4815: -sl-Priority where an increasing priority value indicates a lower priority level;
B4816: -sl-PrioritisedBitRate which sets the sidelink Prioritized Bit Rate (sPBR);
B4817: -sl-BucketSizeDuration which sets the sidelink Bucket Size Duration (sBSD).
B4818: RRC additionally controls the LCP procedure by configuring mapping restrictions for each logical channel:
B4819: -sl-configuredGrantType1Allowed which sets whether a configured grant Type 1 can be used for sidelink transmission;
B4820: -sl-AllowedCG-List which sets the allowed configured grant(s) for sidelink transmission;
B4821: -sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled which sets whether the logical channel is allowed to be multiplexed with logical channel(s) with sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled set to enabled or disabled.
B4822: The following UE variable is used for the Logical channel prioritization procedure:
B4823: -SBj which is maintained for each logical channel j.
B4824: The MAC entity shall initialize SBj of the logical channel to zero when the logical channel is established.
B4825: For each logical channel j, the MAC entity shall:
B4826: 1>increment SBj by the product sPBR × T before every instance of the LCP procedure, where T is the time elapsed since SBj was last incremented;
B4827: 1>if the value of SBj is greater than the sidelink bucket size (i.e. sPBR × sBSD):
B4828: 2>set SBj to the sidelink bucket size.
B4829: NOTE:The exact moment(s) when the UE updates SBj between LCP procedures is up to UE implementation, as long as SBj is up to date at the time when a grant is processed by LCP.
B4830: 5.22.1.4.1.2Selection of logical channels and SL-PRS
B4831: The MAC entity shall for each SCI corresponding to a new transmission:
B4832: 1>if sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfig, sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfigCommon, sl-BWP-PoolConfigA2X or sl-BWP-PoolConfigCommonA2X is configured according to TS 38.331 [5]; and
B4833: 1>if COT sharing information has not been received from lower layers as specified in TS 37.213[18]; and
B4834: 1>if the new transmission is not associated to a sidelink grant on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool:
B4835: 2>if the new transmission is associated to a sidelink grant in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected or sl-DiscTxPoolScheduling configured in sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfig or sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfigCommon:
B4836: 3>select a Destination associated with NR sidelink discovery as specified in TS 23.304 [26], that is in the SL Active time for the SL transmission occasion if SL DRX is applied for the destination, and among the logical channels that satisfy all the following conditions for the SL grant associated to the SCI:
B4837: 4>SL data for NR sidelink discovery is available for transmission; and
B4838: 4>SBj > 0, in case there is any logical channel having SBj > 0; and
B4839: 4>sl-configuredGrantType1Allowed, if configured, is set to true in case the SL grant is a Configured Grant Type 1; and
B4840: 4>sl-AllowedCG-List, if configured, includes the configured grant index associated to the SL grant.
B4841: 2>else if the new transmission is associated to a sidelink grant in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal configured in sl-BWP-PoolConfigA2X or sl-BWP-PoolConfigCommonA2X:
B4842: 3>select a Destination associated with BRID if sl-A2X-Service in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal indicates brid or bridAndDAA or select a Destination associated with DAA if sl-A2X-Service in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal indicates daa or bridAndDAA as specified in TS 23.256 [31], and the logical channel with the highest priority, among the logical channels that satisfy all the following conditions for the SL grant associated to the SCI:
B4843: 4>SL data for A2X communication is available for transmission; and
B4844: 4>SBj > 0, in case there is any logical channel having SBj > 0.
B4845: 2>else:
B4846: 3>select a Destination associated to one of unicast, groupcast and broadcast (excluding the Destination(s) associated with NR sidelink discovery as specified in TS 23.304 [26] or A2X communication), that is in the SL Active time for the SL transmission occasion if SL DRX is applied for the destination, and having at least one of the MAC CE and the logical channel and pending SL-PRS transmission(s) with the highest priority, among the logical channels that satisfy all the following conditions and MAC CE(s), if any, and SL-PRS(s), if any for the SL grant associated to the SCI:
B4847: 4>SL data for NR sidelink communication is available for transmission; and
B4848: 4>SBj > 0, in case there is any logical channel having SBj > 0; and
B4849: 4>sl-configuredGrantType1Allowed, if configured, is set to true in case the SL grant is a Configured Grant Type 1; and
B4850: 4>sl-AllowedCG-List, if configured, includes the configured grant index associated to the SL grant; and
B4851: 4>sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to disabled, if PSFCH is not configured for the SL grant associated to the SCI.
B4852: NOTE 0:A LCH is allowed in a carrier based on whether this selected carrier is within a subset of frequencies associated with all the PC5 QoS flows allowed to be mapped to this LCH based on RRC configuration.
B4853: 1>else if the sidelink grant is associated with Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool:
B4854: 2>select a Destination corresponding to the cast type of the SL grant and having pending SL-PRS transmission(s) with the highest priority for the SL grant associated to the SCI;
B4855: 1>else:
B4856: 2>if COT sharing information has been received from lower layers as specified in TS 37.213[18]:
B4857: 3>if resources used for initial transmission for the SL grant associated to the SCI are within the COT duration and MAC entity decides to use shared COT with type-2 LBT:
B4858: 4>select a Destination associated to one of unicast, groupcast and broadcast that satisfy the following destination condition and CAPC condition, and having at least one of the MAC CE and the logical channel with the highest priority, among the logical channels that satisfy all the following conditions and the MAC CE(s) that satisfies CAPC and destination requirement, if any, for the SL grant associated to the SCI:
B4859: 5>if a Source Layer-1 ID and a Destination Layer-1 ID contained in the COT initiator's SCI or COT sharing information match to the 8 LSB of the corresponding Destination Layer-2 ID and the 16 LSB of a Source Layer-2 IDs relating to the transmission from the responding UE and the cast type indicator in the SCI is set to unicast; or if a Destination Layer-1 ID contained in the COT initiator's SCI or COT sharing information matches to the 16 LSB of a Destination Layer-2 ID relating to the transmission from the responding UE and the cast type indicator in the SCI is set to groupcast or broadcast; and
B4860: 5>if a CAPC value of the SL data has an equal or smaller CAPC value than a CAPC value indicated in the COT sharing information; and
B4861: 5>SL data is available for transmission; and
B4862: 5>SBj > 0, in case there is any logical channel having SBj > 0; and
B4863: 5>sl-configuredGrantType1Allowed, if configured, is set to true in case the SL grant is a Configured Grant Type 1; and
B4864: 5>sl-AllowedCG-List, if configured, includes the configured grant index associated to the SL grant; and
B4865: 5>sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to disabled, if PSFCH is not configured for the SL grant associated to the SCI.
B4866: 2>else if sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfig or sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfigCommon is not configured according to TS 38.331 [5]; and
B4867: 2>if the new transmission is not associated to a sidelink grant on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool:
B4868: 3>select a Destination associated to one of unicast, groupcast and broadcast, that is in the SL Active time for the SL transmission occasion if SL DRX is applied for the destination, and having at least one of the MAC CE and the logical channel and pending SL-PRS transmission(s) with the highest priority, among the logical channels that satisfy all the following conditions and MAC CE(s), if any, and SL-PRS(s), if any, for the SL grant associated to the SCI:
B4869: 4>SL data is available for transmission; and
B4870: 4>SBj > 0, in case there is any logical channel having SBj > 0; and
B4871: 4>sl-configuredGrantType1Allowed, if configured, is set to true in case the SL grant is a Configured Grant Type 1; and
B4872: 4>sl-AllowedCG-List, if configured, includes the configured grant index associated to the SL grant; and
B4873: 4>sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to disabled, if PSFCH is not configured for the SL grant associated to the SCI; and
B4874: 4>allowed on the carrier where the SCI is transmitted, if the carrier is configured by upper layers according to TS 38.331 [5] and TS 23.287 [19], if multiple carrier frequencies are configured and if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 2; and
B4875: 4>having a priority whose associated sl-threshCBR-FreqReselection is no lower than the CBR of the carrier when the carrier is (re-)selected in accordance with clause 5.22.1.11, if multiple carrier frequencies are configured and if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 2.
B4876: NOTE 1:If multiple Destinations have the logical channels satisfying all conditions above with the same highest priority or if multiple Destinations have either the MAC CE and/or the logical channels satisfying all conditions above with the same priority as the MAC CE, which Destination is selected among them is up to UE implementation.
B4877: 1>select the logical channels satisfying all the following conditions among the logical channels belonging to the selected Destination when the new transmission is not associated to a sidelink grant on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool:
B4878: 2>SL data is available for transmission; and
B4879: 2>sl-configuredGrantType1Allowed, if configured, is set to true in case the SL grant is a Configured Grant Type 1; and.
B4880: 2>sl-AllowedCG-List, if configured, includes the configured grant index associated to the SL grant; and
B4881: 2>allowed on the carrier where the SCI is transmitted, if the carrier is configured by upper layers according to TS 38.331 [5] and TS 23.287 [19], if multiple carrier frequencies are configured and if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 2; and
B4882: 2>having a priority whose associated sl-threshCBR-FreqReselection is no lower than the CBR of the carrier when the carrier is (re-)selected in accordance with clause 5.22.1.11, if multiple carrier frequencies are configured if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 2; and
B4883: 2>CAPC value of the SL data has an equal or smaller CAPC value than a CAPC value indicated in the COT sharing information if MAC decides to use the shared COT; and
B4884: 2>sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to the value that satisfies the following conditions:
B4885: 3>if PSFCH is configured for the sidelink grant associated to the SCI and the UE is capable of PSFCH reception:
B4886: 4>sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to enabled, if sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to enabled for the highest priority logical channel satisfying the above conditions; or
B4887: 4>sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to disabled, if sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to disabled for the highest priority logical channel satisfying the above conditions.
B4888: 3>else:
B4889: 4>sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to disabled.
B4890: NOTE 2:HARQ feedback enabled/disabled indicator is set to disabled for the transmission of a MAC PDU only carrying Sidelink MAC CE(s), e.g. Sidelink CSI reporting MAC CE, Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE, Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE or Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE.
B4891: 5.22.1.4.1.3Allocation of sidelink resources
B4892: The MAC entity shall for each sidelink grant associated with Shared SL-PRS resource pool:
B4893: 1>if there is SL-PRS pending for transmission for the selected destination:
B4894: 2>derive Transport Block Size for a new transmission for SL-SCH assuming SL-PRS can be transmitted in the sidelink grant according to clause 8.1.3.2 in TS 38.214 [7];
B4895: 2>if all the SL-SCH data within logical channel with higher priority than that of the SL-PRS can be allocated with resources:
B4896: 3>determine that the pending SL-PRS can be transmitted in the sidelink grant.
B4897: 2>else:
B4898: 3>determine that the pending SL-PRS cannot be transmitted in the sidelink grant;
B4899: 3>derive the Transport Block Size for a new transmission for SL-SCH with no SL-PRS according to clause 8.1.3.2 in TS 38.214 [7].
B4900: The MAC entity shall for each SCI corresponding to a new transmission for SL-SCH:
B4901: 1>allocate resources to the logical channels as follows:
B4902: 2>logical channels selected in clause 5.22.1.4.1.2 for the SL grant with SBj > 0 are allocated resources in a decreasing priority order. If the sPBR of a logical channel is set to infinity, the MAC entity shall allocate resources for all the data that is available for transmission on the logical channel before meeting the sPBR of the lower priority logical channel(s);
B4903: 2>decrement SBj by the total size of MAC SDUs served to logical channel j above;
B4904: 2>if any resources remain, all the logical channels selected in clause 5.22.1.4.1.2 are served in a strict decreasing priority order (regardless of the value of SBj) until either the data for that logical channel or the SL grant is exhausted, whichever comes first. Logical channels configured with equal priority should be served equally.
B4905: NOTE 1:The value of SBj can be negative.
B4906: The UE shall also follow the rules below during the SL scheduling procedures above:
B4907: -the UE should not segment an RLC SDU (or partially transmitted SDU or retransmitted RLC PDU) if the whole SDU (or partially transmitted SDU or retransmitted RLC PDU) fits into the remaining resources of the associated MAC entity;
B4908: -if the UE segments an RLC SDU from the logical channel, it shall maximize the size of the segment to fill the grant of the associated MAC entity as much as possible;
B4909: -the UE should maximise the transmission of data;
B4910: -if the MAC entity is given a sidelink grant size that is equal to or larger than 12 bytes while having data available and allowed (according to clause 5.22.1.4.1) for transmission, the MAC entity shall not transmit only padding;
B4911: -A logical channel configured with sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled set to enabled and a logical channel configured with sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled set to disabled cannot be multiplexed into the same MAC PDU.
B4912: The MAC entity shall not generate a MAC PDU for the HARQ entity if the following conditions are satisfied:
B4913: -there is no Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE generated for this PSSCH transmission as specified in clause 5.22.1.7; and
B4914: -there is no Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE generated for this PSSCH transmission as specified in clause 5.22.1.8; and
B4915: -there is no Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE generated for this PSSCH transmission as specified in clause 5.22.1.9; and
B4916: -there is no Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE generated for this PSSCH transmission as specified in clause 5.22.1.10; and
B4917: -the MAC PDU includes zero MAC SDUs and the MAC PDU is not associated with SL-PRS transmission on Shared SL-PRS resource pool.
B4918: Logical channels shall be prioritised in accordance with the following order (highest priority listed first):
B4919: -data from SCCH;
B4920: -Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE;
B4921: -Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE and Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE;
B4922: -Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE;
B4923: -data from any STCH or SL-PRS.
B4924: NOTE 2:The priority order between Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE and Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE is up to UE implementation.
B4925: 5.22.1.4.2Multiplexing of MAC Control Elements and MAC SDUs
B4926: The MAC entity shall multiplex MAC CEs and MAC SDUs in a MAC PDU according to clauses 5.22.1.4.1 and 6.1.6.
B4927: 5.22.1.5Scheduling Request
B4928: In addition to clause 5.4.4, the Scheduling Request (SR) is also used for requesting SL-SCH resources for new transmission when triggered by the Sidelink BSR (clause 5.22.1.6) or the SL-CSI reporting (clause 5.22.1.7) or SL-DRX Command indication. The Scheduling Request (SR) is also used for requesting SL-PRS resources for new transmission when triggered by SL-PRS resource request (clause 5.22.1.12). If configured, the MAC entity performs the SR procedure as specified in this clause unless otherwise specified in clause 5.4.4. For a sidelink logical channel or for SL-CSI reporting or for SL-DRX Command indication or for Sidelink consistent LBT failure recovery or for SL-PRS Resource Request, at most one PUCCH resource for SR is configured per UL BWP.
B4929: The SR configuration of the logical channel that triggered the Sidelink BSR (clause 5.22.1.6) is also considered as corresponding SR configuration for the triggered SR (clause 5.4.4). The value of the priority of the triggered SR corresponds to the value of priority of the logical channel that triggered the SR.
B4930: Each sidelink logical channel and Sidelink consistent LBT failure recovery may be mapped to zero or one SR configuration, which is configured by RRC. If the SL-CSI reporting procedure is enabled by RRC, the SL-CSI reporting is mapped to one SR configuration for all PC5-RRC connections. The SR configuration of the SL-CSI reporting triggered according to 5.22.1.7 is considered as corresponding SR configuration for the triggered SR (clause 5.4.4). The value of the priority of the triggered SR triggered by SL-CSI reporting corresponds to the value of the priority of the Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE. The SR configuration of the SL-CSI reporting is considered as corresponding SR configuration for the triggered SR of SL-DRX Command indication triggered according to 5.28.3. The value of the priority of the triggered SR triggered by SL-DRX Command indication corresponds to the value of the priority of the Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE. The SR configuration of the Sidelink consistent LBT failure recovery triggered according to 5.31.2 is considered as corresponding SR configuration for the triggered SR (clause 5.4.4). The value of the priority of the triggered SR triggered by Sidelink consistent LBT failure recovery corresponds to the value of the priority of the SL LBT failure MAC CE. SL-PRS resource request may be mapped to zero or one SR configuration, which is configured by RRC. The value of the priority of the triggered SR triggered by SL-PRS resource request corresponds to the lowest value of the priority of all SL-PRS(s) indicated in the SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE.
B4931: All pending SR(s) triggered according to the Sidelink BSR procedure (clause 5.22.1.6) prior to the MAC PDU assembly shall be cancelled and each respective sr-ProhibitTimer shall be stopped when the MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes an SL-BSR MAC CE which contains buffer status up to (and including) the last event that triggered a Sidelink BSR (see clause 5.22.1.4) prior to the MAC PDU assembly.
B4932: All pending SR(s) triggered according to the Sidelink consistent LBT failure recovery (clause 5.31.2) shall be cancelled and each respective sr-ProhibitTimer shall be stopped when the MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes an SL LBT failure MAC CE that indicates Sidelink consistent LBT failure or when all the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure(s) for an SL BWP is cancelled.
B4933: All pending SR(s) triggered according to the Sidelink BSR procedure (clause 5.22.1.6) shall be cancelled and each respective sr-ProhibitTimer shall be stopped when the SL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data available for transmission in sidelink.
B4934: If there is pending SR triggered by Sidelink consistent LBT failure recovery which has no corresponding SR configuration, MAC entity initiate a Random Access procedure (see clause 5.1) on the Serving Cell and cancel the pending SR.
B4935: The pending SR triggered according to the SL-CSI reporting for a destination shall be cancelled and each respective sr-ProhibitTimer shall be stopped when the SL grant(s) can accommodate the Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE when the SL-CSI reporting that has been triggered but not cancelled or when the triggered SL-CSI reporting is cancelled due to latency non-fulfilment as specified in 5.22.1.7. The pending SR triggered according to the SL-DRX Command indication for a destination shall be cancelled and each respective sr-ProhibitTimer shall be stopped when the SL grant(s) can accommodate the Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE when the SL-DRX Command indication that has been triggered but not cancelled. All pending SR(s) triggered by either Sidelink BSR or Sidelink CSI report or Sidelink DRX Command indication shall be cancelled, when RRC configures Sidelink resource allocation mode 2.
B4936: All pending SR(s) triggered according to the SL-PRS Resource Request procedure (clause 5.22.1.12) prior to the MAC PDU assembly shall be cancelled and each respective sr-ProhibitTimer shall be stopped when the MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes an SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE which contains status of the pending aperiodic SL-PRS transmission(s) up to (and including) the last event that triggered a SL-PRS Resource Request (see clause 5.22.1.12) prior to the MAC PDU assembly.
B4937: All pending SR(s) triggered according to the SL-PRS Resource Request procedure (clause 5.22.1.12) shall be cancelled and each respective sr-ProhibitTimer shall be stopped when the SL grant(s) can accommodate the all the pending aperiodic SL-PRS transmission(s).
B4938: 5.22.1.6Buffer Status Reporting
B4939: The Sidelink Buffer Status reporting (SL-BSR) procedure is used to provide the serving gNB with information about SL data volume in the MAC entity.
B4940: RRC configures the following parameters to control the SL-BSR:
B4941: -sl-periodicBSR-Timer, configured by periodicBSR-Timer in sl-BSR-Config;
B4942: -sl-retxBSR-Timer, configured by retxBSR-Timer in sl-BSR-Config;
B4943: -sl-logicalChannelSR-DelayTimerApplied;
B4944: -sl-logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer, configured by logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer in sl-BSR-Config;
B4945: -sl-logicalChannelGroup.
B4946: Each logical channel which belongs to a Destination is allocated to an LCG as specified in TS 38.331 [5]. The maximum number of LCGs is eight.
B4947: The MAC entity determines the amount of SL data available for a logical channel according to the data volume calculation procedure in TSs 38.322 [3] and 38.323 [4].
B4948: An SL-BSR shall be triggered if any of the following events occur:
B4949: 1>if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 1:
B4950: 2>SL data, for a logical channel which belongs to an LCG of a Destination, becomes available to the MAC entity; and either
B4951: 3>this SL data belongs to a logical channel with higher priority than the priorities of the logical channels containing available SL data which belong to any LCG belonging to the same Destination; or
B4952: 3>none of the logical channels which belong to an LCG belonging to the same Destination contains any available SL data.
B4953: in which case the SL-BSR is referred below to as 'Regular SL-BSR';
B4954: 2>UL resources are allocated and number of padding bits remaining after a Padding BSR has been triggered is equal to or larger than the size of the SL-BSR MAC CE plus its subheader, in which case the SL-BSR is referred below to as 'Padding SL-BSR';
B4955: 2>sl-retxBSR-Timer expires, and at least one of the logical channels which belong to an LCG contains SL data, in which case the SL-BSR is referred below to as 'Regular SL-BSR';
B4956: 2>sl-periodicBSR-Timer expires, in which case the SL-BSR is referred below to as 'Periodic SL-BSR'.
B4957: 1>else:
B4958: 2>Sidelink resource allocation mode 1 is configured by RRC and SL data is available for transmission in the RLC entity or in the PDCP entity, in which case the Sidelink BSR is referred below to as 'Regular SL-BSR'.
B4959: For Regular SL-BSR, the MAC entity shall:
B4960: 1>if the SL-BSR is triggered for a logical channel for which sl-logicalChannelSR-DelayTimerApplied with value true is configured by RRC:
B4961: 2>start or restart the sl-logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer.
B4962: 1>else:
B4963: 2>if running, stop the sl-logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer.
B4964: For Regular and Periodic SL-BSR, the MAC entity shall:
B4965: 1>if sl-PrioritizationThres is configured and the value of the highest priority of the logical channels that belong to any LCG and contain SL data for any Destination is lower than sl-PrioritizationThres; and
B4966: 1>if ul-PrioritizationThres is configured and the value of the highest priority of the logical channels that belong to any LCG and contain UL data is equal to or higher than ul-PrioritizationThres according to clause 5.4.5:
B4967: 2>prioritize the LCG(s) for the Destination(s).
B4968: 1>if the Buffer Status reporting procedure determines that at least one BSR has been triggered and not cancelled according to clause 5.4.5 and the UL grant cannot accommodate an SL-BSR MAC CE containing buffer status only for all prioritized LCGs having data available for transmission plus the subheader of the SL-BSR according to clause 5.4.3.1.3, in case the SL-BSR is considered as not prioritized:
B4969: 2>prioritize the SL-BSR for logical channel prioritization specified in clause 5.4.3.1;
B4970: 2>report Truncated SL-BSR containing buffer status for as many prioritized LCGs having data available for transmission as possible, taking the number of bits in the UL grant into consideration.
B4971: 1>else if the number of bits in the UL grant is expected to be equal to or larger than the size of an SL-BSR containing buffer status for all LCGs having data available for transmission plus the subheader of the SL-BSR according to clause 5.4.3.1.3:
B4972: 2>report SL-BSR containing buffer status for all LCGs having data available for transmission.
B4973: 1>else:
B4974: 2>report Truncated SL-BSR containing buffer status for as many LCGs having data available for transmission as possible, taking the number of bits in the UL grant into consideration.
B4975: For Padding SL-BSR:
B4976: 1>if the number of padding bits remaining after a Padding BSR has been triggered is equal to or larger than the size of an SL-BSR containing buffer status for all LCGs having data available for transmission plus its subheader:
B4977: 2>report SL-BSR containing buffer status for all LCGs having data available for transmission;
B4978: 1>else:
B4979: 2>report Truncated SL-BSR containing buffer status for as many LCGs having data available for transmission as possible, taking the number of bits in the UL grant into consideration.
B4980: For SL-BSR triggered by sl-retxBSR-Timer expiry, the MAC entity considers that the logical channel that triggered the SL-BSR is the highest priority logical channel that has data available for transmission at the time the SL-BSR is triggered.
B4981: The MAC entity shall:
B4982: 1>if the sidelink Buffer Status reporting procedure determines that at least one SL-BSR has been triggered and not cancelled:
B4983: 2>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the SL-BSR MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization according to clause 5.4.3.1:
B4984: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure in clause 5.4.3 to generate the SL-BSR MAC CE(s);
B4985: 3>start or restart sl-periodicBSR-Timer except when all the generated SL-BSRs are Truncated SL-BSRs;
B4986: 3>start or restart sl-retxBSR-Timer.
B4987: 2>if a Regular SL-BSR has been triggered and sl-logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer is not running:
B4988: 3>if there is no UL-SCH resource available for a new transmission; or
B4989: 3>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and the UL-SCH resources cannot accommodate the SL-BSR MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization according to clause 5.4.3.1; or
B4990: 3>if the set of Subcarrier Spacing index values in sl-AllowedSCS-List, if configured for the logical channel that triggered the SL-BSR, does not include the Subcarrier Spacing index associated to the UL-SCH resources available for a new transmission; or
B4991: 3>if sl-MaxPUSCH-Duration, if configured for the logical channel that triggered the SL-BSR, is smaller than the PUSCH transmission duration associated to the UL-SCH resources available for a new transmission:
B4992: 4>trigger a Scheduling Request.
B4993: NOTE 1:UL-SCH resources are considered available if the MAC entity has an active configured grant, or receives, or determines an uplink grant. If the MAC entity has determined at a given point in time that UL-SCH resources are available, this need not imply that UL-SCH resources are available for use at that point in time.
B4994: A MAC PDU shall contain at most one SL-BSR MAC CE, even when multiple events have triggered an SL-BSR. The Regular SL-BSR and the Periodic SL-BSR shall have precedence over the padding SL-BSR.
B4995: The MAC entity shall restart sl-retxBSR-Timer upon reception of an SL grant for transmission of new data on any SL-SCH.
B4996: All triggered SL-BSRs may be cancelled when the SL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data available for transmission. All BSRs triggered prior to MAC PDU assembly shall be cancelled when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes an SL-BSR MAC CE which contains buffer status up to (and including) the last event that triggered an SL-BSR prior to the MAC PDU assembly. All triggered SL-BSRs shall be cancelled, and sl-retx-BSR-Timer and sl-periodic-BSR-Timer shall be stopped, when RRC configures Sidelink resource allocation mode 2.
B4997: NOTE 2:MAC PDU assembly can happen at any point in time between uplink grant reception and actual transmission of the corresponding MAC PDU. SL-BSR and SR can be triggered after the assembly of a MAC PDU which contains an SL-BSR MAC CE, but before the transmission of this MAC PDU. In addition, SL-BSR and SR can be triggered during MAC PDU assembly.
B4998: 5.22.1.7CSI Reporting
B4999: The Sidelink Channel State Information (SL-CSI) reporting procedure is used to provide a peer UE with sidelink channel state information per carrier as specified in clause 8.5 of TS 38.214 [7].
B5000: RRC configures the following parameters to control the SL-CSI reporting procedure:
B5001: -sl-LatencyBoundCSI-Report, which is maintained for each PC5-RRC connection.
B5002: The MAC entity maintains an sl-CSI-ReportTimer for each carrier of a pair of the Source Layer-2 ID and the Destination Layer-2 ID corresponding to a PC5-RRC connection. sl-CSI-ReportTimer is used for an SL-CSI reporting UE to follow the latency requirement signalled from a CSI triggering UE. The value of sl-CSI-ReportTimer is the same as the‎ latency requirement of the SL-CSI reporting in sl-LatencyBoundCSI-Report configured by RRC.
B5003: The Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE can only be transmitted on the carrier where the SL-CSI request is received.
B5004: The MAC entity shall for each carrier of a pair of the Source Layer-2 ID and the Destination Layer-2 ID corresponding to a PC5-RRC connection which has been established by upper layers:
B5005: 1>if the SL-CSI reporting has been triggered for a carrier by an SCI and not cancelled:
B5006: 2>if the sl-CSI-ReportTimer for the triggered SL-CSI reporting is not running:
B5007: 3>start the sl-CSI-ReportTimer for the carrier.
B5008: 2>if the sl-CSI-ReportTimer for the triggered SL-CSI reporting expires:
B5009: 3>cancel the triggered SL-CSI reporting for the carrier.
B5010: 2>else if the MAC entity has SL resources allocated for new transmission on the carrier where the corresponding SL-CSI request is received and the SL-SCH resources can accommodate the SL-CSI reporting MAC CE and its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B5011: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate a Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.35;
B5012: 3>stop the sl-CSI-ReportTimer for the triggered SL-CSI reporting of the carrier;
B5013: 3>cancel the triggered SL-CSI reporting of the carrier.
B5014: 2>else if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 1:
B5015: 3>trigger a Scheduling Request.
