B5016: NOTE 1:The MAC entity configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 1 may trigger a Scheduling Request if transmission of a pending SL-CSI reporting with the sidelink grant(s) cannot fulfil the latency requirement associated to the SL-CSI reporting.
B5017: NOTE 2:Void.
B5018: 5.22.1.8Void
B5019: 5.22.1.9IUC-Request transmission
B5020: The Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request transmission procedure is used to trigger a peer UE to transmit Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information.
B5021: RRC configures sl-TransmissionStructureForPSCCHandPSSCH parameter to control the inter-UE coordination request procedure. For a resource pool in a SL BWP where sl-TransmissionStructureForPSCCHandPSSCH is configured as interlaceRB, the Enhanced Inter-UE coordination Request MAC CE is used. Otherwise, the Sidelink Inter-UE coordination Request MAC CE is used.
B5022: The MAC entity shall for each pair of the Source Layer-2 ID and the Destination Layer-2 ID corresponding to a PC5-RRC connection which has been established by upper layers:
B5023: 1>if a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request has been triggered and the MAC entity has SL resources allocated for new transmission and the SL-SCH resources can accommodate the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE or the Enhanced Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE and its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B5024: 2>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE or an Enhanced Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.54;
B5025: 2>cancel the triggered Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request.
B5026: 5.22.1.10IUC-Information Reporting
B5027: 5.22.1.10.1General
B5028: The Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information reporting procedure is used to provide a peer UE with inter-UE coordination information as specified in clause 8.1.4 of TS 38.214 [7]. The Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information reporting procedure can be triggered by Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE only, both Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE and SCI (See TS 38.214 [7]), or condition (See TS 38.331 [5] and TS 38.214 [7]). Unicast for preferred resource set and non-preferred resource set and Groupcast/Broadcast for non-preferred resource set are supported for inter-UE coordination information transmission triggered by a condition other than explicit request reception. Unicast for preferred resource set and non-preferred resource set is supported for inter-UE coordination information transmission triggered by an explicit request.
B5029: RRC also configures sl-TransmissionStructureForPSCCHandPSSCH parameter to control the inter-UE coordination Information reporting procedure. For a resource pool in a SL BWP where sl-TransmissionStructureForPSCCHandPSSCH is configured as interlaceRB, the Enhanced Inter-UE coordination Information MAC CE is used. Otherwise, the Sidelink Inter-UE coordination Information MAC CE is used.
B5030: RRC configures the following parameter to control the SL-IUC Information reporting procedure:
B5031: -sl-LatencyBoundIUC-Report, which is maintained for each PC5-RRC connection.
B5032: The MAC entity maintains an sl-IUC-ReportTimer for each pair of the Source Layer-2 ID and the Destination Layer-2 ID corresponding to a PC5-RRC connection. sl-IUC-ReportTimer is used for an SL-IUC Information reporting UE to follow the latency requirement signalled from an IUC-Information triggering UE. The value of sl-IUC-ReportTimer is the same as the‎ latency requirement of the SL-IUC Information in sl-LatencyBoundIUC-Report configured by RRC.
B5033: The MAC entity shall for each pair of the Source Layer-2 ID and the Destination Layer-2 ID corresponding to a PC5-RRC connection which has been established by upper layers:
B5034: 1>if the SL-IUC Information reporting has been triggered by an Sidelink Inter-UE coordination Request MAC CE alone, or by both a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE and an SCI, and not cancelled:
B5035: 2>if the sl-IUC-ReportTimer for the triggered SL-IUC Information reporting is not running:
B5036: 3>start the sl-IUC-ReportTimer.
B5037: 2>if the sl-IUC-ReportTimer for the triggered SL-IUC Information reporting expires:
B5038: 3>cancel the triggered SL-IUC Information reporting.
B5039: 2>else if the MAC entity has SL resources allocated for new transmission and the SL-SCH resources can accommodate the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE and its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B5040: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.53;
B5041: 3>stop the sl-IUC-ReportTimer for the triggered SL-IUC Information reporting;
B5042: 3>cancel the triggered SL-IUC Information reporting.
B5043: The MAC entity shall for each Destination Layer-2 ID:
B5044: 1>if a SL-IUC Information reporting has been triggered by a condition and the MAC entity has SL resources allocated for new transmission and the SL-SCH resources can accommodate the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE or the Enhanced Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE and its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B5045: 2>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE or an Enhanced Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.53;
B5046: 2>cancel the triggered SL-IUC Information reporting.
B5047: 5.22.1.10.2Reception of IUC-Information Reporting
B5048: Upon the reception of Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE from another UE, the MAC entity shall:
B5049: 1>if sl-InterUE-CoordinationScheme1 enabling reception/transmission of preferred resource set and non-preferred resource set is configured by RRC:
B5050: 2>if the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE contains a non-preferred resource set and if the UE is configured to use full sensing or partial sensing in the resource pool where the non-preferred resource set is located:
B5051: 3>indicate the received non-preferred resource set to physical layer.
B5052: 5.22.1.11TX carrier (re-)selection
B5053: The MAC entity shall consider a CBR of a carrier to be one measured by lower layers according to TS 38.215 [24] if CBR measurement results are available, or the corresponding sl-DefaultTxConfigIndex configured by upper layers if CBR measurement results are not available.
B5054: If the TX carrier (re-)selection is triggered for a Sidelink process according to clause 5.22.1.1, 5.22.1.2 or 5.22.1.3.3, the MAC entity shall:
B5055: 1>if there is no selected sidelink grant on any carrier allowed for the sidelink logical channel where data is available as indicated by upper layers (TS 38.331 [5] and TS 23.287 [19]):
B5056: 2>for each carrier configured by upper layers associated with the concerned sidelink logical channel:
B5057: 3>if the CBR of the carrier is below sl-threshCBR-FreqReselection associated with the priority of the sidelink logical channel:
B5058: NOTE 1:In the case of multiple resource pools configured on a carrier, which specific resource pool is used to determine the CBR of this carrier is up to UE implementation, taking into account of sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled for the sidelink logical channel.
B5059: 4>consider the carrier as a candidate carrier for TX carrier (re-)selection for the concerned sidelink logical channel.
B5060: 1>else:
B5061: 2>for each sidelink logical channel, if any, where data is available and allowed on the carrier(s) for which Tx carrier (re-)selection is triggered according to clause 5.22.1.1, if the CBR of the carrier(s) is below sl-threshCBR-FreqKeeping associated with priority of the sidelink logical channel:
B5062: 3>select the carrier(s) and the associated pool of resources.
B5063: 2>else:
B5064: 3>for each carrier configured by upper layers on which the sidelink logical channel is allowed, if the CBR of the carrier is below sl-threshCBR-FreqReselection associated with the priority of the sidelink logical channel:
B5065: 4>consider the carrier as a candidate carrier for TX carrier (re-)selection, for each carrier configured by upper layers on which the sidelink logical channel is allowed.
B5066: NOTE 1a:For the carriers configured in SIB12 and for which SL-PRS transmission is allowed, the UE selects one carrier for SL-PRS among the selected carriers per above procedure, and which one the UE selects is up to UE implementation.
B5067: The MAC entity shall select the carrier on which the SL-CSI Request was received as the carrier for transmission of a Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE. The MAC entity shall for the Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE select any pool of resources among the pools of resources except the pool(s) in sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfig, sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfigCommon, sl-BWP-PoolConfigA2X or sl-BWP-PoolConfigCommonA2X, if configured or Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool, if configured.
B5068: The MAC entity shall select the carrier on which a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request was received as the carrier for transmission of a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE.
B5069: The MAC entity shall select the carrier on which IUC resource set(s) are located as the carrier for transmission of a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE triggered by condition.
B5070: The MAC entity shall select the carrier where the IUC resource set(s) are required as the carrier for transmission of a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE.
B5071: The MAC entity shall for the Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE or Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE select any pool of resources among the pools of resources except the pool(s) in sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfig, sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfigCommon, sl-BWP-PoolConfigA2X or sl-BWP-PoolConfigCommonA2X, if configured or Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool, if configured.
B5072: The MAC entity shall perform the TX carrier (re-)selection such as TX carrier (re-)selection for the logical channel when TX carrier (re-)selection for a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE, and/or a Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE is triggered.
B5073: The MAC entity shall:
B5074: 1>if one or more carriers are considered as the candidate carriers for TX carrier (re-)selection:
B5075: 2>if Tx carrier (re-)selection is triggered, for each sidelink logical channel allowed on the carrier where data is available:
B5076: 3>select one or more carrier(s) among the candidate carriers with increasing order of CBR from the lowest CBR, and select the associated pool(s) of resources:
B5077: 4>if sl-HARQ-FeedbackEnabled is set to enabled for the sidelink logical channel:
B5078: 5>select one pool of resources configured with PSFCH resources among the pools of resources except the pool(s) in sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfig or sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfigCommon, sl-BWP-PoolConfigA2X or sl-BWP-PoolConfigCommonA2X, if configured or Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool, if configured.
B5079: 4>else:
B5080: 5>select any pool of resources among the pools of resources except the pool(s) in sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfig or sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfigCommon, sl-BWP-PoolConfigA2X or sl-BWP-PoolConfigCommonA2X, if configured or Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool, if configured.
B5081: 2>else if Tx carrier (re-)selection is triggered, for a Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE or a Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE:
B5082: 3>select any pool of resources among the pools of resources except the pool(s) in sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfig, sl-BWP-DiscPoolConfigCommon, sl-BWP-PoolConfigA2X or sl-BWP-PoolConfigCommonA2X, if configured or SL-PRS dedicated resource pool, if configured.
B5083: NOTE 2:It is left to UE implementation how many carriers to select based on UE capability.
B5084: NOTE 3:It is left to UE implementation to determine the sidelink logical channels among the sidelink logical channels where data is available and that are allowed on the carrier for which Tx carrier (re-) selection is triggered.
B5085: NOTE 4:It is left to UE implementation to determine whether the resource pool for CBR measurement is reused as the resource pool for SL grant creation.
B5086: NOTE 5:For the transmission of Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Request MAC CE, the MAC entity selects the TX pool of resource where the IUC resource set is required. For the transmission of Sidelink Inter-UE Coordination Information MAC CE, the MAC entity selects the TX pool of resource where the IUC resource set is located.
B5087: NOTE 6:If RRC indicates the MAC layer to use the legacy carrier in Sidelink CA PDCP duplication for backwards-compatibility, it is up to UE/Network implementation to ensure legacy carrier is used.
B5088: 5.22.1.12SL-PRS Resource Request
B5089: SL-PRS transmission can be triggered either by lower layer signalling from the peer UE or the UE's own upper layers. The SL-PRS Resource Request procedure is used to provide gNB with information about the triggered SL-PRS transmission.
B5090: The MAC entity shall, if Sidelink resource allocation scheme 1 for SL-PRS transmission is configured:
B5091: 1>if aperiodic SL-PRS is triggered:
B5092: 2>trigger the SL-PRS Resource Request.
B5093: The MAC entity shall:
B5094: 1>if SL-PRS Resource Request is triggered and not cancelled:
B5095: 2>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and these UL-SCH resources can accommodate the SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B5096: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly entity to generate the SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE.
B5097: 2>else:
B5098: 3>trigger a Scheduling Request for the SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE as specified in clause 5.4.4.
B5099: The triggered SL-PRS Resource Request may be cancelled when SL grant can accommodate all the pending aperiodic SL-PRS transmissions. The triggered SL-PRS Resource Request shall be cancelled when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes a SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE that indicates request for all the pending aperiodic SL-PRS transmission(s) since the last transmission of the MAC CE.
B5100: 5.22.2SL-SCH Data and SL-PRS reception
B5101: 5.22.2.1SCI reception
B5102: SCI indicates if there is a transmission on SL-SCH and provide the relevant HARQ information. SCI can also indicate if there is a SL-PRS transmission. An SCI for SL-SCH transmission with or without corresponding SL-PRS on Shared SL-PRS resource pool consists of two parts: the 1st stage SCI on PSCCH and the 2nd stage SCI on PSSCH as specified in clause 8.1 of TS 38.214 [7]. An SCI for SL-PRS transmission on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool consists of a single part on PSCCH as specified in TS 38.212 [9].
B5103: The MAC entity shall:
B5104: 1>for each PSCCH duration during which the MAC entity monitors PSCCH:
B5105: 2>if a 1st stage SCI has been received on the PSCCH:
B5106: 3>determine the set of PSSCH durations in which reception of a 2nd stage SCI and the transport block occur using the received part of the SCI;
B5107: 3>if the 2nd stage SCI for this PSSCH duration has been received on the PSSCH:
B5108: 4>store the SCI as a valid SCI for the PSSCH durations corresponding to transmission(s) of the transport block and SL-PRS, if available and the associated HARQ information and QoS information;
B5109: 2>else if an SCI has been received on the PSCCH reception on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool for SL-PRS transmission:
B5110: 3>determine the SL-PRS transmission occasion corresponding to the SCI;
B5111: 3>store the SCI as a valid SCI for the SL-PRS transmission and the corresponding SL-PRS transmission information on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool.
B5112: 1>for each PSSCH duration for which the MAC entity has a valid SCI:
B5113: 2>deliver the SCI and the associated Sidelink transmission information to the Sidelink HARQ Entity.
B5114: 1>for each SL-PRS transmission occasion for which MAC entity has a valid SCI:
B5115: 2>perform SL-PRS reception according to the SL-PRS transmission information within the SCI as in clause 5.22.2.2.2 for SL-PRS received on Shared SL-PRS resource pool and as in clause 5.22.2.4 for SL-PRS received on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool.
B5116: 5.22.2.2Sidelink HARQ operation and SL-PRS reception on Shared SL-PRS resource pool
B5117: 5.22.2.2.1Sidelink HARQ Entity
B5118: There is at most one Sidelink HARQ Entity at the MAC entity for reception of the SL-SCH, which maintains a number of parallel Sidelink processes.
B5119: Each Sidelink process is associated with SCI in which the MAC entity is interested. This interest is determined by the Sidelink identification information of the SCI. The Sidelink HARQ Entity directs Sidelink transmission information and associated TBs received on the SL-SCH to the corresponding Sidelink processes.
B5120: The number of Receiving Sidelink processes associated with the Sidelink HARQ Entity is defined in TS 38.306 [5].
B5121: For each PSSCH duration, the Sidelink HARQ Entity shall:
B5122: 1>for each SCI valid for this PSSCH duration:
B5123: 2>if the NDI has been toggled compared to the value of the previous received transmission corresponding to the Sidelink identification information and the Sidelink process ID of the SCI or this is the very first received transmission for the pair of the Sidelink identification information and the Sidelink process ID of the SCI:
B5124: 3>if there is a Sidelink process associated with the Sidelink identification information and the Sidelink process ID of the SCI:
B5125: 4>consider the Sidelink process as unoccupied;
B5126: 4>flush the soft buffer for the Sidelink process.
B5127: 3>allocate the TB received from the physical layer and the associated Sidelink identification information and Sidelink process ID to an unoccupied Sidelink process;
B5128: 3>associate the Sidelink process with the Sidelink identification information and the Sidelink process ID of this SCI and consider this transmission to be a new transmission.
B5129: NOTE 1:When a new TB arrives, the Sidelink HARQ Entity allocates the TB to any unoccupied Sidelink process. If there is no unoccupied Sidelink process in the Sidelink HARQ entity, how to manage receiving Sidelink processes is up to UE implementation.
B5130: NOTE 1a:If the NDI has not been toggled compared to the value of the previous received transmission corresponding to the Sidelink identification information and the Sidelink process ID of the SCI, and if there is no Sidelink process associated with the Sidelink identification information and the Sidelink process ID of the SCI, it is up to UE implementation to handle the corresponding TB.
B5131: 1>for each Sidelink process:
B5132: 2>if the NDI has not been toggled compared to the value of the previous received transmission corresponding to the Sidelink identification information and the Sidelink process ID of the SCI for the Sidelink process according to its associated SCI:
B5133: 3>allocate the TB received from the physical layer to the Sidelink process and consider this transmission to be a retransmission.
B5134: NOTE 2:A single sidelink process can only be (re-)associated to a single combination of Sidelink identification information and Sidelink process ID at a time and a single combination of Sidelink identification information and Sidelink process ID can only be (re-)associated to a single sidelink process at a time.
B5135: 5.22.2.2.2Sidelink process
B5136: For each PSSCH duration where a transmission takes place for the Sidelink process, one TB and the associated HARQ information is received from the Sidelink HARQ Entity.
B5137: For each received TB and SL-PRS, if available and associated Sidelink transmission information, the Sidelink process shall:
B5138: 1>if this is a new transmission:
B5139: 2>attempt to decode the received data.
B5140: 1>else if this is a retransmission:
B5141: 2>if the data for this TB has not yet been successfully decoded:
B5142: 3>instruct the physical layer to combine the received data with the data currently in the soft buffer for this TB and attempt to decode the combined data.
B5143: 1>if the sidelink transmission information in the SCI indicates SL-PRS transmission:
B5144: 2>if the SL-PRS transmission is associated to unicast:
B5145: 3>if the DST field of the decoded MAC PDU subheader is equal to the 8 MSB of any of the Source Layer-2 ID(s) of the UE for which the 16 LSB are equal to the Destination ID in the corresponding SCI; and
B5146: 3>if the SRC field of the decoded MAC PDU subheader is equal to the 16 MSB of any of the Destination Layer-2 ID(s) of the UE for which the 8 LSB are equal to the Source ID in the corresponding SCI:
B5147: 4>instruct the physical layer to perform SL-PRS reception.
B5148: 2>else if the SL-PRS transmission is associated with groupcast or broadcast:
B5149: 3>if the DST field of the decoded MAC PDU subheader is equal to the 8 MSB of any of the Destination Layer-2 ID(s) of the UE for which the 16 LSB are equal to the Destination ID in the corresponding SCI:
B5150: 4>instruct the physical layer to perform SL-PRS reception.
B5151: 1>if the data which the MAC entity attempted to decode was successfully decoded for this TB; or
B5152: 1>if the data for this TB was successfully decoded before:
B5153: 2>if this is the first successful decoding of the data for this TB:
B5154: 3>if this TB is associated to unicast and the DST field of the decoded MAC PDU subheader is equal to the 8 MSB of any of the Source Layer-2 ID(s) of the UE for which the 16 LSB are equal to the Destination ID in the corresponding SCI:
B5155: 4>if the SRC field of the decoded MAC PDU subheader is equal to the 16 MSB of any of the Destination Layer-2 ID(s) of the UE for which the 8 LSB are equal to the Source ID in the corresponding SCI; or
B5156: 4>if this TB is corresponding to the logical channel with LCID equal to 0 or 1 and determined to be the first TB:
B5157: 5>deliver the decoded MAC PDU to the disassembly and demultiplexing entity.
B5158: 3>if this TB is associated to groupcast or broadcast:
B5159: 4>if the DST field of the decoded MAC PDU subheader is equal to the 8 MSB of any of the Destination Layer-2 ID(s) of the UE for which the 16 LSB are equal to the Destination ID in the corresponding SCI; or
B5160: 4>if this TB is corresponding to the logical channel with LCID equal to 58, and the DST field of the decoded MAC PDU subheader is equal to the 8 MSB of any of the Source Layer-2 ID(s) of the UE for which the 16 LSB are equal to the Destination ID in the corresponding SCI:
B5161: 5>deliver the decoded MAC PDU to the disassembly and demultiplexing entity.
B5162: NOTE:Whether the TB is the first TB can be determined based on the Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID pair.
B5163: 2>consider the Sidelink process as unoccupied.
B5164: 1>else:
B5165: 2>instruct the physical layer to replace the data in the soft buffer for this TB with the data which the MAC entity attempted to decode.
B5166: 1>if HARQ feedback is enabled by the SCI:
B5167: 2>if negative-only acknowledgement is indicated by the SCI according to clause 8.4.1 of TS 38.212 [9]:
B5168: 3>if UE's location information is available and distance beteween UE's location and the central location of the nearest zone that is calculated based on the Zone_id in the SCI and the value of sl-ZoneLength corresponding to the communication range requirement in the SCI as specified in TS 38.331 [5] is smaller or equal to the communication range requirement in the SCI; or
B5169: 3>if none of Zone_id and communication range requirement is indicated by the SCI; or
B5170: 3>if UE's location information is not available:
B5171: 4>if the data which the MAC entity attempted to decode was not successfully decoded for this TB and the data for this TB was not successfully decoded before:
B5172: 5>instruct the physical layer to generate a negative acknowledgement of the data in this TB.
B5173: 2>if negative-positive acknowledgement or unicast is indicated by the SCI according to clause 8.4.1 of TS 38.212 [9]:
B5174: 3>if the data which the MAC entity attempted to decode was successfully decoded for this TB or the data for this TB was successfully decoded before:
B5175: 4>instruct the physical layer to generate a positive acknowledgement of the data in this TB.
B5176: 3>else:
B5177: 4>instruct the physical layer to generate a negative acknowledgement of the data in this TB.
B5178: 5.22.2.3Disassembly and demultiplexing
B5179: The MAC entity shall disassemble and demultiplex a MAC PDU as defined in clause 6.1.6.
B5180: 5.22.2.4SL-PRS reception on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool
B5181: For each SL-PRS transmission occasion on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool, the MAC entity shall:
B5182: 1>if this SL-PRS transmission is associated to unicast:
B5183: 2>if the destination ID in the corresponding SCI is equal to the UE's source ID; and if the field sl-SRC-ID-LenDedicatedSL-PRS-RP is configured with the value of 12bit:
B5184: 3>if source ID in the corresponding SCI is equal to the 12 LSB of the UE's destination layer-2 ID:
B5185: 4>instruct the physical layer to perform SL-PRS reception on the SL-PRS transmission occasion.
B5186: 2>else if the destination ID in the corresponding SCI is equal to the UE's source ID, and if the field sl-SRC-ID-LenDedicatedSL-PRS-RP is configured with the value of 24bit:
B5187: 3>if source ID in the corresponding SCI is equal to the UE's destination layer-2 ID:
B5188: 4>instruct the physical layer to perform SL-PRS reception on the SL-PRS transmission occasion.
B5189: 1>else if this SL-PRS transmission is associated to broadcast or groupcast:
B5190: 2>if the destination ID in the corresponding SCI is equal to the UE's destination layer-2 ID
B5191: 3>instruct the physical layer to perform SL-PRS reception on the SL-PRS transmission occasion.
B5192: 5.23SL-BCH data transfer
B5193: 5.23.1SL-BCH data transmission
B5194: When instructed to send SL-BCH, the MAC entity shall:
B5195: 1>obtain the MAC PDU to transmit from SBCCH;
B5196: 1>deliver the MAC PDU to the physical layer and instruct it to generate a transmission.
B5197: 5.23.2SL-BCH data reception
B5198: When the MAC entity needs to receive SL-BCH, the MAC entity shall:
B5199: 1>receive and attempt to decode the SL-BCH;
B5200: 1>if a TB on the SL-BCH has been successfully decoded:
B5201: 2>deliver the decoded MAC PDU to upper layers.
B5202: 5.24Handling of PRS Processing Window
B5203: When PPW is activated and PRS has higher priority than DL channel and signals, for the affected symbols within the PPW according to clause 5.1.6.5 in TS 38.214 [7], the MAC entity shall:
B5204: 1>if the ra-ResponseWindow or the ra-ContentionResolutionTimer or the msgB-ResponseWindow is running:
B5205: 2>monitor the PDCCH as specified in clauses 5.1.4, 5.1.4a and 5.1.5.
B5206: 1>else:
B5207: 2>not receive DL-SCH;
B5208: 2>not receive PDCCH.
B5209: 5.25Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request
B5210: If the UE is configured with pre-configured positioning measurement gap and the request of the activation/deactivation of the positioning measurement gap by UL MAC CE, the UE may request the network to activate or deactivate the Positioning measurement gap with UL MAC CE for Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request in clause 6.1.3.40.
B5211: The MAC entity shall, when triggered by the upper layer to send Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request, cancel the triggered Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request, if any and trigger another Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request according to the upper layer's request.
B5212: The MAC entity shall,
B5213: 1>if Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE has been triggered, and not cancelled:
B5214: 2>if indication from upper layer has been received that the triggered Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE should be cancelled; or
B5215: 2>if the pre-configured measurement gap indicated in the Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE has already been activated/deactivated according to clause 5.18.20:
B5216: 3>cancel the triggered Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE.
B5217: 2>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and these UL-SCH resources can accommodate the Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B5218: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE according to the upper layer's request;
B5219: 3>cancel triggered Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE.
B5220: 2>else:
B5221: 3>trigger a Scheduling Request for Positioning Measurement Gap Activation/Deactivation Request MAC CE as specified in clause 5.4.4.
B5222: 5.26Positioning SRS transmission in RRC_INACTIVE
B5223: 5.26.1General
B5224: Periodic and semi-persistent Positioning SRS with or without positioning SRS bandwidth aggregation can be configured for Positioning SRS transmission in RRC_INACTIVE.
B5225: SRS for positioning Tx frequency hopping can also be configured for Positioning SRS transmission in RRC_INACTIVE.
B5226: The MAC entity shall,
B5227: 1>if the TA of the configured Positioning SRS is valid according to clause 5.26.2, and the conditions for positioning SRS transmission in clause 7.3.1 of TS 38.213 [6] and clause 6.2.1.4 of TS 38.214 [7] are satisfied:
B5228: 2>instruct to the lower layer according to TS 38.214 [7] to transmit Periodic or Semi-Persistent Positioning SRS that is activated according to clause 5.18.17 or clause 5.18.37.
B5229: 5.26.2TA validation for SRS transmission in RRC_INACTIVE
B5230: RRC configures the following parameters for validation for SRS transmission in RRC_INACTIVE:
B5231: -inactivePosSRS-RSRP-ChangeThreshold: RSRP threshold for the increase/decrease of RSRP for time alignment validation;
B5232: -inactivePosSRS-ValidityAreaRSRP: RSRP threshold for the increase/decrease of RSRP for time alignment validation when SRS positioning validity area is configured.
B5233: The MAC entity shall:
B5234: 1>if the UE receives configuration for SRS transmission in RRC_INACTIVE:
B5235: 2>store the RSRP of the downlink pathloss reference with the current RSRP value of the downlink pathloss reference as in TS 38.331 [5].
B5236: 1>else if the UE is configured with SRS transmission in RRC_INACTIVE:
B5237: 2>if Timing Advance Command MAC CE is received as in clause 5.2, or;
B5238: 2>if Timing Advance Command or Absolute Timing Advance Command is received for Random Access procedure that is successfully completed:
B5239: 3>update the stored the RSRP of the downlink pathloss reference with the current RSRP value of the downlink pathloss reference.
B5240: 2>if the UE is configured Positioning with SRS with validity area and the upper layer indicates the MAC to update the stored RSRP:
B5241: 3>update the RSRP of the downlink pathloss reference with the current RSRP value of the downlink pathloss reference of the camped cell as specified in TS 38.331 [5].
B5242: The MAC entity shall consider the TA to be valid when the following conditions are fulfilled:
B5243: 1>compared to the stored downlink pathloss reference RSRP value, the current RSRP value of the downlink pathloss reference of the camped cell as specified in TS 38.331 [5] has not increased/decreased by more than inactivePosSRS-RSRP-ChangeThreshold, if configured, or inactivePosSRS-ValidityAreaRSRP, if configured, when SRS positioning validity area is configured; and
B5244: 1>inactivePosSRS-TimeAlignmentTimer is running or inactivePosSRS-ValidityAreaTAT is running when SRS positioning validity area is configured.
B5245: 5.27Small Data Transmission
B5246: 5.27.1General
B5247: The MAC entity may be configured by RRC with SDT and the SDT procedure may be initiated by RRC layer for MO-SDT or MT-SDT. The SDT procedure initiated for MO-SDT can be performed either by Random Access procedure with 2-step RA type or 4-step RA type (i.e., RA-SDT) or by configured grant Type 1 (i.e., CG-SDT). The SDT procedure initiated for MT-SDT cannot be performed by RA-SDT (i.e., RA-SDT is not applicable as specified in clause 5.1.1b), but can be performed either by Random Access procedure (i.e., with 2-step RA type or 4-step RA type) or by configured grant Type 1 (i.e., CG-SDT).
B5248: RRC configures the following parameters for SDT procedure:
B5249: -sdt-DataVolumeThreshold: data volume threshold for the UE to determine whether to perform SDT procedure initiated for MO-SDT;
B5250: -sdt-RSRP-Threshold: RSRP threshold for UE to determine whether to perform SDT procedure initiated for MO-SDT;
B5251: -mt-SDT-RSRP-Threshold: RSRP threshold for UE to determine whether to perform SDT procedure initiated for MT-SDT;
B5252: -cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB: an RSRP threshold configured for SSB selection for CG-SDT;
B5253: -cg-MT-SDT-MaxDurationToNextCG-Occasion: time threshold which is used by the UE to determine whether to perform CG-SDT for MT-SDT;
B5254: -cg-SDT-MaxDurationToNextCG-Occasion: time threshold configured per logical channel which is used by the UE to determine whether to perform CG-SDT for MO-SDT;
B5255: -sdt-BeamFailureRecoveryProhibitTimer: prohibit timer to avoid frequent triggering of Random Access procedure due to beam failure recovery during RA-SDT procedure or during MT-SDT procedure initiated by Random Access procedure.
B5256: The following UE variable is used for the SDT procedure:
B5257: -MAX_DURATION_TO_NEXT_CG_OCCASION;
B5258: -RSRP_THRESHOLD.
B5259: The MAC entity shall, if initiated by the upper layers for SDT procedure:
B5260: 1>if SDT procedure is initiated for MO-SDT as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B5261: 2>set the MAX_DURATION_TO_NEXT_CG_OCCASION to the shortest value of cg-SDT-MaxDurationToNextCG-Occasion, if configured, among all the logical channels configured with this parameter by upper layer and having data for transmission;
B5262: 2>set the RSRP_THRESHOLD to the value of sdt-RSRP-Threshold, if configured.
B5263: 1>else if SDT procedure is initiated for MT-SDT as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B5264: 2>set the MAX_DURATION_TO_NEXT_CG_OCCASION to the value of cg-MT-SDT-MaxDurationToNextCG-Occasion, if configured;
B5265: 2>if mt-SDT-RSRP-Threshold is configured:
B5266: 3>set the RSRP_THRESHOLD to the value of mt-SDT-RSRP-Threshold.
B5267: 2>else if sdt-RSRP-Threshold is configured:
B5268: 3>set the RSRP_THRESHOLD to the value of sdt-RSRP-Threshold.
B5269: 1>if the SDT procedure is initiated for MO-SDT as specified in TS 38.331 [5], and the data volume of the pending UL data across all RBs configured for SDT is less than or equal to sdt-DataVolumeThreshold, or if the SDT procedure is initiated for MT-SDT as specified in TS 38.331 [5]; and
B5270: NOTE 1:For SDT procedure, the MAC entity also considers the suspended RBs configured with SDT for data volume calculation. It is up to the UE's implementation how the UE calculates the data volume for the suspended RBs. Size of the CCCH message is not considered for data volume calculation
B5271: 1>if the RSRP of the downlink pathloss reference is higher than RSRP_THRESHOLD or if RSRP_THRESHOLD is not set:
B5272: 2>if the Serving Cell is configured with supplementary uplink as specified in TS 38.331 [5]; and
B5273: 2>if the RSRP of the downlink pathloss reference is less than rsrp-ThresholdSSB-SUL:
B5274: 3>select the SUL carrier.
B5275: 2>else:
B5276: 3>select the NUL carrier.
B5277: 2>if CG-SDT is configured on the selected UL carrier, and TA for CG-SDT is valid according to clause 5.27.2 in the first available CG occasion for initial CG-SDT transmission with CCCH message according to clause 5.8.2; and
B5278: 2>if the SDT procedure is initiated for MO-SDT as specified in TS 38.331 [5], and, for each RB having data available for transmission, configuredGrantType1Allowed, if configured for CG-SDT, is configured with value true for the corresponding logical channel, or if the SDT procedure is initiated for MT-SDT as specified in TS 38.331 [5]; and
B5279: 2>if at least one SSB configured for CG-SDT with SS-RSRP above cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB is available, and if either the time gap between the initiation of the SDT procedure and first available CG occasion for initial CG-SDT transmission with CCCH message according to clause 5.8.2 is less than MAX_DURATION_TO_NEXT_CG_OCCASION, or if the MAX_DURATION_TO_NEXT_CG_OCCASION is not set:
B5280: 3>indicate to the upper layers that the conditions for initiating SDT procedure are fulfilled;
B5281: 3>perform CG-SDT procedure on the selected UL carrier according to clause 5.8.2.
B5282: 2>else if a set of Random Access resources for RA-SDT is configured and can be selected according to clause 5.1.1b on the selected UL carrier on the BWP configured by initialUplinkBWP-RedCap, if configured for an (e)RedCap UE; otherwise, on the BWP configured by initialUplinkBWP; or
B5283: 2>if the SDT procedure is initiated for MT-SDT as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B5284: 3>if cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer is running, consider cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer as expired and perform the corresponding actions in clause 5.2;
B5285: 3>indicate to the upper layers that the conditions for initiating SDT procedure are fulfilled.
B5286: 2>else:
B5287: 3>indicate to the upper layers that the conditions for initiating SDT procedure are not fulfilled.
B5288: 1>else:
B5289: 2>indicate to the upper layers that the conditions for initiating SDT procedure are not fulfilled.
B5290: If Random Access procedure is selected above for SDT procedure initiated for MO-SDT or MT-SDT and after the Random Access procedure is successfully completed (see clause 5.1.6), the UE monitors PDCCH addressed to C-RNTI received in random access response until the SDT procedure is terminated. If CG-SDT is selected above and after the initial transmission for CG-SDT is performed, the UE monitors PDCCH addressed to C-RNTI as stored in UE Inactive AS context as specified in TS 38.331 [5] and CS-RNTI until the SDT procedure is terminated.
B5291: The MAC entity shall:
B5292: 1>if sdt-BeamFailureRecoveryProhibitTimer is configured and not running; and
B5293: 1>if RA-SDT procedure for MO-SDT or MT-SDT procedure initiated by Random Access procedure is ongoing:
B5294: 2>if SS-RSRP of the SSB selected in the last successfully completed Random Access procedure during ongoing RA-SDT procedure or ongoing MT-SDT procedure initiated by Random Access procedure is less than rsrp-ThresholdSSB:
B5295: 3>start the sdt-BeamFailureRecoveryProhibitTimer;
B5296: 3>initiate a Random Access procedure (see clause 5.1).
B5297: NOTE 1a:It is up to UE implementation when to measure SSBs during ongoing RA-SDT procedure or ongoing MT-SDT procedure initiated by Random Access procedure. Based on implementation the UE need not initiate the Random Access procedure if there is no SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB. The UE uses rsrp-ThresholdSSB in Random Access configuration selected by the UE when RA-SDT or MT-SDT procedure was initiated.
B5298: NOTE 2:When the UE determines if there is an SSB with SS-RSRP above cg-SDT-RSRP-ThresholdSSB or less than rsrp-ThresholdSSB, the UE uses the latest unfiltered L1-RSRP measurement.
B5299: 5.27.2TA Validation for CG-SDT
B5300: RRC configures the following parameters for TA validation for CG-SDT:
B5301: -cg-SDT-RSRP-ChangeThreshold: RSRP threshold for the increase/decrease of RSRP for time alignment validation.
B5302: The MAC entity shall, upon the reception of CG-SDT configuration:
B5303: 1>store the current RSRP of the downlink pathloss reference for TA validation as defined in TS 38.331 [5] clause 5.7.17.
B5304: The MAC entity shall consider the TA of the initial CG-SDT transmission with CCCH message to be valid when the following conditions are fulfilled:
B5305: 1>The RSRP values for the stored downlink pathloss reference and the current downlink pathloss reference are valid according to TS 38.133 [11]; and
B5306: 1>Compared to the stored downlink pathloss reference RSRP value, the current RSRP value of the downlink pathloss reference calculated as specified in TS 38.133 [11] has not increased/decreased by more than cg-SDT-RSRP-ChangeThreshold, if configured; and
B5307: 1>cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer is running.
B5308: 5.28Sidelink Discontinuous Reception (DRX)
B5309: 5.28.1General
B5310: The MAC entity may be configured by RRC with an SL DRX functionality that controls the UE's SCI (i.e., 1st stage SCI and 2nd stage SCI) monitoring activity for unicast, groupcast and broadcast. When using SL DRX operation, the MAC entity shall also monitor SCI (i.e., 1st stage SCI and 2nd stage SCI) according to requirements found in other clauses of this specification.
B5311: Sidelink DRX and UE procedure on Dedicated SL-PRS resource pool are not applied at the same time.
B5312: RRC controls Sidelink DRX operation by configuring the following parameters:
B5313: -sl-drx-onDurationTimer/sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer: the duration at the beginning of an SL DRX cycle;
B5314: -sl-drx-SlotOffset: the delay before starting the sl-drx-onDurationTimer/sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer;
B5315: -sl-drx-InactivityTimer/sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer (except for the SL broadcast communication): the duration after the first slot of SCI (i.e., 1st stage SCI and 2nd stage SCI) reception in which an SCI indicates a new SL transmission for the MAC entity;
B5316: -sl-drx-RetransmissionTimer/sl-DRX-GC-RetransmissionTimer (per Sidelink process except for the SL broadcast process): the maximum duration until an SL retransmission is received;
B5317: -sl-drx-StartOffset: defines the subframe where the SL DRX cycle starts;
B5318: -sl-drx-Cycle/sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle: the Sidelink DRX cycle;
B5319: -sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer (per Sidelink process except for the SL broadcast process): the minimum duration before an SL HARQ retransmission is expected by the MAC entity.
B5320: 5.28.2Behaviour of UE receiving SL-SCH Data
B5321: When SL DRX is configured, the Active Time includes the time while:
B5322: -sl-drx-onDurationTimer/sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer or sl-drx-InactivityTimer/sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer is running; or
B5323: -sl-drx-RetransmissionTimer/sl-DRX-GC-RetransmissionTimer is running; or
B5324: -period of sl-LatencyBoundCSI-Report configured by RRC in case SL-CSI reporting MAC CE is not received; or
B5325: -the time between the transmission of the request of SL-CSI reporting and the reception of the SL-CSI reporting MAC CE in case SL-CSI reporting MAC CE is received; or
B5326: -Slot(s) associated with the announced periodic transmission(s) by the UE transmitting SL-SCH Data; or
B5327: -the time between transmission/reception of Direct Link Establishment Request message (TS 24.587 [28]) or ProSe Direct Link Establishment Request message (TS 24.554 [29]) and reception of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message including initial DRX configuration or the link establishment procedure being aborted by upper layer; or
B5328: -the time between transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message including initial DRX configuration and reception of corresponding RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink or RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message.
B5329: When one or multiple SL DRX is configured, the MAC entity shall, for each Destination Layer-2 ID associated to groupcast or broadcast:
B5330: 1>if a single sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle that is mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List or a single sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle that is configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC and none of the QoS profiles associated to the Destination Layer-2 ID can be mapped with any SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List:
B5331: 2>select the sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle that is mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List or the sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC.
B5332: 1>else if multiple sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle that include one or multiple sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle that are mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List and, if applicable, one sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle that is configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC and at least one QoS profile associated to the Destination Layer-2 ID cannot be mapped with any SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List:
B5333: 2>select the sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle whose length is the shortest one among multiple sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle that are mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List and, if applicable, sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC.
B5334: 1>if a single sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer that is mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List or a single sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer that is configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC and none of the QoS profiles associated to the Destination Layer-2 ID can be mapped with any SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List:
B5335: 2>select the sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer that is mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List or the sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC.
B5336: 1>else if multiple sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer that include one or multiple sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer that are mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List and, if applicable, one sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer that is configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC and at least one QoS profile associated to the Destination Layer-2 ID cannot be mapped with any SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List:
B5337: 2>select the sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer whose length is the longest one among multiple sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer that are mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List and, if applicable, sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC.
B5338: 1>if a single sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer that is mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List or a single sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer that is configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC and none of the QoS profiles associated to the Destination Layer-2 ID can be mapped with any SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List and the associated cast type is groupcast:
B5339: 2>select the sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer that is mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List or the sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC.
B5340: 1>else if multiple sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer that include one or multiple sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer that are mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List and, if applicable, one sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer that is configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC and at least one QoS profile associated to the Destination Layer-2 ID cannot be mapped with any SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List and the associated cast type is groupcast:
B5341: 2>select sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer whose length is the longest one among multiple sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer that are mapped with one or multiple SL-QoS-Profile in sl-DRX-GC-BC-PerQoS-List and, if applicable, sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer configured in sl-DefaultDRX-GC-BC.
B5342: The MAC entity shall:
B5343: 1>if an sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer expires:
B5344: 2>if the data of the corresponding Sidelink process was not successfully decoded or if the HARQ feedback (i.e., negative acknowledgement) is not transmitted for unicast due to UL/SL prioritization:
B5345: 3>start the sl-drx-RetransmissionTimer/sl-DRX-GC-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the expiry of sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer.
B5346: When the cast type is groupcast or broadcast as indicated by upper layer, or the cast type is unicast for the reception of Direct Link Establishment Request message [28] or ProSe Direct Link Establishment Request message [29] as indicated by upper layer, or for the reception of discovery message [26], the sl-drx-StartOffset and sl-drx-SlotOffset are derived from the following equations:
B5347: sl-drx-StartOffset (ms) = Destination Layer-2 ID modulo sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle (ms).
B5348: sl-drx-SlotOffset (ms) = (Destination Layer-2 ID modulo the number of slots in one subframe)/ (the number of slots in one subframe) (ms).
B5350: The MAC entity shall:
B5351: 1>if the SL DRX cycle is used, and [(DFN × 10) + subframe number] modulo (sl-drx-Cycle or sl-DRX-GC-BC-Cycle) = sl-drx-StartOffset:
B5352: 2>start sl-drx-onDurationTimer/sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer after sl-drx-SlotOffset from the beginning of the subframe.
B5353: 1>if an SL DRX is in Active Time:
B5354: 2>monitor the SCI (i.e., 1st stage SCI and 2nd stage SCI).
B5355: 2>if the SCI indicates a new SL transmission:
B5356: 3>if Source Layer-1 ID of the SCI is equal to the 8 LSB of the intended Destination Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-1 ID of the SCI is equal to the 16 LSB of the intended Source Layer-2 ID and the cast type indicator in the SCI is set to unicast:
B5357: 4>start or restart sl-drx-InactivityTimer for the corresponding Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID pair in the first slot after SCI reception.
B5358: 3>if Destination Layer-1 ID of the SCI (i.e., 2nd stage SCI) is equal to the 16 LSB of the intended Destination Layer-2 ID and the cast type indicator in the SCI is set to groupcast:
B5359: 4>start or restart sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer for the corresponding Destination Layer-2 ID in the first slot after SCI reception.
B5360: 2>if the SCI indicates an SL transmission:
B5361: 3>if a next retransmission opportunity is indicated in the SCI:
B5362: 4>derive the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer from the retransmission resource timing of the next retransmission resource in the SCI.
B5363: 3>else if PSFCH resource is configured for the SL grant associated to the SCI:
B5364: 4>set the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer based on sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer1 configured by upper layer if the cast type associated with the SCI is unicast or sl-DRX-GC-HARQ-RTT-Timer1 configured by upper layer if the cast type associated with the SCI is groupcast when HARQ feedback is enabled, or based on sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer2 configured by upper layer if the cast type associated with the SCI is unicast or sl-DRX-GC-HARQ-RTT-Timer2 configured by upper layer if the cast type associated with the SCI is groupcast when HARQ feedback is disabled, for resource pool configured with PSFCH.
B5365: 3>else (i.e., if PSFCH resource is not configured for the SL grant associated to the SCI):
B5366: 4>set the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer as 0 slots.
B5367: 3>if PSFCH resource is not configured for the SL grant associated to the SCI:
B5368: 4>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the slot following the end of PSSCH transmission (i.e., currently received PSSCH).
B5369: 3>if PSFCH resource is configured for the SL grant associated to the SCI:
B5370: 4>if HARQ feedback is enabled by the SCI and the cast type associated with the SCI is unicast:
B5371: 5>if sl-NumPSFCH-Occasions is configured as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B5372: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of corresponding PSFCH transmission carrying the SL HARQ Feedback when the SL HARQ feedback is successfully transmitted in one of PSFCH occasions from sl-NumPSFCH-Occasions; or
B5373: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the last PSFCH occasion for the SL HARQ Feedback when the SL HARQ feedback is not transmitted in all PSFCH occasions from sl-NumPSFCH-Occasions.
B5374: 5>else:
B5375: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH transmission carrying the SL HARQ feedback; or
B5376: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH resource for the SL HARQ feedback when the SL HARQ feedback is not transmitted due to UL/SL prioritization or SL LBT failure.
B5377: 4>if HARQ feedback is enabled by the SCI and the cast type associated with the SCI is groupcast and positive-negative acknowledgement is selected:
B5378: 5>if sl-NumPSFCH-Occasions is configured as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B5379: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the last PSFCH occasion for the SL HARQ Feedback.
B5380: 5>else:
B5381: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH transmission carrying the SL HARQ feedback; or
B5382: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH resource for the SL HARQ feedback when the SL HARQ feedback is not transmitted due to UL/SL prioritization.
B5383: 4>if HARQ feedback is enabled by the SCI and the cast type associated with the SCI is groupcast and negative-only acknowledgement is selected;
B5384: 5>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH transmission carrying the SL HARQ feedback; or
B5385: 5>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH resource for the SL HARQ feedback when the SL HARQ feedback is not transmitted due to UL/SL prioritization; or
B5386: 5>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH resource for the SL HARQ feedback when the SL HARQ feedback is a positive acknowledgement.
B5387: 4>if HARQ feedback is disabled by the SCI and the resource(s) for one or more retransmission opportunities is not scheduled in the SCI:
B5388: 5>if sl-NumPSFCH-Occasions is configured as specified in TS 38.331 [5]:
B5389: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the last PSFCH occasion.
B5390: 5>else:
B5391: 6>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the slot following the end of PSFCH resource.
B5392: 4>if HARQ feedback is disabled by the SCI and the resource(s) for one or more retransmission opportunities is scheduled in the SCI:
B5393: 5>start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the slot following the end of PSSCH transmission (i.e., currently received PSSCH).
B5394: NOTE:Void.
B5395: 3>stop the sl-drx-RetransmissionTimer/sl-DRX-GC-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding Sidelink process.
B5396: 1>if an SL DRX Command MAC CE is received for the Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID pair of a unicast:
B5397: 2>stop sl-drx-onDurationTimer for the Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID pair of a unicast;
B5398: 2>stop sl-drx-InactivityTimer for the Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID pair of a unicast.
B5399: 5.28.3Behaviour of UE transmitting SL-SCH Data
B5400: The UE transmitting SL-SCH Data should keep aligned with its intended UE receiving the SL-SCH Data regarding the SL DRX Active time as specified in clause 5.28.2.
B5401: Furthermore, the UE transmitting SL-SCH Data determines the SL DRX Active time based on SL DRX timers that are running (e.g., sl-drx-onDurationTimer/sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer, sl-drx-InactivityTimer/sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer, sl-drx-RetransmissionTimer/sl-DRX-GC-RetransmissionTimer) or will be running in the future (e.g., sl-drx-onDurationTimer/sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer, sl-drx-InactivityTimer/sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer, sl-drx-RetransmissionTimer/sl-DRX-GC-RetransmissionTimer) at the UE(s) receiving SL-SCH data. The UE may select resource for the initial transmission of groupcast within the time when sl-DRX-GC-BC-OnDurationTimer or sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer of the destination is running.
B5402: NOTE 1:A UE may assume that a resource for retransmission is in the Active time if an initial transmission causes the sl-drx-RetransmissionTimer/sl-DRX-GC-RetransmissionTimer to be started at the receiving UE.
B5403: NOTE 2:A UE may send SL DRX Command MAC CE to receiving UE for unicast and when to send SL DRX Command MAC CE is up to UE implementation.
B5404: The MAC entity shall for each Destination Layer-2 ID associated with groupcast that is interested in NR sidelink transmision:
B5405: 1>if the SCI indicates a new transmission where the cast type is set to groupcast is transmitted:
B5406: 2>start or restart sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer for the corresponding Destination Layer-2 ID in the first slot after SCI transmission.
B5407: The MAC entity shall for each pair of the Source Layer-2 ID and the Destination Layer-2 ID corresponding to each PC5-RRC connection which has been established by upper layers:
B5408: 1>if the SL DRX Command indication has been triggered by the UE:
B5409: 2>if the MAC entity has SL resources allocated for new transmission and the SL-SCH resources can accommodate the SL DRX Command MAC CE and its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization:
B5410: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate a Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE as defined in clause 6.1.3.52;
B5411: 3>cancel the triggered SL DRX Command indication.
B5412: 2>else if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 1:
B5413: 3>trigger a Scheduling Request.
B5414: 5.29Activation/Deactivation of SCG
B5415: The network may activate and deactivate the configured SCG.
B5416: The MAC entity shall for the configured SCG:
B5417: 1>if upper layers indicate that SCG is activated:
B5418: 2>if BFI_COUNTER >= beamFailureInstanceMaxCount for the PSCell or the timeAlignmentTimer associated with PTAG is not running:
B5419: 3>indicate to upper layers that a Random Access Procedure (as specified in clause 5.1.1) is needed for SCG activation.
B5420: 2>activate the SCG according to the timing defined in TS 38.133 [11].
B5421: 2>(re-)initialize any suspended configured uplink grants of configured grant Type 1 associated with this PSCell according to the stored configuration, if any, and to start in the symbol according to rules in clause 5.8.2.2;
B5422: 2>apply normal SCG operation including:
B5423: 3>SRS transmissions on the PSCell;
B5424: 3>CSI reporting for the PSCell;
B5425: 3>PDCCH monitoring on the PSCell;
B5426: 3>PUCCH transmissions on the PSCell;
B5427: 3>transmit on RACH on the PSCell;
B5428: 3>initialize Bj for each logical channel to zero.
B5429: 1>else if upper layers indicate that the SCG is deactivated:
B5430: 2>deactivate all the SCells of the SCG according to clause 5.9;
B5431: 2>deactivate SCG according to the timing defined in TS 38.133 [11];
B5432: 2>clear any configured downlink assignment and any configured uplink grant Type 2 associated with the PSCell respectively;
B5433: 2>suspend any configured uplink grant Type 1 associated with the PSCell;
B5434: 2>reset MAC according to clause 5.12;
B5435: 2>flush all HARQ buffers associated with the PSCell.
B5436: 1>if the SCG is deactivated:
B5437: 2>not transmit SRS on the PSCell;
B5438: 2>not report CSI for the PSCell;
B5439: 2>not transmit on UL-SCH on the PSCell;
B5440: 2>not transmit PUCCH on the PSCell;
B5441: 2>not transmit on RACH on the PSCell;
B5442: 2>not monitor the PDCCH on the PSCell.
B5443: 5.30Handling of FR2 UL gap
B5444: During the FR2 UL gap configured by ul-GapFR2-Config as specified in TS 38.331 [5], the MAC entity shall, on the Serving Cell(s) of FR2 single CC and intra-band CA, or on the Serving Cell(s) of FR2 inter-band CA where UE does not support tx-Support-UL-GapFR2:
B5445: 1>only perform transmission of:
B5446: 2>PRACH preamble as specified in clause 5.1.2 and 5.1.2a;
B5447: 2>UL-SCH for Msg3 or the MSGA payload as specified in clause 5.4.2.2;
B5448: 2>UL-SCH for configured grant;
B5449: 2>mode-B UE-initiated CSI report;
B5450: 2>the valid CSI report during SCell activation procedure where the valid CSI report is valid CQI with non-zero CQI index defined in TS 38.214 [7], clause 5.2.2.1, when the time period between UL gap colliding with CSI report of non-zero CQI and the slot where the SCell activation MAC CE or CSI report activation command is received is no less than 10 ms;
B5451: 2>the valid L1 RSRP report during SCell activation procedure, where the valid L1 RSRP report is non lowest L1 RSRP defined in TS 38.133 [11], clause 10.1.6, when the time period between UL gap colliding with L1 RSRP reporting and the slot where the SCell activation MAC CE or CSI report activation command is received is no less than 10 ms;
B5452: 2>the PUCCH transmission for SR, UE Initiated Report Indication, and link recovery request (LRR) defined in TS 38.133 [11], clause 8.5.
B5453: 5.31Sidelink LBT operation
B5454: 5.31.1General
B5455: The lower layer may perform an SL LBT procedure, see TS 37.213 [18], according to which a transmission is not performed by lower layers if the channel is identified as being occupied. When lower layer performs an SL LBT procedure before a transmission and the transmission is not performed, an SL LBT failure indication is sent to the MAC entity from lower layers. Unless otherwise specified, when SL LBT procedure is performed for a transmission, actions as specified in this specification are performed regardless of if an SL LBT failure indication is received from lower layers. When SL LBT is not performed by the lower layers, SL LBT failure indication is not received from lower layers.
B5456: 5.31.2Sidelink LBT failure detection and recovery procedure
B5457: The MAC entity may be configured by RRC with a Sidelink consistent LBT failure detection and recovery procedure. Sidelink consistent LBT failure is detected per RB set by counting SL LBT failure indications, for all SL transmissions, from the lower layers to the MAC entity.
B5458: RRC configures the following parameters in the sl-LBT-FailureRecoveryConfig:
B5459: -sl-LBT-FailureInstanceMaxCount for the Sidelink consistent LBT failure detection;
B5460: -sl-LBT-FailureDetectionTimer for the Sidelink consistent LBT failure detection;
B5461: -sl-LBT-RecoveryTimer for recovery of the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure.
B5462: The following UE variable is used for the Sidelink consistent LBT failure detection procedure:
B5463: -SL_LBT_COUNTER (per RB set): counter for SL LBT failure indication which is initially set to 0.
B5464: For activated SL BWP configured with sl-LBT-FailureRecoveryConfig, the MAC entity shall:
B5465: 1>if SL LBT failure indication has been received from lower layers for an RB set of the configured pool(s) of resources in the SL BWP:
B5466: 2>start or restart the sl-LBT-FailureDetectionTimer for the RB set;
B5467: 2>increment SL_LBT_COUNTER for the RB set by 1;
B5468: 2>if SL_LBT_COUNTER >= sl-LBT-FailureInstanceMaxCount:
B5469: 3>trigger Sidelink consistent LBT failure for the RB set in the SL BWP;
B5470: 3>if consistent LBT failure has been triggered in all the RB sets of the configured pool(s) of resources in the SL BWP:
B5471: 4>indicate Sidelink consistent LBT failure based Sidelink RLF detection for all destination IDs associated to unicast service to upper layers.
B5472: 1>if all triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failures are cancelled in a RB set; or
B5473: 1>if the sl-LBT-FailureDetectionTimer expires for a RB set:
B5474: 2>set SL_LBT_COUNTER to 0 for the RB set.
B5475: 1>if sl-LBT-FailureDetectionTimer or sl-LBT-FailureInstanceMaxCount is reconfigured by upper layers:
B5476: 2>set SL_LBT_COUNTER to 0 for all the RB sets.
B5477: The sl-LBT-RecoveryTimer is used for recovery of the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure, when RRC configures Sidelink resource allocation mode 2.
B5478: The MAC entity shall:
B5479: 1>if Sidelink consistent LBT failure has been triggered, and not cancelled, in the RB set(s), and SL LBT failure MAC CE for the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure has not been generated;
B5480: 2>if the sl-LBT-RecoveryTimer for the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure is not running:
B5481: 3>start the sl-LBT-RecoveryTimer.
B5482: 2>if UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the SL LBT failure MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of logical channel prioritization according to clause 5.4.3.1:
B5483: 3>instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure in clause 5.4.3 to generate the SL LBT failure MAC CE.
B5484: 2>else:
B5485: 3>trigger a Scheduling Request for SL LBT failure MAC CE.
B5486: 1>if a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes the SL LBT failure MAC CE:
B5487: 2>cancel the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure(s) in RB set(s) for which Sidelink consistent LBT failure was indicated in the transmitted SL LBT failure MAC CE if the MAC entity has been configured with Sidelink resource allocation mode 1.
B5488: 1>if the sl-LBT-RecoveryTimer for the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure(s) expires:
B5489: 2>cancel the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure(s) in RB set(s) for which Sidelink consistent LBT failure was detected.
B5490: 1>if sl-LBT-FailureRecoveryConfig is reconfigured by upper layers for the BWP:
B5491: 2>cancel all the triggered Sidelink consistent LBT failure(s) in the SL BWP.
B5492: 5.32Void
B5493: 5.33First PUSCH transmission of RACH-less handover
B5494: The first PUSCH uplink transmission of a RACH-less handover procedure can be performed either using a dynamic uplink grant or a configured uplink grant Type 1 preallocated by RRC, if configured.
B5495: When rach-LessHO is configured, the MAC entity shall:
B5496: 1>if cg-RRC-Configuration is configured:
B5497: 2>select a configured uplink grant for the first PUSCH transmission according to clause 5.8.2;
B5498: 2>perform the first PUSCH transmission in the first available CG occasion for RACH-less handover according to clause 5.8.2;
B5499: 2>monitor the PDCCH as specified in clause 5.7 and TS 38.213 [6].
B5500: 1>else:
B5501: 2>if tci-StateID is configured in rach-LessHO:
B5502: 3>indicate to lower layers the TCI state information included in tci-StateID.
B5503: 2>else if ssb-Index is configured in rach-LessHO:
B5504: 3>indicate to lower layers the SSB index included in ssb-Index.
B5505: 2>monitor the PDCCH as specified in TS 38.213 [6].
B5506: 5.34Cell-Level Energy Saving
B5507: 5.34.1General
B5508: Each Serving Cell may be configured by RRC with a periodic cell DTX pattern (i.e., Active and Non-Active Periods). The cell DTX operation controls UE's monitoring activity of PDCCH and configured downlink assignments in RRC_CONNECTED. For all activated Serving Cells with cell DTX configured and activated, the MAC entity may monitor PDCCH and configured downlink assignments using the cell DTX operation specified in clause 5.34.2.
B5509: Each Serving Cell may be configured by RRC with a periodic cell DRX pattern (i.e., Active and Non-Active Periods). The cell DRX operation controls Scheduling Request and configured uplink grant transmission activity in RRC_CONNECTED. For all activated Serving Cells with cell DRX configured and activated, the MAC entity may transmit configured uplink grant transmissions and Scheduling Request using the cell DRX operation specified in clause 5.34.3.
B5510: RRC controls cell DTX and cell DRX operation by configuring the following parameters in cellDTX-DRX-Config per Serving Cell:
B5511: -cellDTX-DRX-ConfigType: defines whether only cell DTX is configured, only cell DRX is configured, or both are configured;
B5512: -cellDTX-DRX-onDurationTimer: the active duration at the beginning of a cell DTX/DRX cycle;
B5513: -cellDTX-DRX-StartOffset: defines the subframe where the cell DTX/DRX cycle starts;
B5514: -cellDTX-DRX-SlotOffset: the delay before starting the cellDTX-DRX-onDurationTimer;
B5515: -cellDTX-DRX-Cycle: the cell DTX/DRX cycle period.
B5516: -cellDTX-DRX-ActivationStatus: the initial activation status of cell DTX and cell DRX operation.
B5517: 5.34.2Cell Discontinuous Transmission
B5518: Cell DTX is configured if cellDTX-DRX-ConfigType is set to dtx or dtxdrx. Cell DTX operation is activated and deactivated for each Serving Cell by:
B5519: -receiving a cell DTX indication from lower layers indicating activation or deactivation of cell DTX operation, as specified in TS 38.213 [6];
B5520: -configuring cellDTX-DRX-Config by upper layers: if cell DTX is configured and cellDTX-DRX-ActivationStatus is set to activated, cell DTX operation is activated upon cell DTX configuration; if cell DTX is configured and cellDTX-DRX-ActivationStatus is set to deactivated, cell DTX operation is deactivated upon cell DTX configuration; if cellDTX-DRX-Config is released or reconfigured as cell DRX only, cell DTX operation is deactivated and all the corresponding configurations are released.
B5521: When cell DTX is configured and activated for a Serving Cell, the cell DTX Active Period includes the time while:
B5522: -cellDTX-DRX-onDurationTimer is running for the associated Serving Cell.
B5523: For each Serving Cell configured with cell DTX, the MAC entity shall:
B5524: 1>if cell DTX is activated for this Serving Cell:
B5525: 2>if [(SFN × 10) + subframe number] modulo (cellDTX-DRX-Cycle) = (cellDTX-DRX-StartOffset):
B5526: 3>start cellDTX-DRX-onDurationTimer for this serving cell after cellDTX-DRX-SlotOffset from the beginning of the subframe.
B5527: NOTE:In case of unaligned SFN across carriers in a cell group, the SFN of the SpCell is used to calculate the cell DTX duration.
B5528: 1>if cell DTX operation is deactivated for this Serving Cell; or
B5529: 1>if the Serving Cell is in the cell DTX Active Period:
B5530: 2>monitor PDCCH on this Serving Cell, as specified in TS 38.213 [6] and other clauses of this specification.
B5531: 1>if any drx-RetransmissionTimerDL, drx-RetransmissionTimerUL or drx-RetransmissionTimerSL (as described in clause 5.7) is running on any Serving Cell in the DRX group of this Serving Cell; or
B5532: 1>if ra-ContentionResolutionTimer (as described in clause 5.1.5) or msgB-ResponseWindow (as described in clause 5.1.4a) is running; or
B5533: 1>if a Scheduling Request is sent on PUCCH and is pending (as described in clause 5.4.4 or 5.22.1.5); or
B5534: 1>if a PDCCH indicating a new transmission addressed to the C-RNTI of the MAC entity has not been received after successful reception of a Random Access Response for the Random Access Preamble not selected by the MAC entity among the contention-based Random Access Preamble (as described in clauses 5.1.4 and 5.1.4a):
B5535: 2>monitor PDCCH on the Serving Cells in the DRX group of this Serving Cell, as specified in TS 38.213 [6] and other clauses of this specification.
B5536: 1>if ra-ResponseWindow (as described in clause 5.1.4) is running and this Serving Cell is the SpCell:
B5537: 2>monitor PDCCH on this Serving Cell (as described in clause 5.1.4).
B5538: For each Serving Cell configured with cell DTX, the MAC entity need not:
B5539: 1>if cell DTX operation is activated and the Serving Cell is not in the cell DTX Active Period:
B5540: 2>monitor PDCCH for the MAC entity's RNTIs listed in clauses 5.7 and 5.7b, irrespective of the requirements of clauses 5.7 and 5.7b, unless stated otherwise in this clause;
B5541: 2>instruct the physical layer to receive transport block on the DL-SCH of this Serving Cell according to a configured downlink assignment for SPS;
B5542: 2>indicate the presence of a configured downlink assignment and deliver the stored HARQ information to the HARQ entity;
B5543: 2>set the HARQ Process ID to the HARQ Process ID associated with the PDSCH duration of a configured downlink assignment;
B5544: 2>consider the NDI bit for the HARQ process corresponding to the PDSCH duration of a configured downlink assignment to have been toggled for the configured downlink assignment.
B5545: 5.34.3Cell Discontinuous Reception
B5546: Cell DRX is configured if cellDTX-DRX-ConfigType is set to drx or dtxdrx. Cell DRX operation is activated and deactivated for each Serving Cell by:
B5547: -receiving a cell DRX indication from lower layers indicating activation or deactivation of cell DRX operation, as specified in TS 38.213 [6];
B5548: -configuring cellDTX-DRX-Config by upper layers: if cell DRX is configured and cellDTX-DRX-ActivationStatus is set to activated, cell DRX operation is activated upon cell DRX configuration; if cell DRX is configured and cellDTX-DRX-ActivationStatus is set to deactivated, cell DRX operation is deactivated upon cell DRX configuration; if cellDTX-DRX-Config is released or reconfigured as cell DTX only, cell DRX operation is deactivated and all the corresponding configurations are released.
B5549: When cell DRX is configured and activated for a Serving Cell, the cell DRX Active Period includes the time while:
B5550: -cellDTX-DRX-onDurationTimer is running for the associated Serving Cell.
B5551: For each Serving Cell configured with cell DRX, the MAC entity shall:
B5552: 1>if cell DRX is activated for this Serving Cell:
B5553: 2>if [(SFN × 10) + subframe number] modulo (cellDTX-DRX-Cycle) = (cellDTX-DRX-StartOffset):
B5554: 3>start cellDTX-DRX-onDurationTimer for this serving cell after cellDTX-DRX-SlotOffset from the beginning of the subframe.
B5555: NOTE 1:In case of unaligned SFN across carriers in a cell group, the SFN of the SpCell is used to calculate the cell DRX duration.
B5556: 1>if cell DRX is activated and the Serving Cell is not in the cell DRX Active Period:
B5557: 2>not instruct the physical layer to signal a SR on a PUCCH resource for SR;
B5558: 2>not increment the SR_COUNTER for a SR;
B5559: 2>not start the sr-ProhibitTimer for a SR;
B5560: 2>not deliver any configured uplink grant and the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity;
B5561: 2>not instruct a HARQ process associated with a configured uplink grant to trigger a new transmission or a retransmission;
B5562: 2>not report CSI on PUCCH and semi-persistent CSI configured on PUSCH;
B5563: 2>not transmit UE Initiated Report Indication on PUCCH of the Serving Cell for mode-A UE-initiated CSI reporting;
B5564: 2>not transmit UE Initiated Report Indication on PUCCH and the associated mode-B UE-initiated CSI report on PUSCH if the PUCCH or the PUSCH resource of the Serving Cell is not in the cell DRX Active Period;
B5565: 2>if the UE is configured to transmit periodic/semi-persistent SRS and the SRS is not for positioning:
B5566: 3>not transmit periodic/semi-persistent SRS.
B5567: 2>if an emergency service is initiated by upper layers and this Serving Cell is the SpCell:
B5568: 3>initiate a Random Access procedure (as specified in clause 5.1.1).
B5569: NOTE 2:How the MAC layer in the UE is aware of an ongoing emergency service is up to UE implementation.
B5570: 2>if upper layers provide Access Identity 1 or Access Identity 2 and this Serving Cell is the SpCell:
B5571: 3>initiate a Random Access procedure (as specified in clause 5.1.1).
B5572: 5.35L1 measurement and event triggered report
B5573: 5.35.1Introduction
B5574: The network may configure an RRC_CONNECTED UE to perform L1 beam level measurements for LTM candidate cell(s) and/or serving cell, and report the corresponding measurement results in accordance with the event triggered L1 measurement configuration or perform the L1 measurement based Conditional LTM in accordance with the Conditional LTM execution condition. The measurement report is used for indicating to serving gNB of the L1 measurement results from the serving cell and/or candidate cell(s). The measurement configuration is provided by means of RRC dedicated signalling.
B5575: The network may configure the UE to report the following measurement information based on SS/PBCH block(s):
B5576: -Measurement results per SS/PBCH block;
B5577: -SS/PBCH block(s) resource indicator (SSBRI).
B5578: The network may configure the UE to report the following measurement information based on CSI-RS resources:
B5579: -Measurement results per CSI-RS resource;
B5580: -CSI-RS resource indicator (CRI).
B5581: RRC configures the following parameters in the LTM-CSI-ReportConfig:
B5582: -ltm-ResourcesForChannelMeasurement for the LTM resource configuration containing the RS(s) of LTM candidate cell(s) that may be measured for the event;
B5583: -eventTriggered for the event-triggered measurement report;
B5584: -eventLTM2, eventLTM3, eventLTM4, eventLTM5: events for the event-triggered measurement report;
B5585: -timeToTrigger (TTT): time during which an entering/leaving condition needs to be consistently satisfied for event triggered L1 measurement report or for cell switch execution;
B5586: -ltm-CandidateReportConfigList: List of report configurations for LTM candidate IDs;
B5587: -ltm-EventTriggeredPeriodicReport: whether the event triggered L1 measurement report is sent periodically if an LTM event is triggered;
B5588: -reportOnLeave: whether the event triggered L1 measurement report shall be triggered when the leaving condition for an event is satisfied;
B5589: -ltm-EventTriggeredReportContent: the content of the event triggered L1 measurement report;
B5590: -candidateSpecificOffset: offset for event condition that is applicable for all the reference signals belonging to the candidate cell with the candidate cell ID ltm-CandidateReportConfigId;
B5591: -ltm-CandidateReportConfigId: LTM candidate cell ID for which the UE is required to measure reference signal and perform LTM event evaluation;
B5592: -servingSpecificOffsetS: offset for event condition that is applicable for all the reference signals belonging to the serving cell.
B5593: For L1 measurement and event triggered L1 measurement reporting, if an ltm-CSI-ReportConfig or an ltm-CSI-ResourceConfig associated with that ltm-CSI-ReportConfig is removed or modified from the current UE configuration, as specified in TS 38.331 [5], the MAC entity shall:
B5594: 1>remove the measurement reporting entry for the corresponding ltm-CSI-ReportConfigId from the MR_LIST, if included;
B5595: 1>stop the periodical reporting timer, if running, and reset the associated information (e.g. TTT and variables defined in 5.35.3) for the corresponding ltm-CSI-ReportConfigId;
B5596: 1>cancel, if any, triggered event triggered L1 measurement report for the corresponding ltm-CSI-ReportConfigId.
B5597: 5.35.2Performing measurement
B5598: An RRC_CONNECTED UE obtains L1 beam level measurement results by measuring one or multiple RSs as configured by the network as specified in TS 38.214 [7] for LTM candidate cell(s) for evaluation of reporting criteria or evaluation of execution condition.
B5599: For L1 measurements performed for evaluation of reporting criteria as specified in clause 5.35.3 or evaluation of execution condition as specified in clause 5.36.2, the MAC entity shall:
B5600: -apply the layer 1 filtering by implementation, before using the measured results for evaluation of reporting criteria and measurement reporting or evaluation of execution condition.
B5601: -when the UE has two indicated TCI-states, use the best beam of the serving cell. It is up to the UE implementation how to choose the best beam.
B5602: 5.35.3Measurement report triggering
B5603: 5.35.3.1General
B5604: The UE maintains the following UE variables for event triggered L1 measurement and report procedure:
B5605: -MR_LIST: includes the list of ltm-CSI-ReportConfigId for which the L1 measurement report entering or leaving condition has been met for TTT for at least one applicable RS and, for each ltm-CSI-ReportConfigId, the RS resource index, and L1 measurement result of each measured applicable RS;
B5606: -MR_SENT_COUNTER: the number of event triggered L1 measurement report(s) sent by UE if a triggering condition for the corresponding event is met for TTT for each ltm-CSI-ReportConfigId;
